chapters.title: Chapter 351 - Planning
paragraphs: “Fang Heng? What do you think?”
The words were on the tip of his tongue, but just as he was about to reject him, Fang Heng immediately changed his words and spoke righteously.
“Of course, Ai Lei, whether it’s the parallel world or here, our goals are the same. Bring peace back to this world and rebuild our home.”
“You’re right, Fang Heng!”
Ai Lei excitedly slammed the table and turned to shout at the apocalypse merchant beside him, “Hawk! Give me two boxes of beer!”
Gulp gulp gulp...
Ai Lei gulped down a bottle of beer and passed another bottle to Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, if you need anything, feel free to contact me. We’ll save these two damned worlds together!”
Looking at the beer Ai Lei handed over, Fang Heng used his fingers to open the bottle cap.
Gulp gulp gulp...
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Ai Lei has increased significantly.]
[Hint: You have accepted the next tier for the main storyline mission-Ai Lei’s plan.]
Mission name: Ai Lei’s plan.
Mission description: Follow Ai Lei’s plan. You need to increase your level in the Scavenger Army as soon as possible to meet with Cook Barn.
Mission requirements: Increase the player’s Scavenger Army level to Level 10.
Mission reward: Main storyline contribution, survival points, King of Gods’ points.
After discussing some details with Ai Lei, Fang Heng returned to the shelter.
Seeing that the 48-hour parallel world teleportation time was about to end, Fang Heng went offline again and brought the ‘Occult Guide’ back to the real world. Then, he emptied his backpack.
Finally, he put the divine potion that he had painstakingly obtained into the warp backpack slot.
Fortunately, the item in the warp backpack slot could be stacked.
Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief, took two bottles of divine potion and waited for his return home.
The 48-hour time limit ended and Fang Heng was forcefully pulled back to District 8 in an instant.
[Hint: You have been pulled by a special spatial strength. You have returned to District 8.]
In the entire basement hall, dozens of research personnel were waiting for Fang Heng’s return.
This was the first time in history that parallel world teleportation had been carried out.
“You seem to be in good condition.” Victor waved at Fang Heng. “How does it feel to be in a parallel world? Fang Heng?”
The researcher looked at Fang Heng, waiting for him to give a speech.
“Not bad. The teleportation was successful. I went to that parallel universe.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the entire basement burst into cheers.

[Hint: The first parallel time travel has been completed. The morale of the survivors in your shelter has been greatly increased. The research speed has been increased by 72 hours and the loyalty of all survivors in the shelter has been slightly increased.]
David of the Dark Knights was also very concerned about Fang Heng’s trip. He and a few Dark Knights’ researchers had been staying here for the past two days, waiting for Fang Heng’s return.
“Fang Heng, Congratulations.”David asked, “What about the first-generation meteorite? Did you get the first-generation meteorite from the parallel world?”
“The first-generation meteorite is a little troublesome.” Fang Heng rubbed his neck and explained, “The first-generation meteorite from the parallel world was also destroyed.”
Mo Jiawei’s mouth was wide open. “It can’t be? District 7 was also scammed?”
“That’s not true. They’ve already researched the first-generation meteorite. The main storyline mission has also continued.”
Fang Heng roughly sorted out the things that had happened in District 7 and roughly told them about it.
Everyone, including David from the Dark Knights, had grave expressions on their faces when they heard this.
Mo Jiawei also didn’t recover from his senses for a long time.
He thought to himself, “Good guy, you went to District 7 once and even took down the main storyline mission of District 7?”
“Our District 8 hasn’t been settled yet. Does this count as having one’s feet in two boats?”
“Isn’t your step a little too big?”
“Oh right, this is the divine potion that I managed to obtain from the parallel world. We can study it. I wonder if it can replace the first-generation meteorite for analysis.”
Qiu Yaokang had been very interested in Fang Heng’s divine potion.
He walked to Fang Heng’s side, took the potion and observe it in his hand.
“I will immediately conduct a sample analysis.”
“Be careful of the purple worm inside.”
“Okay.”
David was also very curious about the first-generation meteorite. He nodded and said, “Mr Qiu, if you don’t mind, can we get our people to help you speed up the analysis and research?”
“The experiment must be led by me.”
David smiled gently and said, “Of course. I’ll listen to Mr Qiu’s arrangements.”
“Alright, follow me.”
With another new research item, Qiu Yaokang was unusually excited. He immediately returned to the laboratory with the potion and a group of researchers.
When most of the researchers and the group of Dark Knights were teleported to the hall again, Mo Jiawei walked up.
He whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “Fang Heng, has the mission been triggered?”
“No.”
Fang Heng shook his head and was a little disappointed.
“Judging from David’s look, I don’t think we can get the first-generation meteorite, nor can we trigger the next mission. What are we going to do next?”
“Don’t tell me you want to change your target and go to District 7?”
“No, let’s put District 7 aside for now. We still have to think of a way to find the first-generation meteorite.”
Fang Heng felt that District 8 was the foundation, so he had to get his hands on it first before considering the rest.
Mo Jiawei agreed, “I think so too. So, let’s try our luck on the other server?”
“Yes, speaking of which, I just thought of a good idea.”
Mo Jiawei’s eyes lit up. “You have an idea?”
“Yes, I just found a good thing.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he took out a 12-sided die from his pocket and placed it in his palm.
Mo Jiawei looked baffled.
“What?”
Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei on the shoulder. “Come, throw a sieve.”
“No way, Fang Heng.”
“Just treat it as a game. There’s no other hint anyway. Let’s try our luck on a random server.”
Mo Jiawei had a bitter expression on his face. He took the sieve and shook it casually.
Five points.
District 5?
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
When they saw the number, both of them fell silent at the same time.
Fang Heng suddenly recalled the message that Old Black had left for him not long ago.
District 5...
Now that he thought about it, could this be a hint that Old Black had left for him?
After all, Old Black knew that he had already obtained Victor.
Old Black was good at intelligence analysis, so he should be able to analyze that he had already obtained the space tearing device.
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed.
He wanted to contact Old Black and obtain real information from him.
But he couldn’t do it.
Who cares, let’s go to District 5 first!
With this thought, Fang Heng turned his head to look at Victor, who was checking the space tearing device behind him.
“Victor, can the space tearing device still be activated?”
“Not yet, Fang Heng.”
“To ensure the safety of the next teleportation, I still need to thoroughly check the device. If there are no accidents, it can be used again in five hours.”
Five hours was enough.
Fang Heng prepared to go offline to rest for a while. After five hours, he would directly enter District 5 to look for the first-generation meteorite.
“Wait, Fang Heng, are you sure you want to go to District 5 now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - Federation’s Shelter
paragraphs: “Huh?”

Mo Jiawei frowned and said, “I heard from Fourth Uncle two days ago that District 5 has been very chaotic recently and a big war might break out. Since two weeks ago, we have started to withdraw our investment in District 5.”
“Then I have to go and take a look.”
Fang Heng felt that District 5 would be a breakthrough point.
District 5 was the most chaotic in the Zombie Apocalypse.
The death rate of players there was high.
At first, there were a few anti-federation forces in District 5.
Later, as the Federation’s control over District 5 gradually decreased, many criminals on the Federation’s wanted list were transferred into District 5 through various means.
District 5 once became a haven for criminals.
Later, various anti-federation forces gradually infiltrated District 5 and joined forces to resist the Federation.
This had always been a headache for the Federation.
The Federation had also spent a great deal of effort to carry out several purges against District 5.
Each time, the Federation paid a great price, but the final result was not ideal.
As time passed, anti-federal organization forces of all sizes were deeply rooted in District 5.
As dusk approached, a spatial crack appeared in the forest area of District 5.
Through the spatial crack, Fang Heng appeared in the wilderness.
He quickly scanned his surroundings.
It was his first time in District 5 and he was unfamiliar with the place.
“It’s going to be dark soon. I need to find a shelter to settle down.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
After sunset, the apocalypse merchant camp would not open.
Fang Heng turned on his personal survival radio.
Soon, he found a large-scale Federation-built shelter nearby.
He was lucky!
In the chaotic District 5, there were quite a few Federation shelters!
For ordinary players, they could get a free night’s accommodation and a small amount of food there.
However, in order to stay for a long time and enter the safer Federation shelter, the player had to go through a series of real-name authentication offline.
Fang Heng planned to go to the Federation to rest for a day tonight and ask for some information related to District 5.
Following the game coordinates, Fang Heng followed a small path and soon arrived at a Federation shelter at the foot of the mountain.

Under the guidance of two Federation soldiers, Fang Heng went through a simple registration at the front desk. He received an identity number card and was led by a Federation soldier into an affiliated building outside the shelter.
This large-scale Federation shelter had a history of several decades and had undergone at least twenty transformations.
It was built at the foot of the mountain.
Halfway up the mountain, there was a large-scale mine controlled by the Federation.

Apart from the shelter, the Federation had also built several subsidiary buildings on the periphery of the shelter, two of which were the temporary refugee area and a warehouse for the players who sought refuge.
In order to ensure the safety of the shelter, a player like Fang Heng who only had basic information registered could only temporarily stay in the temporary refugee area outside the shelter.
Fang Heng looked at the Federation shelter in the distance and nodded in his heart.
The overall defense of the Federation shelter was much stronger than that of District 8 and District 7.
There were hundreds of automatic turrets visible to the naked eye.
Fang Heng felt that even with his own zombie team, it would be difficult to break through the shelter in a short time.
However, it would be different if it dragged on for a long time.
His own zombie clones could resurrect indefinitely, so it was likely that he could torture the shelter to death.
Soon, the Federation soldier led Fang Heng into a small hut with many people in it.
“Alright, you can stay here tonight.”
The Federation soldier threw a can of food to Fang Heng.
“This is the food you were given today. You can only get free food once a day. Eat it sparingly. You won’t starve to death.”
“Also, the inner area of the shelter is not open to you at the moment. Don’t go near it.”

“There is a sleeping pod in the shelter. After entering the sleeping pod, you can be guaranteed to log in once a month and not be affected by satiety. The current fee for the sleeping pod is 50 Federation coins a month. If there is a need, you need to go through the identity verification process offline in advance.”
“Do I make myself clear?”
Fang Heng nodded, indicating that he understood.
The sleeping pod of the Federation was the game method chosen by the vast majority of ordinary players.
After entering the sleeping pod, the player only needed to log in once a month and would not be affected by satiety.
The prerequisite was that the player needed to satisfy the game’s designated log-in time and had enough Federation coins to rent the sleeping pod.
“Any other questions?”
“Wait a moment, is there an apocalypse merchant camp nearby?”
“What are you going to do there?”

The Federation soldier looked at Fang Heng in surprise. Without waiting for his reply, he shook his head and said, “Forget it, it’s not important. Go along Road No. 102 on the right, you’ll see it soon.”
“Thank you.”
After watching the Federation soldier leave, Fang Heng turned around and looked at the overall layout of the temporary shelter hut.
The hut was allocated for multiple people to live in. There were a few simple beds in the corners, and a few players were sitting around and whispering to each other.
When the players saw Fang Heng, they looked at him at the same time.
“Another new face is here.”
A tall and thin young man waved at Fang Heng as a greeting.
His eyes were somewhat scrutinizing.
“New. I don’t think I’ve seen you before.”

Fang Heng spread his hands and walked towards the circle of players and sat with them. He said very casually, “I don’t have any money. I was chased out by other shelters. I came here to try my luck with the Federation.”
“Tch, don’t even think about it. The people of the Federation won’t give us civilians a way out.”
“Those hypocrites who talk about freedom and equality, but they won’t even give us shelter...”
Fang Heng had been in the Federation’s ‘refugee area’ when he was at his most down and out. He knew these people very well.
In reality, they were all poor or unemployed people. They couldn’t afford to spend 50 Federation coins a month to rent a sleeping pod.

Some of them were black account holders with criminal records, or because of some special reasons, they didn’t pass the Federation’s real name certification test and couldn’t enter the shelter to live.
The few of them chatted all over the place, venting their dissatisfaction with the Federation.
Fang Heng joined in and cursed a few times, becoming familiar with this group of people.
“Right, have you heard of meteorites?”
After getting familiar with them, Fang Heng tried to sniff out the topics related to meteorites.
“Meteorites? What are those? Rare ores?”
“You should be talking about the Meteorite Technology Group. Aren’t they all dead?”
Without any surprise, these people were all dumbfounded when they heard about meteorites and gave some invalid information.
Fang Heng was not disappointed.
He had expected this.
Fang Heng planned to rest here for the night.
One night was enough for all the zombie clones to resurrect, and then create a batch of proliferators.
After all, District 5 was an old district that had been open for decades, and there were even players above Level 10 in it.
The danger level was much higher than in District 7 and District 8.
One might encounter a person along the way who could pull out a shotgun and shoot him.

With the zombie team, he would have an extra layer of protection. The next day, he would head to the apocalypse merchant camp to look for the Dark Knights and find out about the first-generation meteorite from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - Stealing Ores?
paragraphs: After cursing the Federation with the refugee players for a while, Fang Heng decided to just leave a simple bed on the spot.
He was going to get some books to read in the game.

Fang Heng went online and offline every 20 minutes and returned to Mo Yunxiao’s study in the backyard. He casually flipped through a book related to occultism and put it into his warp backpack slot. He was not tired of it and brought it into the game time and time again.
“Mr Fang Heng, you are...”
It was not until the tenth time that Mr Sun, the housekeeper’s assistant in the villa, finally could not hold it in anymore.
He watched Fang Heng go back and forth in Mo Yunxiao’s study.
Mr Sun was a little confused.
This was too strange...
The ancestors of the Mo Family had set a rule that the books in the study could be borrowed, but they could not be taken out of the study.
Mr Sun also did not sense the existence of the books from Fang Heng.
“Hahaha, it’s nothing. It’s my habit. I like to walk around more when my heart is not calm.”
Fang Heng was wearing a short-sleeved shirt. Mr Sun could see through it at a glance if he was hiding any books on his body.
Mr Sun could only shake his head, secretly saying that he could not understand the young people of today.
At the Federation’s Zombie Apocalypse, District 5 United Front headquarters.
The lights were bright.
The atmosphere in the combat conference room was heavy.
The commander of the United Front, Qian Yuan, who was wearing a military uniform, sat on a chair and rubbed his temples.
Four hours ago, the spatial rift sensing device in District 5 detected a high-intensity spatial fluctuation.
Qian Yuan immediately called for an emergency combat conference.
The door was pushed open and a Federation soldier entered in a hurry.
“Reporting, sir! We have completed the location of the spatial fluctuation. We have confirmed that the fluctuation point is near Shelter No. 2.”
“We can not confirm what kind of space tearing passage it is. The fluctuation level is about Level 8.”
Shelter No. 2?!
The high-ranking officers of the four Federation shelters under the Federation’s Zombie Apocalypse’s District 5 were discussing in low voices.
During this period, similar blurry spatial transmission signals had occurred in District 5.
Because the signals were too blurry, it had been impossible to pinpoint them.
Combined with the information gathered through various channels, all kinds of signs indicated that someone was secretly preparing to attack District 5.
Qian Yuan had specifically strengthened the defenses of District 5.
However, the enemy had always been very stealthy.
Only today, the transmission signal was extremely obvious.
Why?
Why didn’t they conceal the signal as usual?
After discussing with the other officers of District 5’s shelter, Qian Yuan and the other officers came to a unified answer.
It wasn’t that they didn’t conceal it, but that they couldn’t do it!
The fluctuation was beyond the range of the concealable signal!
In other words, the original spatial fluctuation should have been far above Level 8!
It was the people from the anti-federal organization who were preparing to take action!
Shelter No. 2 was one of the largest shelters in District 5. Not only did it store large amounts of materials and resources, but it also had a total of 30,000 sleeping pods in use.
Among them, there were some important Federation politicians.
Qian Yuan said in a deep voice, “Shelter No. 2 has entered a Tier 1 alert state. Everyone to be on standby.”
“Yes!”
The Federation moved quickly.
The night had set, and darkness fell.
Fang Heng went online again.
In the temporary shelter, most players were able to go offline. Only seven or eight players were still gathered in front of the bonfire, discussing something in a low voice.
Noticing that Fang Heng had suddenly gone online, a circle of players looked at him warily.
The tall and thin player from before did not sleep either. He asked, “Brother, why aren’t you resting at this time of night?”
Fang Heng recognized him. His name was Zuo Qing.
“Don’t talk about it. I still have to go to work tomorrow. I have to go online for some time.”

Fang Heng pretended to be bitter as he cursed, “F*ck the Federation. They’re pressuring us, migrant workers. Recently, the rent has increased again. I don’t know when I’ll be able to get the down payment.”
When everyone heard this, the vigilance in their eyes lessened a little and they began to curse the Federation.
Similar situations were common in the game.
The game had the protection of the Federation. Players could get free food as the bare minimum for survival but they couldn’t use the sleeping pods for free.
Therefore, many low-level players would choose to work during the day and enter the game at night. They would directly rest in the game, and at the same time, they could kill time.
Even though doing this would make them feel tired when they went offline the next day, at least it would not delay their work.
Fang Heng chatted with the others, then opened the game log and glanced at it.
There were less than ten minutes left and the zombie clones were about to resurrect.
Fang Heng did not want to attract attention, so he prepared to run outside and find a hidden place to summon the zombie team.
“No, it’s too stuffy here. I have to go out for a walk.”
Fang Heng stood up and walked toward the door.
A player said, “It’s late. It’s not safe outside. Better not to go out.”
“It’s okay. I’ll just wander around the area.”
Fang Heng pushed the door open and walked out of the temporary shelter.
The players sitting in front of the bonfire looked at each other.
“I’ll handle it.”
Zuo Qing stood up and chased after Fang Heng who had walked out of the hut.

Outside the hut, Fang Heng was walking along a small path away from the shelter. He had planned to stay far away and find a place to summon his zombie team. At the same time, he could also explore the way.
Suddenly, he raised his head and noticed something.
“Eh? What’s that?”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
At night, the visibility outside was not high. However, through the night vision skill of the vampire bloodline, Fang Heng still noticed a group of players walking down the mountain.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and carefully sized up the group of players.
From the mining area above, there were a few players working together to push the boxes from a certain distance.
They transported the boxes to a temporary shelter hut at the foot of the mountain not far away.
Why did they have to transport materials at night?
Moreover, their movements looked very sneaky. There was no lighting during the entire process, and they kept quiet as much as possible, trying not to make any noise.
What made Fang Hen even more curious was that they were not wearing the Federation’s standard clothing, but they were all wearing black masks.
They were not ordinary players!
Could it be that they were stealing ores?
While he was in doubt, Fang Heng keenly sensed that someone was approaching from behind.
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head.
A tall and thin man stood behind him.
His face was also covered with a black mask.
“Fang Heng, don’t be nervous, it’s me.”
Zuo Qing laughed and lifted the mask on his face. He walked over and handed Fang Heng a gold nugget the size of a fingernail.
“Brother, do me a favor and pretend you didn’t see anything.”
Fang Heng took the gold nugget.
Item: Small gold nugget.
Description: A rare currency in the apocalypse. You can use it to exchange for food and consumables of equal value in the apocalypse merchant camp.
Description: A special high-value item. It will definitely drop after death.
“Are you guys stealing the ores?”
“Shh.”
Zuo Qing put on his black mask again and gestured to Fang Heng to be quiet.
“Brother, don’t be too loud. We’re just trying to make a living. It’s not easy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - Alert
paragraphs: How dare they steal from the Federation’s mines?
With a thought, Fang Heng immediately noticed the problem.
Something was wrong!

If they were caught stealing from the mines of a large guild, they would at most die. However, stealing from the Federation’s mines would be considered a crime! They would face the risk of being wanted by the Federation.
Why would they take such a huge risk to steal from the Federation’s mines?
Or could it be that there were some high-value minerals in the mines above?

Moreover, the Federation had done a good job protecting the mines. The reason why they were able to steal from the mines without making a sound was most likely because they had planted spies within the Federation.
It was too difficult for ordinary players to do this.
Fang Heng concealed the doubt in his heart and put on a joyful expression.
He put away the gold nugget and winked at Zuo Qing.
“Hehe, Brother, you’re too kind. Call me if you need help. I can help.”
Zuo Qing patted Fang Heng’s shoulder and said, “We can make money together. I’ll call you if I need help.”
“Okay, I’ll go there for a walk.”
Zuo Qing frowned. He didn’t want Fang Heng to stay outside, so he said, “It’s not convenient outside. Come back with me.”
“It’s okay. I’ll be back soon.”
Seeing that the time for the zombie clone’s rebirth was almost up, Fang Heng prepared to go and settle the zombie clone first.
“That’s good. Be careful. Don’t go too far.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng turned and took two steps forward. Suddenly, he heard the sound of air being cut behind him.
“Bang!”
Zuo Qing, who had launched a sneak attack, was shocked.
Fang Heng grabbed Zuo Qing’s right wrist with one hand.
The iron rod stopped in mid-air.
Zuo Qing instinctively wanted to pull his arm back, but he found that his right hand was tightly held by Fang Heng.
How could it be?
Zuo Qing’s heart instantly stirred up a storm.
His level was already Level 9. He had also learned strength training skills and special equipment with the strength attribute. His strength points had already reached a terrifying 10.7!
How could an ordinary player be so much stronger than him in terms of strength!?
In the next moment, Zuo Qing realized that a huge fist was coming towards him.
“Bang!”
Zuo Qing’s chest was hit by Fang Heng’s fist!
“Crack crack...”
Zuo Qing heard the sound of his ribs breaking, and his body flew backwards uncontrollably.
“Bang!”
He flew three meters away and landed on his back on the ground.
His survival instinct made Zuo Qing struggle to straighten his body and stare at Fang Heng.
He felt as if his chest had been hit by a big rock and it hurt terribly.
“You are definitely not an ordinary person. Who are you?”
“I refuse to answer.”
Fang Heng chuckled and walked toward Zuo Qing.
“I should be the one asking the questions. Who are you? Who asked you to do this?”
“Don’t come over!”
Zuo Qing gritted his teeth. Because of the pain, his forehead was covered in a layer of cold sweat!
Seeing Fang Heng approaching, Zuo Qing immediately took out a shotgun from his backpack and aimed the muzzle at Fang Heng.
“I told you to stay where you are!”
Zuo Qing did not want to shoot.
At night, the gunshots would attract the attention of the nearby Federation shelter and disrupt their mining plan.
Fang Heng also stopped and stared at Zuo Qing.
At such a close distance, Fang Heng believed that he did not have a 100% chance of successfully avoiding the range of the shotgun.
For a moment, both of them froze on the spot.
Zuo Qing’s throat rolled.
He was about to say something when a mechanical alarm sounded around the shelter.
“Alert! Alert! Alert!”
“Shelter is on Tier 1 alert! All non-combatants, please remain in the room!”
“Alert! Aert!”
Fang Heng and Zuo Qing were shocked when they heard the alert!
They turned their heads to look in the direction of the shelter.
Zuo Qing was extremely shocked.
It was an alert issued by the Federation’s shelter.
Could it be that the theft of the mine was exposed?
“Did you do it?”
Zuo Qing turned his head and stared at Fang Heng.
His chest hurt so much that he gritted his teeth every time he said a word.
“Who are you?”
Fang Heng looked at Zuo Qing and shook his head. “No, it has nothing to do with me.”
Zuo Qing’s eyes flashed with surprise.
The next moment, he saw several strange red alchemy magic arrays appear under Fang Heng’s feet.
The magic arrays spun rapidly.
“Chi! Chi Chi!”
Several red shadows suddenly darted out from the magic arrays, leaving a series of rustling sounds in the air.
What the hell was that!
Zuo Qing was shocked.
With just a thought, the red shadow that darted out from the magic array had already approached Zuo Qing.
It was the Licker!
Zuo Qing recognized the red creature!
The Licker reflected in his eyes zoomed in quickly!
At the critical moment of life and death, Zuo Qing pulled the trigger without hesitation.
“Boom!!”
The charging Licker was hit head-on by the shotgun.
The huge impact caused the Licker to fall back.
However, the remaining two Lickers pounced on Zuo Qing at an even faster speed, one on the left and one on the right.
“Chi!!”
The sharp claws cut Zuo Qing’s head.
[Hint: You have killed a player. You have received guillotine skill experience points +12.]
Dead.
Fang Heng glanced at the corpse on the ground.
The magic arrays continued to revolve beneath his feet and 35 Lickers crawled out of the magic arrays one by one.
The surrounding muddy ground also began to churn.
Rotten palms stretched out from the ground.
This time, Fang Heng only controlled a total of 100 vine zombies to commit suicide and enter District 5.
Fang Heng walked to the corpse and confiscated Zuo Qing’s shotgun.
After thinking for a while, he took off the mask that Zuo Qing wore on his face.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Lickers swarmed over crazily and gnawed at Zuo Qing’s corpse.
Fang Heng stood still and looked in the direction of the mining area not far away.
The players who had been moving the ore boxes down from the mountainside immediately left the boxes on the spot when they heard the alert, scattering like birds and beasts.
Teams of well-equipped Federation players came out of the shelter, driving motorcycles and trucks toward the mining area.
In the temporary shelter he had just stayed in, a few familiar players also ran out and fled for their lives in the dark.
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
He felt that this matter was not simple.
In order to hide his identity, he put on Zuo Qing’s mask.
First, he wanted to see what was in those boxes!
Fang Heng walked toward the temporary shelter hut at the foot of the mountain.
When he arrived in front of the hut, Fang Heng found that the door of the hut was locked by a chain.
To save time, Fang Heng aimed the shotgun at the wooden door around the chain.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
With a few gunshots, the shotgun blew a hole in the wooden door.
Fang Heng raised his fist and smashed the door into pieces.
He pushed the door open and entered.
There were more than ten boxes in the room.
Fang Heng walked to one of the boxes.
He opened the box and a faint blue light shone out.
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed into slits.
Crystal?
The crystal was emitting a faint blue light.
Blue crystal raw ore?!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He picked up a crystal and examined it.
Item: Blue crystal raw ore.
Level: Normal.
Description: A special ore that contains powerful energy. It seems to require special smelting to activate this energy.
Is it really blue crystal raw ore??
Fang Heng exclaimed in surprise.
The box was actually full of blue crystal raw ores!

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - Porter
paragraphs: In District 8, the production of blue crystal raw ores was extremely low.
There was a large amount of blue crystal raw ores in this place?!
Zuo Qing and the others were trying to steal the Federation’s blue crystal raw ores?
Just as Fang Heng was puzzled, a game hint flashed across his vision.
[Hint: Due to your skill-basic occult (Level 2), you can perform a preliminary occult analysis of the blue crystal raw ore.]
[Hint: You can spend 100 survival points to analyze the blue crystal raw ore (normal). Do you want to analyze it?]
F*ck!
Again?
D*mn it, he had already been cheated of the divine potion last time, and now they want to cheat him again?
Fang Heng decided to ignore it first and waved his hand.
The ore was put into his backpack.
About a third of the blue crystal ores in the box were swept away in an instant.

According to the game’s settings, although the same type of ore only occupied a single backpack slot, if the weight-bearing of the ore in the player’s backpack exceeded a certain limit, the player would receive an additional weight-bearing penalty of more than ten times.
The more you load, the greater the negative penalty effect.
Fang Heng had the shelter’s super backpack skill and the additional weight-bearing due to his high basic physical strength.
His backpack was much larger than an ordinary player’s, so he could hold about a third of the blue crystal raw ores in one go.
If it was an ordinary player, they would only be able to fit less than a tenth of a box of blue crystal raw ores.
Fang Heng’s eyes flashed with greed.
Blue crystal raw ores!
Good stuff!
They could directly be made into blue energy crystals.
That was a necessary energy source to activate the space tearing device!
In addition, it was also an indispensable part of the ‘Fatten up Project’!
The crystallized worm obtained its upgrade by devouring the blue crystal raw ores.
Fang Heng would never complain about having too many of these things!
He had to think of a way to take them all away.
Fang Heng pondered for a moment, then through the window, he glanced at the mining area that was in chaos outside.
The Federation army team had already arrived at the mining area halfway up the mountain.
It seemed that they would be able to clean up the mining area very soon.
It would still take some time for them to search this place.
How should he hide all these blue crystal ores?
The speed of the zombies moving them was too slow. There was no time at all.
Who cares!
He would take as much as he could!
Fang Heng immediately switched the blue crystal ores in his backpack into the warp backpack slot, leaving more than a dozen Lickers hiding in the temporary shelter.
Leaving a simple bed on the spot, Fang Heng went offline.
Offline.
Opening the game cabin, Fang Heng appeared in the villa’s guest room.
He didn’t have time to find a place to store the blue crystal raw ores!
He could encounter danger at any time in the game.
Fang Heng directly took out the ores from his backpack and threw them in the guest room.
Clearing his backpack, Fang Heng opened the game cabin and entered the game again.
The entire process was smooth and fluid. It took less than five minutes.
With a wave of his hand, Fang Heng put another third of the blue crystal raw ores into his normal backpack slot.
Fang Heng secretly thought about his next move.
The time interval for using the warp backpack slot was 20 minutes.
The transportation efficiency was a little slow.
It would be great if he could expand a few more slots.
Or should they just let the zombie team dig a hole and bury them?
No, they didn’t have enough time. If they dug a hole on the spot, the traces would be too obvious, and the Federation would see through them at a glance.
While Fang Heng was thinking, the noise of footsteps and conversations suddenly came from outside the door.
“Quick, it’s right in front.”
“Bring the boxes!”
The footsteps quickly approached.
Someone was coming!
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and controlled the Lickers to climb to the ceiling, ready to attack.
“Eh? Why is the door broken?”
“Be careful, someone came in.”
The wooden door was pushed open with a bang, and a few black muzzles aimed at Fang Heng.
“It’s one of us!”
The bald leader noticed the mask on Fang Heng’s face and waved his hand to signal for everyone to put down their weapons.
He looked at Fang Heng and asked, “Why are you alone? Where’s Zuo Qing? Where are the others?”
Fang Heng was surprised for a moment and immediately understood.
The bald man had mistaken him for someone else.
It was the mask on his face!
The mask he took off Zuo Qing’s body made the bald man mistakenly think that he was with Zuo Qing.
Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to continue hiding in the shadows of the ceiling. He looked out of the window and said, “They heard the Federation alert and ran away.”
“D*mn it! I knew I couldn’t rely on that idiot!”
The bald man spat on the ground. He waved his hand, indicating for the people behind him to help move the boxes.
“Move the ores in first.”
“Quick, you come and help too.”
Fang Heng nodded, feeling puzzled.
The Federation had already come to find them, why didn’t the bald man and the others run away? Instead, they were taking the time to move these boxes?
Could it be that they had a way to move the boxes out?
Fang Heng’s heart stirred, and he slowly walked up to help everyone move the boxes filled with blue crystal raw ores into the temporary shelter hut.
Baldy walked to a corner of the room and fumbled around in the closet for a moment.
There was a slight sound.
The mechanism in the room was triggered and a wooden plank on the floor in the corner of the room was lifted.
It was a tunnel!
Fang Heng suddenly understood.
So that was how it was. It seemed that Zuo Qing’s group had used this tunnel to transport the stolen blue crystal raw ores out of the shelter.
“Quick, don’t just stand there. Move all the ores into the underground passage first.”
Fang Heng licked his lips and thought that this was interesting.
There were already close to twenty large boxes in the shelter. Together with the boxes that Baldy and his group had moved all the way here, there were more than thirty boxes in total.
The players’ physical strength was limited. They were already panting heavily from moving more than ten boxes in from outside.
A player wearing a mask was a little nervous. He looked out of the window and whispered to Baldy, “Boss Cao, move all of them in? Will it be too late?”
“What are you afraid of!”

Baldy glared at the person behind him. “They will buy us time. We just need to move the materials into the tunnel. We will get 100,000 for each box we move. You can decide whether you want to earn this money or not!”
Cao Zhengde cursed in a low voice. Everyone heard a commotion from the outside.
Then, gunshots were heard.
They were fighting?
Fang Heng was confused and he stuck his head out to check.
What was that?
Fang Heng was surprised to find that a wave of zombies was spawning.
A large number of high-level zombies were attacking the Federation’s shelter.
After a rough scan, Fang Heng found that there was at least five Tier 4 one-eyed zombies among them!
How could it be so coincidental?
It was not normal for so many zombies to suddenly appear!
They were also controlled by a player?
When the shelter was attacked, the Federation immediately recalled the players who were maintaining order in the mining area and rushed back to the shelter to provide support.
“Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!”
The shelter was equipped with a high-intensity beam weapon.
Streaks of pale red light streaked across the night sky, piercing holes in the one-eyed zombie’s body.
Dense artillery weapons were fired crazily at the zombie horde.
The continuous artillery fire lit up more than half of the night sky.
A large number of Tier 4 mutated zombies brought great trouble to the Federation.
Those people were most likely part of the anti-federation forces.
They must have used some method to attract the zombie horde to attack the Federation shelter!

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - Exploded Again
paragraphs: Seeing this, Cao Zhengde said excitedly, “Good! Night Owl’s people must have come to help. Quick, let’s transport the ores out together.”
The players’ spirits were also raised and they worked together to transport the boxes down the passage.
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed slightly and a phrase unconsciously appeared in his mind.
Taking advantage of the situation!
Wouldn’t it be nice to fish blue crystal raw ores every 20 minutes?
He would first infiltrate this group of people and get them to help transport the ores back to the tunnel!
Fang Heng chose to remain discreet and let them think he was part of the team. He silently joined Cao Zhengde’s group.
Under the urging of Baldy Cao Zhengde, he and another player, who was also wearing a mask, picked up the boxes and put them into the trolley. They pushed the trolley into the underground passage.
The passage was very dark. Only the candlelight on the wall gave off a weak light.
After walking along the artificially created underground passage for a while, a temporary storage area appeared in front of them.
There were more than thirty boxes left in the storage area.
Fang Heng estimated that these boxes should have been transported out tonight and had not been sent out yet.
After going back and forth a few times, everyone finally moved all the boxes in the shelter back to the underground storage area.
The long-distance transportation exhausted the players’ remaining vitality.
A player sat down on the ground and waved his hand, saying, “We really can’t move anymore, Boss Cao.”
Cao Zhengde saw that everyone else also sat down with their backs against the boxes to rest, and he knew that he couldn’t force them to continue.
“Forget it, everyone, let’s rest first.”
Cao Zhengde turned on the survival radio on the spot and contacted the Night Owl organization.
He received a reply and then randomly selected a few players.
“Kunzi, Ah Gui, Xiaoqi, you guys come with me. The rest of you stay here and look after the boxes. Rest for a while and wait for me to come back.”
After saying that, Cao Zhengde brought the few players that had been selected and quickly left through the passage on the other side.
The remaining players sat on the ground one by one and took out some bread to eat, seizing the time they had left to recover their strength.
Fang Heng was happy to stay.
Tonight was a sleepless night!
Just in time, 20 minutes had arrived.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, he scooped up another batch of blue crystal raw ores and returned to the real world.
The lights in the temporary storage room were very dim.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Fang Heng was preparing to quietly hide away from the players and find an opportunity to go offline on the spot.
“Everyone, I’ll speak.”
A middle-aged man wearing a mask suddenly clapped his hands, attracting the attention of the players.
“I, Ni Tonghui, have been in the game for more than thirty years. Up until now, I haven’t earned much money, but I have figured out a way to survive.”
The middle-aged man’s voice was unusually hoarse. Under the gaze of many players, he slowly extended a finger.
“If you don’t do it for yourself, the heavens will destroy you.”
“Your life is your own. Everyone knows how much this life is worth. However, I feel that no matter what, we have to think for ourselves and leave a way out. Don’t you guys agree?”
Fang Heng was stunned. He did not understand what he meant.

Another player immediately echoed, “Master Hui is right. Let’s keep this among ourselves. If we have money, we can earn it together. If anyone tries to stab us in the back, I, Lin Ah-er, will be the first to kill him.”
“Brothers, I’ve asked around. This thing is called the blue crystal raw ore. It’s very valuable in the black market. It’s just a little troublesome to sell it. We should at least bring some with us.”
As the middle-aged man spoke, he stood up from where he was. He opened the box and took the lead to put the blue crystal raw ores into his backpack.
Fang Heng immediately came to a realization.
What a good guy. After talking for so long and laying the groundwork for so long, the result was to trick everyone into stealing the ores together, right?!
One look and one could tell that these people were all unorganized and undisciplined ordinary refugee players.
“Master Hui is right! Whoever plays dirty behind the scenes will be making things difficult for all of us!”
The other players also reacted one by one and stuffed the raw blue crystal ores into their backpacks until they filled up the entire backpack.
The smart player began to pick and choose. One by one, they carefully selected high-level ores and stuffed them into their backpack.
Some players were not satisfied and cleared out the miscellaneous items in their backpacks to store more ores.
Fang Heng shook his head and thought to himself, in this world, even stealing ores could be so competitive that it was starting to roll up, right?
Taking advantage of the time when the players were stealing ores, Fang Heng found a dark corner and quietly threw down a simple bed.
After spending five minutes moving the ores back to the guest room in the real world, Fang Heng went online again.
The other players did not notice Fang Heng going online and offline.
After stealing the ores, everyone acted as if nothing had happened and sat down to rest. Some of them gathered in groups of two or three and discussed something in a low voice.
Baldy Cao Zhengde had not returned since he left with his people.
Fang Heng casually opened a box beside him and put a third of the blue crystal raw ores into his backpack.
He imitated the other players and sat down with his back against a box to rest.
He wondered how the Federation players were doing.
And the Night Owl organization.
Could they control the zombies as well?
While thinking, Fang Heng took out a blue crystal raw ore and played with it.
Since he had nothing to do, he could use occultism to analyze the blue crystal and use it to farm basic occult experience points.
With a thought, the game hint refreshed on Fang Heng’s retina once again.
[Hint: Due to your skill-basic occult (Level 2), you can perform a preliminary occult analysis on the blue crystal raw ore.]
[Hint: You can spend 100 survival points to analyze the blue crystal raw ore (normal quality). Do you want to analyze it?]
“Analyze.”
Buzz...
The blue crystal raw ore was pulled by a force and it rose from Fang Heng’s palm and floated in the air.
Fang Heng had already experienced something similar before. This time, he was no longer surprised.
He quietly raised his head and looked at the crystal in the air.
However, the next second, the row of game hints gave Fang Heng a shock.

[Hint: Through basic occult (Level 2), you have conducted occult testing on the blue crystal raw ore. No spiritual energy, no mental energy, no creature fluctuations have been found in the blue crystal raw ore.]
[Hint: Medium-strength concentrated natural energy found in the blue crystal raw ore.]
[Hint: Player has a skill-occult ritual (binding soul seal) and can absorb natural energy.]
What was going on?
Natural energy? Can be absorbed?
Before Fang Heng had time to check the hint, the blue crystal raw ore in the air began to tremble slightly.
At this moment, a thought suddenly appeared in Fang Heng’s mind.
Could it be that it was going to explode again?
“Bang!!!”
A muffled explosion sounded.
The blue crystal raw ore exploded in the air.
The sound wasn’t loud, but it was exceptionally clear in the quiet temporary underground storage area.
The ore exploded?
Almost all the players heard the sound of the ore explosion.
They all had strange expressions on their faces as they looked in Fang Heng’s direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - Natural Energy
paragraphs: Fang Heng did not notice the gazes of the other players.
All his attention was focused on the blue crystal raw ore.
After the blue crystal raw ore exploded, it left specks of blue powder in the air.
The powder formed the shape of a basic occult rune.
After reading the entire ‘Occult Guide’, the meaning of this rune immediately appeared in Fang Heng’s mind.
It represented the most basic natural energy of occult.
After the rune was maintained for half a second, the blue powder fell from the sky.
Fang Heng suddenly felt the back of his hand itchy.
He subconsciously raised his hand to take a look.
The rune mark on the back of his hand showed a faint light.
The blue specks were absorbed by the rune mark on the back of his hand.

Skill: Low-efficiency energy storage (can be detonated).

Skill description 1: Player can absorb various forms of energy through the occult ritual and store the energy in the occult imprint, current conversion efficiency is extremely low (conversion efficiency and maximum stored energy upper limit are related to the level of the occult ritual and the level of basic occult).

Skill description 2: Player can instantly release all stored energy in the imprint and trigger an energy explosion, causing a large amount of damage to the area, this damage was related to the imprint’s current stored energy intensity and the level of the occult ritual (damage ignored friend or foe). If the energy value during the explosion was greater than a certain limit, there was a probability of triggering an energy vortex. Skill cooldown time: 48 hours.
[Hint: You have tested the blue crystal raw ore for the first time. You have obtained skill-basic occult experience points +43.]
[Hint: You have absorbed the energy of the blue crystal raw ore. Current energy storage: 0.2%.]
Fang Heng looked at the long skill description and roughly understood.
From the perspective of occultism, the blue crystal raw ore contained powerful natural energy.
Coincidentally, the occult ritual rune on the back of his hand could absorb this energy.
His body became a container.
Just by looking at the skill description, he needed to absorb a large number of blue crystal ores before using the skill once.
He didn’t know the actual effect.
After all, the blue crystals made from blue crystal ores had extremely strong energy, and they could even create a spatial rift.
It shouldn’t be too weak.
It was just that this method of using energy was too crude.
Simply absorbing and detonating.
Was it equivalent to using one’s own body as a medium?
“Cough, cough.” Ni Tonghui could not help but cough lightly. “Brother, what’s the situation?”
Fang Heng returned to his senses. Only then did he realize that the surrounding players were all looking at him with inquisitive gazes.
“Uh, I don’t know either. I don’t know how it exploded.”
Everyone became even more confused and looked at each other.
This thing could explode?
They had been smuggling ores here for more than ten days, but this was the first time they had heard of ores that could explode.
“I was also shocked. The crystal just now was a little different. It was especially bright. I thought it was some good stuff...”
Fang Heng explained casually, trying to deceive them.
Although everyone had doubts, they did not continue to investigate further.
Ni Tonghui looked at Fang Heng and said, “I don’t think I’ve seen you before.”
“I joined not long ago. I was with Zuo Qing. They all ran fast, leaving me alone.”
“Zuo Qing ran really fast.”
Fang Heng tried to find out what was going on with the zombies outside. “By the way, do you know what happened to those zombies outside? Was it the employer? Why did they make such a big commotion?”
“I don’t know. Brother, I advise you not to ask too much. It’s good that you have the money. The more you know about this kind of thing, the faster you’ll die.”
While they were talking, they heard footsteps coming from the front.
The two immediately stopped talking.
Cao Zhengde brought the three people back together.
Their faces didn’t look good.
“What’s wrong, Boss Cao? Was there a problem?”

“D*mn, Night Owl’s people don’t keep their word. They say that we caused too much of a ruckus and attracted the Federation’s attention. They’re only willing to give us a third of our wages, and they even want us to think of a way to move the ores from the mining area on the mountain.”
“F*ck!”
“What bullsh*t Night Owl! Aren’t they worse than the Federation?”
“F*ck!”
“They want us to go back to the mining area? Does he f*cking want us to die?”
“They should be punished for their carelessness! It’s clearly their fault that the Federation discovered us!”
The players were both angry and afraid.
The Federation had already discovered that someone was stealing the mines outside. If they were to go to the mining area now, wouldn’t that be courting death?
“Pui!”
Cao Zhengde spat on the ground with a vicious expression.
“Brothers, the people outside are all Night Owl’s men. I won’t hide it from you. There are only two paths in front of us.”
“We can either go back the way we came and escape through the entrance and run as many as we can. We can consider this operation as a mistake.”
“Or we can trust Night Owl one last time.”
“Night Owl’s men have said that they have temporarily taken control of the mining area. The people of the Federation are also attacked by the zombie horde and have no time to deal with us.”
“There are still many high-quality blue crystal raw ores in the mining area. They really need people to transport the ores from the mountain.”

“There are still a few trucks that are locked in the mining area that can be used. Night Owl’s people have promised to give us five million Federation coins as long as we can transport a cart of high-quality ores down the mountain. At that time, we will split it with them.”
Hearing five million, everyone’s eyes immediately lit up. They had completely forgotten how they had reprimanded Night Owl just now.
One cart already had five million. What if they could transport a few more carts?
After doing this job, they would be able to lie down comfortably for the rest of their lives. They would no longer have to risk their lives.
After Cao Zhengde said that, he looked around.
He saw pairs of hungry eyes.
“Brothers, what do you say?”
“Let’s do it!”
“Of course, let’s do it once!”
“Since we might not be able to escape now, we might as well do it ruthlessly!”
“Don’t ask. If anyone asks, we’ll take him down...”
Fang Heng looked at the unusually excited players and felt that it was funny.
They had been fooled by Night Owl’s people for less than a minute. How could they have forgotten about it in the blink of an eye? Why were they still in a hurry to continue working with Night Owl?
Weren’t they afraid of being tricked again?

Cao Zhengde nodded. “That’s fine. The problem now is that a few trucks in the mining area have been locked. Forcefully opening the lock will damage the trucks. Who knows about high-level car maintenance?”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
He thought to himself that this was fine.
The ores in the mining area were all high-level blue crystal raw ores.
They could head up the mountain and get more high-level goods that he could bring home!
When the Federation was almost done fighting, he would directly snatch a mining truck and run away.
He didn’t care about the fight between Night Owl and the Federation. He wanted to make a profit first!
After secretly making up his mind, Fang Heng stood out and said, “I know a bit of lock-opening skills. Talent skill and mechanical maintenance. I can help.”
“Okay!”
Cao Zhengde’s eyes lit up. “You come with me too. When the time comes, I will definitely treat you well and give you an extra sum of money.”

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - Tier 5 Mutated Zombie
paragraphs: At this moment, the Federation’s command hall was bustling with activity.
After receiving the warning from the command centre of Zombie Apocalypse District 5, the chief commander of the shelter, Li Dahai, immediately ordered a secret inspection of the entire shelter.
Soon, they discovered that someone was secretly stealing ores from the mining area at night.
The blue crystal raw ores!
Due to some special reasons, District 5 had yet to create a teleportation device, so the usage rate of the blue crystal raw ores was very low.
And this blue crystal mine was the largest in the entire District 5.
Even in the Zombie Apocalypse server, this blue crystal mine was the largest!
This directly caused a lot of blue crystals to be stored in the mine, and they couldn’t be used up in a short time.
Li Dahai immediately issued an order to arrest.
However, he didn’t expect that the anti-federation forces had infiltrated the mining area and the shelter to such an extent.
A large number of zombies attacked the shelter.
They had to transfer the soldiers from the mining area back to help protect the shelter, in case the entire shelter was attacked by zombies.
“Report! We have confirmed that the mastermind of this operation is Sikong Mao.”

“Sikong Mao, an S-level wanted man of the Federation, one of the core figures of the Night Owl organization. He has participated in many anti-federation terrorist operations. He has an S-level talent and has undergone an S-level talent upgrade.”
“Based on the information we have so far, we believe that Sikong Mao’s talent skill is the ability to control some low-level intelligent life forms into a rage state and divert their hatred.”
“This ability is especially effective against zombies, especially in the Zombie Apocalypse world. Therefore, Sikong Mao has been active in the Zombie Apocalypse game.”
“Currently, the zombie horde outside the shelter should be under Sikong Mao’s special control.”
“Night Owl organization has put some high-level zombies into hibernation in advance. After that, Sikong Mao will wake them up and divert their aggro, so that they can attack our shelter.”
“There are many screaming zombies mixed in the zombie horde. Their special shrieking ability can attract more zombies nearby and cause a small zombie horde in the outside world.”
As they were talking, a huge black shadow appeared on the screen of the hall.
Seeing that shadow, the faces of the people in the command centre darkened.
It was the giant zombie!
A Tier 5 mutant-Giant!
Just like his name, the giant zombie was seven meters tall!
There were three of them!
The giant zombie walked with heavy steps towards the shelter.
“Night Owl...”
Li Dahai whispered.
It was difficult for the Federation to put a Tiere 5 mutated zombie into temporary hibernation.
And the Night Owl organization put three of them into hibernation at once!
Were they putting all their eggs in one basket?
However, three Tier 5 mutated zombies could only bring a heavy blow to the shelter. It was impossible to destroy the shelter.
Night Owl should be clear about this.
Why did they do this?
Li Dahai frowned.
He recalled that someone had been found stealing ores in the mining area.
Was it for the blue crystal raw ore?
Night Owl’s goal was the blue crystal mine?
That did not seem right. What did they want the blue crystal mine for?
“Sir, the giant zombies have entered the attack range.”

Li Dahai did not continue thinking about Night Owl. He spoke in a low voice, “Confirm authorization. Use high-tier energy beam weapons. Aim at the giant zombies and attack. Do not let them get close to the shelter.”
“Yes!”
Facing the attacks of three Tier 5 zombies, the entire command hall was extremely nervous.
Halfway up the mountain, in the Federation mining area.
Fang Heng was also shocked by the three giant zombies at the foot of the mountain.
They were both Tier 5 creatures, but the worm creature from before did not look as shocking as the giant zombies.
The giant zombies were already taller than the city walls at the periphery of the Federation’s shelter.
The strength of the Federation’s shelter was not to be underestimated.
More than twenty high-energy light cannon turrets fired continuously.
The giant zombies were unable to get any closer.
“Brother, how is it? Can it work?”
Cao Zhengde was anxious and could not help but urge.
Fang Heng looked away from the distance and continued to fiddle with the wire in his hand.
“It’s not a big problem. I can pry it open, but the success rate is not high. I still have to try a few more times.”
As he said this, the iron wire in Fang Heng’s hand emitted a faint ‘Pa da’ sound.
[Hint: You have used a skill to pick the lock on the military truck. The lock picking is successful. You have obtained lock picking experience points +22.]
“Look! It’s done!”
“Okay!”
Cao Zhengde was overjoyed when he saw this. He stuck his head out of the truck and shouted, “Brothers, the truck is done. Hurry! Move the goods!”
The morale of the players was greatly boosted. Upon hearing this, they began to move the materials behind the truck.

There were originally five military trucks in the mining area. Due to the previous battle in the mining area, two of the trucks were damaged and could not be used. The remaining three large trucks were also locked.
Fang Heng jumped down from the truck.
“There are still two trucks left. I need to recover my vitality before I can continue to use my skill to unlock.”
“Okay! Brother, it’s been hard on you. Go and rest. This time, I’ll remember your great contribution. When I get the money, I’ll give you a few more shares!”
Cao Zhengde did not suspect anything. He patted Fang Heng’s shoulder excitedly and hurriedly instructed the remaining players to move the ores.
“Quick! Hurry up! Go to Mine No. 3 to move the ores first.”
“Night Owl only wants the best quality blue crystal raw ores, or else they won’t pay!”
Very quickly, the players loaded a truck. Cao Zhengde personally drove the truck to move a batch of ores down the mountain.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Fang Heng walked to a corner.
Using the excuse of recovering his stamina, Fang Heng secretly observed the surrounding terrain of the mining area.
In District 5, the number of core members of the Night Owl organization was more than that of District 8.
Fang Heng counted carefully and found that there were a total of 12 Night Owl members.
They all wore special silver-white masks. Most of them held guns in their hands and guarded the periphery of each entrance. The remaining few were players who guarded the mines.
There were a total of eight mines in the entire mine area. The open-air mine was filled with large boxes filled with blue crystal raw ores.
Fang Heng casually walked to the side of a box and picked up an ore from the box.
Item: Blue crystal raw ore.
Quality: Low.
No wonder it was casually discarded. It turned out to be inferior.
Fang Heng exerted force with his hand.
“Crack!”
The blue crystal ore was easily crushed into powder by Fang Heng.
The lower the level of the blue crystal ore, the more impurities there were, and the easier it was to crush it.
A game hint appeared in the lower right corner of the retina.
[Hint: Through the occult ritual, you have absorbed a small amount of energy from the blue crystal raw ore. Current energy storage is 0.25%.]
Fang Heng felt that the people of the Federation seemed to be very rich. So many blue crystal ores had been casually discarded in the mining area, so the security was probably not tight.
No wonder they were targeted by Night Owl’s people.
Unfortunately, he was unable to bring all of these ores back to District 8.
Since he couldn’t bring them away, rather than being taken away by Night Owl’s people, he might as well use them himself.
Fang Heng followed the principle of not wasting them and began to crush the ores to absorb the natural energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - Finishing Blow
paragraphs: [Hint: You have absorbed a small amount of energy from the blue crystal raw ore. Current storage energy is 0.31%,]
[Hint: You have absorbed a small amount of energy from the blue crystal raw ore. Current storage energy is 0.34%...]
A low-tier ore could only provide 0.02% to 0.05% of energy.
Too little!
Then absorb more points!

The mining area was very large. The player was busy moving high-tier ores and did not have the time to care about others. Most of the members of the Night Owl organization were also guarding the outside of the mining area.
No one noticed Fang Heng, who was walking in the open mine area and crushing the blue crystal ores to absorb energy.
Seeing that the 20-minute cooldown time was up, Fang Heng quietly hid in a hidden corner of the mining area and threw down a sleeping bag on the spot.
Although it was very troublesome, every time he went offline, he would make a huge profit. Fang Heng was also very happy.
He went back and forth until he went offline for the eighth time.
Once again, he opened the game cabin and returned to the real world. Fang Heng frowned.
He suddenly realized a problem.
The room could not hold it anymore!
The raw ore was big to begin with.
The guest room was already filled with blue crystal raw ores. Even the bed was filled with blue crystal raw ores. If they continued to pile up, they would have to bury the game cabin.
It was late at night and Fang Heng had no way to find another place to store the ores.
Got it! He might as well just leave it there!
Fang Heng ran to the back garden and threw the blue crystal ores on the ground.
The three big trucks were repaired. Cao Zhengde was very satisfied with Fang Heng’s efficiency. He waved his hand to let Fang Heng rest.
The other players were also doing their best to move the materials to earn money.
No one cared about where Fang Heng went.
At this time, Fang Heng was leaning against a tree, hiding in everyone’s blind spot, observing the situation of the Federation shelter at the foot of the mountain.
“They fought for more than four hours.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“What a pity...”
Until now, Fang Heng finally understood what he could put in the warp backpack slot to bring back to District 5.
Live sample collector!
The strength of a Tier 5 giant zombie shocked Fang Heng.
The powerful defense displayed by the Federation’s shelter also shocked Fang Heng.
Such a powerful defense was not something that could be achieved overnight.
It required a large amount of materials, accumulated over many years!
If the prison shelter of Server 8 wanted to achieve such a defense, it would need more time to develop.
Fang Heng felt that as long as he had enough time, his shelter’s defense would definitely surpass it!
As he pondered, Fang Heng turned to look at the three Tier 5 giant zombies.
It was about time, after being bombarded by the high-energy beam weapon for 4 hours, the Tier 5 giant zombies were starting to show signs of fatigue.
They were about to die.
He needed to find an opportunity to lay his hands on them.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
He had been quietly observing the battle between the zombie horde and the Federation’s shelter.
He was secretly waiting for an opportunity to sneak up on them.
Tier 5 zombies would drop high-energy evolution crystals. To upgrade to Tier 4 space tearing device, he would require a lot of these things!
Fang Heng did not want to miss this good opportunity.
He could make a small profit!
Fang Heng opened the game log and remotely controlled the group of Lickers waiting at the side.
“You guys are tired after fighting for so long. Let me help you clean up the mess. We’re all old acquaintances. There’s no need to be polite...”
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
At the foot of the mountain.
Federation’s shelter.
The ground trembled slightly.
In the command center, Li Dahai was observing the situation outside through the screen.
The wall at the periphery had been smashed by the giant zombie.
This was a Tier 3 metal enhanced wall!
The giant zombie had broken through the periphery and entered the inner defense circle. It had also destroyed a large number of automatic turrets and sentry towers outside the shelter.
“Buzz...”
“Boom!!”
The light cannon turret gathered energy and fired again. The thick light cannon hit the giant zombie’s body.
The giant zombie was hit by the light cannon and flew backward. It fell heavily to the ground, leaving a bloody hole on its body.
The hole healed at a visible speed.
“Report the current situation.”

“The damage rate of the automatic turret is 73% and the usage rate of the laser energy turret is 90%. Three of the turrets are malfunctioning, and the remaining 27 are cooling down. The remaining energy of the light cannon turret is 29.7%, close to the warning line!”
Still a little bit.
Li Dahai stared at the screen.
The light cannon turret would overheat after a period of use. It had to wait for a period of time for it to cool down before it could attack.
Every time the energy was recharged, the giant zombies would take advantage of this period of time to cause a huge amount of damage to the shelter’s city defense.
With every punch, a large number of automatic turrets would be destroyed.
Fortunately, the HP of the three giant zombies was very low.
It could be seen from their slow movements.
It was estimated that after a few more rounds, the zombies would be completely killed.
The giant zombie supported its body with both hands and stood up. Once again, it walked toward the shelter.
It raised its fist and threw it at a sentry tower.
“Boom!”
The entire command room shook violently.
The HP of the sentry tower was almost depleted. It exploded and the ruined buildings burned violently.
The images captured by the surveillance camera made the high-ranking officers of the Federation look gloomy.
Judging from the current situation, they could win this battle.
However, winning was a pyrrhic victory.
After this battle was over, they would have to spend a lot of materials to rebuild the defense of the shelter.
“Eh?”
Suddenly, a Federation soldier noticed something and said, “Eh?”.
“What’s wrong?”
“Sir, we found an anomaly!”
The Federation soldier responded and hurriedly adjusted the surveillance equipment, projecting the anomaly onto the big screen.
“We found a large number of Lickers moving quickly towards the shelter...”
“Chi Chi Chi.”
On the surveillance screen, a large number of red Lickers darted out from the dense forest on the other side.
Almost in an instant, the entire command room was filled with heavy breathing sounds.
The players instantly became extremely nervous.
Oh no!
It was a group of Lickers!
To deal with a high-speed moving creature like a Licker, the best weapon was not a high-energy beam weapon, but an ordinary turret!
The energy beam required a long time to accumulate power, and the hit rate was not high.
It was like a cannon hitting a mosquito.
At this time, more than two-thirds of the shelter’s turret had been damaged!
In the current situation of the Federation’s shelter, the Lickers were more troublesome than the Tier 5 giant zombies!
They posed a greater threat to the shelter!
They could only rely on the players to take them head on!
“Attention, all attention. A large number of Lickers are approaching. Please be on alert and eliminate the Lickers as soon as possible.”
The people on duty at the sentry tower were all elite players of the Federation.
Even so, the continuous high-intensity battle for more than four hours had exhausted them mentally.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - Serial Blood Explosions
paragraphs: “Received!”
Upon receiving the warning, the players braced themselves to deal with the group of Lickers.
They would use long-range sniping to eliminate threats in advance!
Chi Chi Chi..
A red figure emerged from the darkness.
The players raised their sniper rifles, trying to aim at the Licker.
Zhang Linhui was the leader of the Federation’s elite team, possessing the long-range sniping talent skill.
He quickly used the scope to locate the Licker and was about to pull the trigger.
“Eh?”
Zhang Linhui was stunned.
He moved the scope away and looked into the distance. He even rubbed his eyes, wondering if he had seen wrongly.
What was going on?
A large number of Lickers were actually rushing towards the Tier 5 giant zombies?!
Under the astonished gazes of the Federation’s elites, the Lickers leapt onto the giant zombies’ huge bodies, crazily biting at them. They waved their claws and left many wounds on their bodies.
The damage was not great, but the giant zombies were agitated by the Lickers.
The giant zombies reached out their hands and grabbed a Licker, throwing it into the distance.
“Bang!”
The Licker was thrown and smashed into the wall of the shelter’s periphery.
Its HP was instantly depleted, and the Licker was instantly killed!
Even the wall of the shelter was dented by the huge impact, and the durability of the shelter was reduced by a small part.
What happened?
The zombies started fighting each other?
The Lickers were here to help?!

After playing Zombie Apocalypse for so many years, this was the first time Zhang Linhui had seen such a situation. He was extremely confused and didn’t know if he should continue to execute the order to kill the Lickers.
Not only him, but the officers in the command room of the shelter were also confused.
“Stop firing!”
“Quick! Order to stop firing! Switch targets and attack the giant zombies!”
Li Dahai was the first to react and he gave the order to the Federation soldiers.
He didn’t understand why this group of Lickers would choose to attack the giant zombies.
It wasn’t important!
The most important thing now was to get rid of Tier 5 giant zombies!
Li Dahai didn’t have time to think about it anymore.
He couldn’t afford to lose the shelter!
“Chi!”
The giant zombie was annoyed by the group of Lickers. It suddenly reached out its hand and grabbed a Licker, holding it in its palm.
“Chi! Chi!”
The Licker was held in the giant zombie’s palm. It struggled and attacked crazily, trying to break free.
The giant zombie slowly clenched its fists, trying to squeeze the Licker to death.
“Boom!!!”
The Licker exploded violently!
Hot blood splashed everywhere.
The giant zombie was suddenly hit by the strong impact of the explosion. Its body swayed backwards and it took several steps back before it managed to stand still.
It opened its palm.
The palm of the giant zombie was actually corroded by a lump of blood and its flesh was a mess.
“It’s still not dead?!”
In the mining area halfway up the mountain, Fang Heng was surprised by the giant zombie’s strong vitality.
He focused his mind and thought about countermeasures.
At this stage, it was still a little difficult to deal with a Tier 5 zombie by relying on strength alone.
A single attack from a giant zombie could easily kill a Licker.
On the other hand, the normal attack damage of a Licker could hardly damage a Tier 5 mutated zombie.
Only by relying on the Licker’s close-range self-destruct could it deal a large amount of damage in a short period of time.
Use self-destruct to deal with it!
However, the trouble was that although the damage of the HP explosion was strong, it had a special restriction. Only Licker with HP below 10% could use it.
What should he do!?
Fang Heng’s eyes scanned the surroundings.
At the periphery of the shelter, the sentry tower and other buildings that had been attacked earlier were burning.
Got it!
Fang Heng immediately had a plan.
“Captain, what’s the situation?”
“I don’t know.”
On the sentry tower, Zhang Linhui was also confused by the Lickers.
The Lickers gave up on attacking the giant zombies and retreated at a very fast speed.
Had the Lickers turned into spirits?
Seeing that they couldn’t win, they ran away again?
Zhang Linhui was ready to wait for the next order, but he frowned.
“Captain, look at them...”
The Lickers seemed to have gone crazy as they all rushed towards the burning buildings in the distance.
In the blink of an eye, all the Lickers had disappeared into a sea of fire.
What was this situation? Suicide?
Zhang Linhui really could not understand it. He immediately said, “Forget about the Lickers. Let’s continue attacking!”
“Yes!”
After charging into the flames, the Lickers’ HP started to decrease.
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has received fire damage.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has entered a burning state and will continue to receive fire damage...]
Fang Heng observed the row of damage messages that appeared in the game log and estimated the remaining HP of the Lickers.
“Enough!”
After estimating that the Lickers’ HP had dropped to 10%, Fang Heng controlled the Lickera to jump out of the sea of fire again.
“Swoosh! Swoosh!”
The Lickers jumped out of the sea of fire again!
They pounced on one of the Tier 5 giant zombies crazily!
They leaped onto the body of the Tier 5 giant zombie and grabbed it tightly!
The Lickers were covered in the burning flames, which made them even more ferocious. Among them, two Lickers grabbed the back of the giant zombie’s head from behind.
Now!
Standing on the high ground, Fang Heng suddenly clenched his fists.
“Blood explosion!”
“Boom! Boom Boom!”
The Lickers attached to the giant zombie self-detonated one after another.
For a moment, red blood splattered everywhere!
It was a close-body explosion!
The giant zombie’s body was blasted into a bloody mess. Its body swayed a few times before it fell to the ground.
[Hint: You have killed the giant zombie. You have obtained 455 survival points. You have obtained high energy crystal (purple)*1.]
It worked..
Fang Heng wiped the sweat off his forehead and heaved a sigh of relief.
First, he relied on the Federation’s high-intensity beam weapon to reduce the giant zombie’s HP for more than four hours. Finally, he used up more than 20 Lickers to finish off a Tier 5 giant zombie.
A Tier 5 mutated zombie was still difficult to deal with!
With experience, the next step was much easier.
Following the pattern, Fang Heng controlled the remaining Lickers to enter the sea of fire in batches.
In the Federation shelter command hall, looking at the scene captured on the monitor, the players fell silent for a moment.
What they saw just now made them somewhat unable to understand.
They had won, but it was a very strange win.
Flames could make Lickers stronger?
And what about that self-destruct attack?
Li Dahai broke the silence and said in a low voice, “We can confirm one thing. These Lickers are being controlled by someone behind the scenes.”
“Someone is helping us in the dark?”
“Yes.”
The players present fell into silence again. They were all thinking.
Who could it be?
Who could control the Licker, and who would be willing to help them in the dark?
An officer suddenly thought of something and said, “Could it be Fang Heng?”
Li Dahai had been focusing most of his attention on the safety of the shelter and Night Owl, who was in Server 5. He rarely paid attention to news from other servers.
This was the first time he had heard this name. He could not help but turn to look at the officer. “Who are you talking about?”
