chapters.title: Chapter 361 - Gone
paragraphs: “Fang Heng from Zombie Apocalypse District 8. He can control zombies. He has been appearing on the player forums many times recently.”
“No, it can’t be him.”
Li Dahai shook his head and vetoed it.
Server 8 had only been in service for a short while. Upgrading to Tier 2 space tearing device was impossible.
No one could do it!
Perhaps it was an organization that was hostile to the Night Owl organization?
“Edit the video and send it to the intelligence department. Try to figure out the identity of the player who was secretly controlling the Lickers.”
“Yes!”
Not far from the Federation’s shelter, in front of an abandoned building.
A few people wearing silver masks were standing guard beside Sikong Mao.
One of them asked, “What happened to the last group of zombies?”
“I don’t know.”
Sikong Mao’s voice was hoarse.
Controlling a large number of high-tier zombies into a berserk state to attack the Federation’s shelter had consumed almost all of his energy.
“Licker is a hunter with sharp perception. It would hardly attack a higher-level mutated zombie, let alone have the ability to self-detonate.”
Sikong Mao’s breathing was heavy, and his eyes showed a deep fear.
“Someone must be controlling them from behind.”
The few people in silver masks fell silent.
They had planned for half a year, and spent a lot of effort to drag the three Tier 5 mutated zombies into hibernation mode.
The other party seemed to have an easier way to control the zombies.
If there was such a person, his strength would definitely be terrifying.
After a long while, that person asked, “Is it the Federation’s backup plan?”
“I’m not sure.”
“Release the video to the black market and think of a way to find out that person’s identity.”
“Alright.”
The two masked men nodded.
Sikong Mao turned his head to look at the mine halfway up the mountain.
“Let’s ignore him for now. We’ve managed to delay the Federation for a few hours. The blue crystal ores should have already been transported, right?”
“Hmm. I’ve made some calculations. It should be about time.”

“The Federation’s sudden attack this time is a little strange. They might have predicted our movements in advance. In addition to the loss of the blue crystal raw ores, we won’t be able to hide our actions from them for too long.”
Sikong Mao had slightly recovered his stamina. Leaning against the wall beside him, he said, “We need to carry out our plan in advance. The sooner the better.”
“If we want to speed up, we still need a few players who have advanced construction engineer skills.”
“It’s finally done.”
Seeing the last giant zombie fall in a series of self-destructions, Fang Heng let out a sigh of relief.
Controlling the Lickers to self-destruct one by one consumed too much energy.
In this battle, all the Lickers were exhausted.
Fang Heng opened his palm and aimed at the foot of the mountain in the distance.
The drop rate of the giant zombies was extremely high. After the three zombies died, they all dropped high energy evolution crystals.
“Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!”
Three high energy evolution crystals came from afar and flew into Fang Heng’s palm.
When they came into contact with his palm, the rune mark on the back of Fang Heng’s hand once again displayed a weak light.
Then, the high energy evolution crystals were absorbed by the rune mark.
A line of game hints appeared.
[Hint: Detected that the player has mastered a skill: occult ritual (Tier 1), basic occult (Level 2). The evolution crystal in your backpack can be stored directly in the occult ritual.]
“The evolution crystal can be stored directly in the occult ritual?”
Fang Heng placed the back of his hand in front of his eyes and observed.
This was a pretty good skill. It could save quite a few slots in the backpack.
Since the crisis of the Federation’s shelter was over, Fang Heng estimated that the people from the Federation would soon rush to the mining area.
This wave of profits was almost over.
He should leave as soon as possible!

The players of the Night Owl organization in the mining area had also noticed the situation in the Federation’s shelter at the foot of the mountain. They called on the players to speed up the transportation, preparing to leave after getting the last batch of goods.
Taking advantage of the fact that everyone was speeding up the transportation of materials, Fang Heng casually walked to the side of a military truck.
The blue crystal raw ores behind the truck were already 70-80% filled. A few players had just laboriously moved two large boxes up.
Fang Heng quietly sat in the driver’s seat.
He stepped on the accelerator and the large truck drove out of the mining area.
Night Owl organization did not notice anything amiss. They only thought that Fang Heng was also a player who helped to move the ores.
When a few players came out of the iron mine with boxes filled with iron ores, they were stunned when they saw the truck driving away from the iron mine area.
“Hey! Wait!”
“It’s not full yet!”
“Hey! That guy!”
The truck did not have any intention of stopping. The players watched as Fang Heng drove the truck to the foot of the mountain and disappeared into the night.
The remaining players looked at each other in dismay.
What was going on?
The truck was not filled up and someone had driven it away?
This was going to cost them money!
There were 35 hours left until the end of the teleportation.
Including the truck full of high-quality blue crystal raw ores, it should be enough to cover the cost.
Fang Heng pondered.
It was a pity that he didn’t bring the live sample collector. Otherwise, he should be able to collect some samples of Tier 5 giant zombies.
Next, he should think of a way to find the first-generation meteorite.
Fang Heng went down the mountain along the path.
On the way, the remaining five Lickers jumped onto the back of the truck.
Fang Heng controlled the steering wheel and made a turn, moving along Road No. 102.
He headed all the way to the apocalypse merchant camp. About half an hour later, Fang Heng discovered the apocalypse merchant camp beside the path ahead.
The sky was still dark and the gate of the apocalypse merchant camp was still closed.
Fang Heng took a detour and temporarily parked the truck in a dense forest nearby, protected by the Lickers.
He went offline again to deliver a wave of high-quality blue crystal raw ores.
Express Hotel.
In the pitch-black room, Old Black sat alone in front of his computer desk.
The screen was playing the video of the Tier 5 giant zombies being attacked by the Lickers not long ago.
“Buzz...”
The phone on the table vibrated.
Old Black picked up the call.
“It’s me.”
“Did you receive the latest video?”
Old Black paused the video at the moment the Licker self-destructed and replied expressionlessly, “I’m watching.”
“What do you think? Is he from the Federation?”
“I’m not sure.”
“Confirm his identity as soon as possible. His existence will increase the uncertainty of our plan. I have a bad feeling.”
“It’s a bit troublesome. I’ve already checked the latest database, but so far, I haven’t found any suspicious candidates that match the relevant abilities.”
“10,000 King of Gods’ points.”
Old Black massaged his temples and his sitting posture became more relaxed. He said, “It’s not about the money. The person you’re looking for isn’t on the list.”
“Yes, I understand.”
“The plan has been moved forward. We need to activate the first phase of the plan within 24 hours. We still lack players who are proficient in mechanical repair abilities.”
“That’s a rare talent, and you know that place in District 5.”
“10,000 King of Gods’ points. I need to ensure that the amplification device is activated within 24 hours.”
“Of course, as you wish.”
Old Black pressed his phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - Dark Knights Wiped out
paragraphs: By the time Old Black saw the video, he was 80% sure.
It was Fang Heng!
Old Black had been paying attention to Fang Heng’s movements in District 8.
This included the videos of Fang Heng controlling the Lickers and the prison’s recent collection of rare ores and materials.
Old Black was very clear.
In the game, those who had both the Tier 3 space tearing device and the ability to control the Lickers...
Perhaps only Fang Heng!
However, Old Black did not expect Fang Heng to be able to complete the modification of the Tier 3 space tearing device so quickly.
He also did not expect Fang Heng to appear in the Federation’s second shelter last night.
Old Black even suspected that Fang Heng had something to do with the Night Owl organization’s plan being exposed ahead of time.
“Good boy, you caught up with me in advance.”
Old Black’s face showed a hint of amusement.
“I turned down a big deal for you. You have to help me earn more.”
Fang Heng waited on the spot for nearly an hour until the sky turned white. The apocalypse merchant camp was finally open to the public.
Leaving the truck in the bushes, Fang Heng entered the apocalypse merchant camp alone.
“Hello, Adventurer.”
The merchant in the camp was a white-haired old man.
He had just opened for business and was wiping the counter with a rag.
“You look unfamiliar. Is this your first time here?”
“Yes.” Fang Heng nodded slightly and introduced himself, “My name is Fang Heng, I come from another parallel world. Our world is experiencing the apocalypse just like you guys.”
The apocalypse merchant raised his head and looked at Fang Heng.
He did not show much surprise and continued to wipe the armrest of the counter with a rag.
“Welcome, guest from the parallel world. Others call me Uncle Lindsay. Is there anything you need?”
“I want to inquire about the Dark Knights. I need to find them. I know you can do it. Just pass them a message on my behalf. I’m willing to pay some points.”
“Dark Knights...”
Uncle Lindsay paused.
He put down the rag in his hand, closed his eyes and sighed.
“It’s been a long time since I’ve heard this name...”
Fang Heng had a very bad feeling.
“What do you mean?”
“I’m sorry, I can’t help you.”
Uncle Lindsay turned around and took out a bottle of wine and two wine glasses from the cabinet at the back.
He opened the bottle cap and slowly poured a glass of wine into the glass.
“The Dark Knights were completely destroyed 30 years ago. I was still very young at that time. I once thought that they would save our world.”
“Disappeared?”
The team got wiped out?
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
He had heard of Dark Knights being wiped out in some worlds.
He did not expect it to be in Server 5!
“You are very surprised. It seems that in your parallel world, the Dark Knights are still alive.”
Lindsay pushed the glass of half-filled wine toward Fang Heng.
“Do you mind telling me about it?”
Fang Heng was a little confused. He gulped down the wine in the glass.
“Can you tell me how the Dark Knights were destroyed first?”
Uncle Lindsay recalled with a nostalgic look on his face.
“It started with a special operation. I think it was Pine City.”
“Yes, I remember it should be that place. During that operation, the Dark Knights were attacked by the Nemesis and were completely destroyed. Their strength was greatly reduced.”

“After that, we encountered the zombie wave that erupted in the quarantine zone. The Dark Knights were greatly weakened. When they tried their best to stop the spread of the poison gas in the quarantine zone, the Dark Knights’ headquarters was attacked by a group of lunatics.”
Fang Heng digested Uncle Lindsay’s words.
The Dark Knights were tricked by the players!
It was most likely caused by the anti-federation forces of Night Owl.
Fang Heng had heard a long time ago that the anti-federation forces in District 5 were deeply rooted.
He knew that the situation in District 5 was bad, but he did not expect it to be this bad.
Wait!
Thinking carefully, according to what Uncle Lindsay said, the main storyline mission of District 5 had just reached Pine City.
This meant that the Dark Knights had yet to discover the first-generation meteorite.
The first-generation meteorite should still be there!
“After the Dark Knights were destroyed, I can no longer see the hope of the end of the apocalypse.”
Lindsay finished the wine in his glass and poured himself a full glass.
“It’s your turn, Fang Heng. Now, I want to hear your story.”
“In our world, we successfully entered Pine City and obtained information related to the primogenitor virus and the first-generation meteorite...”
Fang Heng roughly told the main story of Server 8.
“Uncle Lindsay, I need to find the first-generation meteorite. This is the most likely way to save our world. Do you know the whereabouts of the first-generation meteorite?”
“I’m sorry, young man. I’ve never heard of such a thing.”
Fang Heng’s heart sank again.
Alright.
Although he did not know, there was a high probability that the first-generation meteorite was still in a corner of this apocalyptic world.
With the last glimmer of hope, Fang Heng continued to ask, “Then do you know who might know?”
“I really want to help you, but it’s been a long time since I’ve paid attention to the Meteorite Company.”
Uncle Lindsay lowered his head and thought, “From your description, I suggest that you start investigating the first-generation meteorite from the source.”
“The source?”
Fang Heng left the apocalypse merchant camp in disappointment.
The source?
Did he have to start investigating from Pine City?
Fang Heng scratched his head and yawned.
He felt a little sleepy.
He stayed up all night without sleep.
Back in the truck, Fang Heng threw down a simple bed and went offline.
Fang Heng opened the game cabin with much effort and took a deep breath.
Buzz Buzz Buzz...
His phone continued to vibrate.
“Coming, coming. That Chen Yu, he won’t stop for a second...”
Fang Heng muttered as he flipped through the messy pile of ores in the room, trying to look for the missing phone.
The only person who could persistently call him on his phone was Chen Yu.
After spending a long time, Fang Heng finally found his phone under the pile of blue crystal ores.
When he saw the caller ID, Fang Heng was stunned.
Unknown number?
Fang Heng had a guess almost instantly.
Could it be Old Black?
“Hello?”
A familiar voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Fang Heng, it’s me.”
“Old Black?”
“Hehe, it’s been a while. It seems like you still remember me.”
Old Black chuckled. “You’re in District 5, right? Let me guess, you’re looking for the first-generation meteorite?”
Fang Heng immediately became extremely vigilant.
Old Black was actually able to guess that he was going to District 5 to look for the first-generation meteorite...
On the surface, Fang Heng was still laughing loudly. “Thanks to you. Besides, didn’t you ask me to go to Server 5? Is there any news?”
“Fang Heng, you really surprised me. To be honest, I didn’t expect you to complete Tier 3 space tearing device modification so quickly.”
Fang Heng pursed his lips. “Really? Should I be proud?”
“You do have the right to be proud. Now that time is limited, I’ll cut to the chase. I need you to do something for me.”
“Sure, in exchange, I need to get the first-generation meteorite.”
“Hahahaha, deal!”
Fang Heng was stunned.
He had only pretended to be polite, but he did not expect Old Black to agree directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - Research Institute
paragraphs: “Do as I say. I can guarantee you that you will get the first-generation meteorite within the next 30 hours.”
“In exchange, I need you to do something.”
“Okay.”
“That’s cool. This is not the first time we’ve worked together. I need more trust this time. Do as I say. Can you do it?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng felt that he should agree first.
“You’re near the second shelter of the Federation, right?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“Very good. I need you to go find Night Owl’s people now.”
“Night Owl?”
“Yes. I don’t want you to expose your identity. Go to the King of Gods’ game and buy a custom-made red mask. I’ll send you the mask blueprint later.”
“To be safe, spend another 100 King of Gods’ points to buy a bottle of potion that can change one’s appearance for up to 24 hours.”
“You’ll have to pay for this.”
“Sure. Right now, Night Owl desperately needs an excellent mechanic. I need you to find them first and help them with some work.”
“Send me to work? What about the first-generation meteorite?”
“Don’t worry. Night Owl’s people will take you to an experimental base to work. The first-generation meteorite is in that experimental base.”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
After circling for half a day, the first-generation meteorite was actually in the hands of the Night Owl organization!?
“Don’t get excited yet, Fang Heng.”

“That place was originally the Meteorite Company’s experimental base. After it was occupied by the Night Owl organization, it underwent special modifications. I only have the initial map of that place.”
“Night Owl has very strict control over that place...”
“Back garden? There’s a lot of stones?”
At first, Mr Sun did not believe what the cleaner said.
It was not until he was dragged to the back garden by a few cleaners that he saw the piles of stones piled up in the back garden with his own eyes.
“What’s going on?”
“It’s probably Mr Fang Heng. We were about to call someone to clean up the stones, but Mr Fang Heng stopped us.”
“Fang Heng?”
Mr Sun felt like he was going crazy.
Last night, Fang Heng went back and forth to the library, saying that he was looking for inspiration.
He hadn’t stopped yet. What was the meaning of putting so many stones in the back garden today?
If Fang Heng wasn’t Mo Yunxiao’s VIP and Mo Jiawei’s best friend, Mr Sun would have chased him out.
Wait, when did he put so many stones in the back garden?
“Mr Sun, you’re up so early, huh?”
Fang Heng walked into the back garden and greeted everyone with a smile.
He had just made a part of the follow-up plan with Old Black. After hanging up the phone, he heard the sound of the outside world through the window, so he ran out in a hurry.
“Mr Fang Heng... What are you doing?”
Mr Sun smiled bitterly and looked at Fang Heng, waiting for him to explain.
“Ah, this... I’m sorry, these stones are quite precious. I can’t find the place at the moment...”
“I have put them in the back garden for the time being. These are very precious ores, so we must be careful that they don’t get stolen by others.”
Precious?
Mr Sun did not believe a single word Fang Heng said.
“Mr Fang Heng, you’re new here. Could you have been deceived by someone? Is this kind of stone very precious?”
“Of course, it’s very expensive.”
Mr Sun casually picked up a raw stone and placed it in his hand to observe.
The raw stone emitted a faint blue light.
Blue jade?
But this blue was so transparent. No matter how one looked at it, it seemed fake.
“Three days. Three days later, I’ll clean it up. I’ll have to trouble Big Brother Sun.”
It wasn’t easy to convince Mr Sun to temporarily store the ores in the back garden. Fang Heng meditated for another three hours, recovering some of his energy and returned to the game.

After spending 110 King of Gods’ points, Fang Heng first bought a custom-made red mask and a face-changing potion that lasted for 24 hours according to the blueprint Old Black gave him before entering the game.
Entering the Zombie Apocalypse, Fang Heng put on the mask, drank the potion and drove the truck toward the agreed coordinates.
To prevent the truck from exposing his identity, Fang Heng parked the truck at a location one kilometre away from the agreed-upon gathering point and slowly walked over.
Soon, an abandoned shelter appeared in front of him.
The abandoned shelter had been destroyed in the zombie wave and only half of it remained.
Stepping into the shelter, Fang Heng looked around.
Two members of the Night Owl organization, one on the left and one on the right, wearing silver masks, walked out from behind the stone pillars.
“You were introduced by Old Black?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“We were sent by Night Owl to pick you up. Come with us.”
The two compared the masks on Fang Heng’s face and led him to the back door of the ruins.
Fang Heng followed the two of them out of the back door of the abandoned shelter.
A black SUV was parked by the roadside.
“Let’s go, get in the car.”
After getting in the car, Fang Heng turned his head to look out of the window. “How long will it take?”
“About two hours if everything goes smoothly.”
Fang Heng took out a sleeping bag from his backpack. “I’ll go offline to rest for a while. Wake me up after two hours.”
The two Night Owl players looked at each other.
Most players would be nervous when they heard that Night Owl was an anti-federal organization for the first time.
It was rare for them to be as relaxed as Fang Heng.
“No.”
“Old Black should have told you that to prevent the mission from leaking, offline operations are prohibited during the operation. This is also for the safety of both parties.”
“Correspondingly, Night Owl will give you extra mission compensation.”
Fang Heng curled his lips.
He definitely wouldn’t be able to receive the so-called compensation. Most likely, Old Black would use it to fill his own pockets.
He thought of it as the price for the first-generation meteorite.
Fang Heng put away the simple bed and controlled the scattered ordinary zombies in the distance to slowly walk over.
The entire journey was silent.
After bumping for nearly an hour and a half in the car, the car drove into the wilderness.
Fang Heng looked out of the window.
District 5, in the wilderness.
This large area was controlled by the anti-federation forces.
Fang Heng had seen some random conversations on the forum before.
It was said that the anti-federation forces were not on the same page. There were frequent conflicts of all sizes, so it was normal for them to fight to the death.
However, once the Federation forces tried to invade the wilderness, they would unite and face the outside world.
After driving along the road in the wilderness for half an hour, the car turned into a newly built path.
Soon, the car stopped outside a research institute.
Fang Heng did not get out of the car immediately.
Through the car window, he saw many large trucks parked outside the research institute.
Many players were moving materials down from the trucks.
These players didn’t wear masks.
Eh? Boxes?
After carefully observing them, Fang Heng felt that those boxes looked a little familiar.
Could they be the blue crystal raw ores that he had plundered from the mining area last night?
Fang Heng was suspicious.
“We’re here. You can get off now.”
Fang Heng opened the car door and got off.
The scorching sun hung high in the sky.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and looked up at the building in front of him.
It was a five-story building with a large number of turrets attached to it.
A few people wearing silver masks stood at the entrance of the research institute.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - Stabilizers
paragraphs: Among the crowd, only Sikong Mao wasn’t wearing a mask. He looked at Fang Heng, his gaze fixed on Fang Heng’s red mask.
“I’m Sikong Mao, the person in charge of the research institute.”
“Fang Shuo.”
Fang Heng replied indifferently, his gaze shifting to Sikong Mao.
Sikong Mao!
The Federation’s S-level wanted criminal!
He was a ruthless character.
Fang Heng had a slight impression of him.
There were two types of criminals that could make it onto the S-level wanted list.
The first type was those who were strong to a certain extent and possessed extremely destructive abilities, causing the Federation to feel an extremely great threat.
The second type was those criminals who relied on their efforts to stir up trouble in the game, causing great damage to the Federation.
Sikong Mao belonged to the latter.
“I’ve been waiting for you for a long time. Time is limited. Let’s walk and talk.”
Sikong Mao turned around and led Fang Heng into the research institute. He gave Fang Heng a general introduction to the research institute.
“This building used to be one of the secret research institutes of the Meteorite Company. Now, it’s completely under the control of our Night Owl.”
The group of people walked straight into the research institute and stopped in front of the delivery elevator.
Sikong Mao pressed the button that led to the second basement.
A few players who were pushing ore carts followed them into the elevator.
“After we took over the research institute, we completely modified it and strengthened the research institute’s defensive capabilities.”
“The wilderness areas are all anti-federal organizations. We’re united against the outside world, so it’s safer. Next is stealth...”
“Stealth?”
Fang Heng looked at the player who was moving the ores and materials, thinking, is this still considered stealth?
“There’s a change in the plan. They only came here last night. Two days ago, only the core members of Night Owl’s organization knew about the existence of the research institute.”
Sikong Mao noticed Fang Heng’s tone and explained.
He raised his head to look at Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Shuo, what’s your mechanic level and building level?”
“Both are Level 15 and there’s also the talent skill bonus.”
Fang Heng deliberately omitted Tier 3.
Sikong Mao’s eyes flashed with surprise.
“You’re Level 15?”
“Yes.”
“Very impressive.”
Sikong Mao nodded his head in praise.
Level 15. This level was considered a veteran player in Server 5.
“Looks like Old Black has introduced me to a reliable candidate.” Sikong Mao sighed and asked intentionally, “How do you know Old Black?”
“In the beginning, it was through an anonymous mission. At that time, I didn’t know that he was related to your Night Owl, so I was almost cheated by him once.”
Fang Heng said with a smile, “But he still gave a lot of money, and it arrived in time.”
“Ding Dong!”
The elevator stopped at the third basement.
“Let’s go.”
Along the way, Fang Heng was observing the surrounding terrain.
The internal security of the research institute was relatively tight. Night Owl players wearing silver masks could often be seen.
After walking through a passage that was about ten meters long, a huge underground platform appeared in front of them.
“This is the research institute’s main control room.”
Seeing the scene in the main control room, Fang Heng’s pupils suddenly constricted.
That was...
In the middle of the platform stood a large mechanical device.
Many players were surrounding the machine and making calculations and modifications.
What the hell!
Large-scale space tearing device?!
Fang Heng was shocked.
That’s not right!
Fang Heng frowned as he carefully observed the super-sized machine in the centre of the platform.
It was not a large-scale space tearing device.
Even though it was very similar to the structure of the space tearing device.
“Let me introduce the space tearing stabilizing device.”
Fang Heng turned his head to look at Sikong Mao.
“What’s that?”
Sikong Mao wanted to test Fang Heng’s mechanical knowledge.
“Old Black said that you’re proficient in mechanical devices, so you should have heard of the large-scale space tearing device, right?”
“Of course, it’s a kind of long-distance transmission device. It consumes a lot of energy and requires a special blue crystal as its energy source.”
Fang Heng paused and added, “In addition, I heard that after the device is upgraded to a higher tier, it can also conduct teleportations across servers.”
“You’re right. The space tearing device is the ‘back door’ left behind by the game in various worlds.”
“After we get the space tearing device, we can continuously upgrade it to level up, so that we can cross servers and even cross the game worlds.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
What Sikong Mao said proved his previous guess.
That’s right!
The space tearing device would most likely continue to level up after levelling up to Tier 4!
Fang Heng had always believed that the destruction of the first-generation meteorite in Server 8 had something to do with Night Owl.
It was the Night Owl organization’s use of the space tearing device.
And the traces left in the cave on Paradise Island indicated that it was related to vampires.
Therefore, Fang Heng concluded that it was an invasion from the world of vampires.
This meant that the large-scale space tearing device could also carry out transmissions across the game world!
For example, it could enter the world of vampires of the same level.
It could even enter the game world of a higher level!
Fang Heng took a deep breath and raised his head to look at the large-scale device in the middle of the spacious main control room.
“You still haven’t told me what this thing is used for?”
“You can think of it as an amplification device of the space tearing device.”
Sikong Mao explained, “There are multiple restrictions on the space tearing device. Under normal circumstances, the passage across the game world can only open for a very short moment.”
“For example, a normal space tearing device can only transport a player from the original point A world to point B world, and it will also cost a little.”
“Now, we can build an amplifier at point B to link point A and point B for a long time, which is equivalent to opening a long-lasting passage.”
“Of course, this passage still has many restrictions, and there are still many things that can not pass through this temporary passage.”
Listening to Sikong Mao’s words, Fang Heng’s heart beat wildly.
“You’re saying that this can be used to open a continuous time passage?!”
“Yes, that’s right.”
A cold glint appeared in Sikong Mao’s eyes.
“The troublesome thing is that building the passage requires a lot of rare materials and a lot of energy.”
As they spoke, a few players laboriously dragged a few large boxes into the laboratory and stacked them along the right wall.
“As you can see, those boxes are filled with blue crystal raw ores.”

“You should also know that after the Dark Knights of District 5 were destroyed, the production method of blue crystal ores is also impossible to obtain. Hence, we can only use this inefficient method to directly use blue crystal raw ores as energy stabilizing devices.”
“Hence, we need a large number of blue crystal raw ores.”
“Unfortunately, most of the blue crystal raw ore mines in District 5 are within the scope of the Federation’s control.”
“Therefore, from a few months ago, we’ve already begun to secretly steal the blue crystal raw ores from within the Federation.”
Sikong Mao walked to Fang Heng’s side and sized up the large space stabilizing device located in the centre of the main control room.
“I believe Old Black has already told you that to obtain the blue crystal raw ores, there was a huge commotion last night.”
“Those people from the Federation aren’t all trash. I believe that they will react very quickly. They might be able to guess what we are trying to do.”
“Therefore, I need to complete the construction of the stabilizing device before the Federation realises it, and open the passage completely!”

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Blueprint
paragraphs: Fang Heng was secretly shocked when he heard this.
What a guy!
Night Owl was prepared to play a big game this time!
Directly opening a time passage and using the strength of the other servers to annihilate Server 5’s federal forces?
After saying this, Sikong Mao stopped and raised his hand to greet a researcher.
“Parason!”
On the large stabilizer, a short, skinny, dark-skinned young man flipped over and walked towards Sikong Mao.
Parason’s forehead was covered in sweat and he looked a little impatient.
“Mr Sikong, time is too tight. I’m afraid I won’t be able to complete it in twenty hours...”
Sikong Mao waved his hand and interrupted, “This is Fang Shuo, the person recommended by Old Black. He will be in charge of the construction of the stabilizer. You will assist him.”
When Parason heard this, he carefully sized up Fang Heng and revealed an expression of distrust.

“He is Parason, a Level 11 mechanical master. He is in charge of the entire research institute’s base reconstruction. He was originally in charge of the construction of the stabilizer. Now that time is tight, I need you to take the lead.”
Parason had some doubts about Fang Heng’s ability, so he nodded at Fang Heng.
“I’ll leave this to the two of you. Work together. If you encounter any problems, come and find me immediately. I’ll help you solve them as soon as possible.”
As he spoke, Sikong Mao handed Fang Heng a piece of the blueprint.
[Hint: You have obtained the building blueprint-large-scale space tearing device.]
There was such a benefit!?
Getting a piece of blueprint for free?
With this, he would be able to think of a way to directly open the world passage in the future!!
Fang Heng maintained his calm on the surface and opened the building blueprints to check.
Item: building blueprints-large-scale space tearing device stabilizer.
Description: After using the blueprints, you can learn the construction of the large-scale space tearing device stabilizer.
Learning requirements: Machinery proficiency Level 10, basic building Level 10.

Construction effect 1: After the main space tearing device is positioned, the stabilizer is activated. It can greatly increase the stability of the passage, allowing the passage to be continuously constructed and allow most of the minerals, materials and living things to pass through.

Construction effect 2: Activating the stabilizer will consume a large amount of energy in an instant, and maintaining the passage will consume the energy of both the main device and the stabilizer at the same time (as the passage’s usage time increases, the energy consumption will gradually increase).
Construction effect 3: The facility may be damaged during usage.
Materials required for construction: Click here to display the details.
Good stuff!
Fang Heng impatiently slapped the blueprint on his head.
[Hint: You have learned the skill-large-scale space tearing device.]
“Fang Shuo, you only have 20 hours. We have to complete the construction of the stabilizer.”
Sikong Mao instructed Fang Heng.
He did not leave the main control room. Instead, he walked to the side, sat on a stool and quietly watched.
Fang Heng was still thinking about the stabilizer.
This thing was good!
With it, he could think of a way to open a passage for a longer duration in the future, plundering the resources of other servers and moving materials into his shelter!
The scale had become bigger all of a sudden!
Seeing that Fang Heng did not make any move, Parason wiped the sweat from his forehead and could not help but urge him.
“Fang Shuo, let’s start now.”

“The other players’ mechanical levels are very low, so they can only help out and make some intermediate parts. Only the two of us and the other three NPC survivors can complete the main construction work.”
“Okay, okay.”
Fang Heng answered perfunctorily and glanced at the game log.
The zombie clones that died last night would be resurrected in less than two hours.
There were too many people here, so it was not a good place to resurrect zombies.
He had to find a quiet place to resurrect zombies as soon as possible and then make a plan.
“Fang Heng, hurry up. If we don’t finish the construction on time...”
Parason carefully glanced at Sikong Mao, who was not far away, and hesitated.
“Don’t worry. There’s still plenty of time.”
Fang Heng followed Parason to the space tearing stabilizing device in the centre of the main control room.
[Hint: You have found a large-scale space tearing stabilizing device under construction.]
[Hint: You have mastered the construction of the building.]
[Hint: Current completion rate: 77.15%.]

[[Hint: This construction requires high-level mechanical parts*17, chrome-lead alloy*27, advanced precision gear*31... after completion, the overall completion rate will be increased by 2%-4.3%. This construction success rate: 87%.]
Fang Heng raised his head again and turned his head to look behind him.
A gaze was focused on him.
It was Sikong Mao.
Fang Heng raised the wrench and waved it at Sikong Mao, then turned around to start the construction.
Seeing a long channelling bar appear above Fang Heng’s head, Sikong Mao, who had been staring at Fang Heng, heaved a sigh of relief.
He had let down his guard a little against Fang Heng.
Perhaps it was because it was too important, he had always felt a little uneasy.
Closing his eyes, Sikong Mao continued to glean the plan that he would carry out later.
[Hint: You have completed the current construction of the building. The completion rate of the building has increased by 2.9%. Current completion rate of the building: 89.92%.]
“Mr Fang Shuo!”
Parason could not help but feel a little excited.
At first, he had some doubts about the abilities of this new architect.
He did not expect that in less than two hours, he had completed 10% of the construction!
It was too shocking!
Parason watched the whole process.
Fang Heng had completed every construction!
A terrifying success rate.
“Vitality points have been used up. I will go and rest for a while. The parts needed for the next step will be prepared as soon as possible.”
“Okay, okay. Mr Fang Shuo, I’ll take care of this.”
Parason was convinced by Fang Heng’s words and he became even more respectful.
Fang Heng waved his hand and glanced at the game hint.
There was less than half an hour left before the zombie team resurrected. He needed to find a place to place the zombies as soon as possible.
Looking around, Fang Heng walked toward the exit of the control room.
Two members of the Night Owl organization wearing silver masks reached out and stopped Fang Heng.
“What? Can’t I find a place to rest? Energy points will affect my construction success rate.”
The Night Owl players hesitated for a moment and looked at Sikong Mao.
Sikong Mao looked at Parason.
Parason said excitedly, “Mr Sikong, with Mr Fang Heng’s help, the current completion rate of the stabilizer is close to 90%.”
That fast?
Sikong Mao was also shocked by Fang Heng’s efficiency.
He didn’t expect Fang Heng to be able to provide so much help with the construction.
With this speed, they could greatly advance the schedule!
“Thank you for your hard work. Parason, take him to the lounge. You still have 18 hours.”
“Mr Fang Shuo, please follow me.”
Watching Fang Heng and Parason leave, a young man wearing a silver mask walked forward. “Do you need me to follow him?”
“No need. He was recommended by Old Black. We can trust him.”
“But...” the young man watched Fang Heng leave. “He has been wearing a mask and doesn’t want to show his real face. Do you want to check him?”
“No need. If he wants to hide his identity, he can’t be found even if he takes off his mask.”

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - Established
paragraphs: Fang Heng followed Parason out of the main control room in the third basement and took the elevator to the second floor.
The entire research institute was under Night Owl’s control.
Not only was the game map blocked, but even the survival radio couldn’t be used.
“Fang Shuo, the lounge is on the second floor. I’ll take you there now.”
“Thank you.”
“Your mechanical skill is very impressive. Is it related to your talent skill?”
“Yes.”
“With your help, we’ll be able to complete the construction of the stabilizer very soon.”
“I hope there are no accidents.”
Fang Heng replied. Under Parason’s guidance, he took the elevator to the second floor. After passing through a long pathway, he arrived at the door of a lounge.
Along the way, Fang Heng discovered that the guards on the second floor had been much more lax. Only the elevator entrance was guarded by two members of the Night Owl organization.
The entire passage was also empty.
“This is your room, 2239. This is the key. Please keep it well.”
Fang Heng took the key. “There doesn’t seem to be anyone here?”
“The second floor is full of temporary lounges and guest rooms. Very few people are here during the day.”
“Okay.” Fang Heng unlocked the door and stood at the door. He said, “You go ahead and get ready for the next phase of construction. I’ll be back after my energy points recover.”
“Okay, I’ll go back first.”
Parason was also concerned about the construction of the stabilizer. He nodded to Fang Heng and left quickly.
After closing the room door, Fang Heng tried to take out a simple bed from his backpack and threw it on the ground.
[Hint: The current environment is affected by a special factor. You are unable to use the simple bed’s offline function. Please leave the area and try again.]
Unable to go offline!
Fang Heng was not surprised by this. He had already received this news from Old Black in advance.
He then took out the blueprint that Old Black had sent from outside the game not long ago from his backpack and placed it on the table.
This blueprint was the layout of the research institute of the Meteorite Company.
After the Night Owl organization took over the research institute, they repaired and partially renovated the research institute.
The main building didn’t change much.
Especially the built-in ventilation duct.
Fang Heng quickly confirmed his position on the blueprint.
From the map, there was a large storage room behind the next corner.
The storage room was usually used to store goods, so there should be no one there.
There was also a ventilation duct in the storage room.
That was it!
Fang Heng left the room and walked to the door of the storage room. He knocked on the door.
After confirming that there was no reply from inside the room, he took out the wire from his backpack.
[Hint: You used the lock picking skill.]
[Hint: Your lock picking skill has failed authentication!]
[Hint: You have used the lock picking skill...]
[[Hint: Authentication successful. You have completed the lock picking. You have received skill-lock picking experience points +12.]
“Click...”
After several failed attempts, the door lock was opened.
Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered quickly.
Very good, there was no one there.
There were some damaged experimental equipment and miscellaneous items piled up in the storage room.
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at the ventilation duct above.
After waiting for more than twenty minutes, the rotating alchemy magic arrays gradually appeared under Fang Heng’s feet.
The resurrected Lickers came out of the alchemy magic arrays, with a few vine zombies mixed in.
After the Lickers were completely resurrected, Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to break through the ventilation duct’s entrance and enter one after another.
Combined with the information given by Old Black, the first-generation meteorite was hidden inside the research institute.
The Meteorite Company’s research institute’s design showed that the fifth, sixth and seventh basements were originally laboratories.

Considering that the first-generation meteorite would cause strong radiation, in order to minimize the radiation effect, storing the first-generation meteorite in the deepest part of the seventh basement was the optimal plan.
While thinking, Fang Heng controlled the Lickers in the ventilation duct to explore downward.
Soon, the Lickers sent a message.
After the ventilation duct entered the sixth basement, it was completely cut off.
The Lickers sensed the sound of a human being at the exit of the ventilation duct on the sixth basement.
“Looks like I have to wait...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
Pretending that nothing had happened, Fang Heng returned to the third basement.
Four hours later.
A game hint appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: You have completed the construction of the large-scale space tearing stabilizer.]
The large-scale space tearing stabilizer was completed!
“Good! Thank you for your hard work.”
Sikong Mao’s eyes flashed with unconcealable excitement.
“Parason, let’s begin.”
“Yes!”
The construction was completed more than ten hours ahead of schedule, and Parazon was in high spirits.
He immediately called the few researcher NPCs in the room to connect to the main world’s space tearing device. At the same time, he assigned the players to load the blue crystal raw ores.
Fang Heng stood quietly on the spot, looking at the busy players.

Sikong Mao walked to Fang Heng’s side. “Fang Shuo, there’s a high probability that the stabilizing device will malfunction during operation. Later, we still need you to stay here and ensure the normal operation of the teleportation passage.”
“No problem, leave it to me.”
Fang Heng nodded lightly and agreed immediately.
“Thank you.”
Sikong Mao clenched his fists.
After setting up for so long, the Night Owl organization had finally taken the first step in their plan.
He could not help but feel a little excited.
Fang Heng asked, “Is it a passage that crosses the game world?”
“That’s right, the other end of the passage comes from the Vampire Apocalypse.”
He guessed it right!
Night Owl’s series of arrangements were all related to the Vampire Apocalypse!
Fang Heng was about to ask more questions when another NPC research personel walked up and asked in a low voice.

“Mr Sikong, the blue crystal raw ores have been filled up. The efficiency of the raw ore’s energy conversion is extremely low. According to the current blue crystal raw ore reserve, it’s estimated that it can only maintain the passage open for about 20 minutes. Are we ready to open it?”
“The energy is enough. Let’s begin.”
Parason and the other two NPC researchers sat in front of the main control console, controlling the stabilizer to perform docking operations.
“We have received a parallel world signal.”
“Docking is in progress.”
“Docking completed. Confirming the docking point. Passage is being established...”
The stabilizer at the center of the control center kept shaking. Circles of blue energy waves radiated out from the stabilizer.
“What’s the situation?”
“Is there a problem?”
“The fluctuation range is still within the normal range...”
The fluctuation phenomenon produced by the amplifier made the players a little nervous. They couldn’t help but whisper in low voices.
Parason frowned and said in a low voice, “Don’t be nervous! This is a normal phenomenon, it’s the energy dissipation caused by using low-level energy!”
“Sizzle Sizzle Sizzle...”
As soon as he finished speaking, the space in the center of the control room showed a strange distortion.
Parason saw this and ordered loudly, “Quick! Increase the power! Adjust it to the maximum! Quick!”
Hearing this, the two assistant researchers immediately adjusted the power to the maximum.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The space was distorted to the extreme and a black crack appeared in the middle!
Blue electric currents were constantly flashing in the crack.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Invasion
paragraphs: “Whoosh!!!”
Two thick blue energy beams shot out from the stabilizers’ top, directly hitting the spatial rift.
A strong light flashed and all the players couldn’t help but lower their heads.
They looked up again.
A blue, rippling passage that looked like the surface of the water appeared in the centre of the control centre hall.
The ripples trembled slightly.
A female player with long chestnut hair stepped out of the time passage.
She was a foreigner.
She had a delicate face and looked to be in her early twenties. She had a pair of blue eyes.
Fang Heng looked at her from afar.
He felt a strange sense of familiarity with the woman.
Emilia walked out of the time passage.
She closed her eyes and tried to breathe the air of the Zombie Apocalypse.
“Marquis Emilia! Welcome, great vampires.”
Sikong Mao suppressed the excitement in his heart and slightly bowed.
The other Night Owl organization players and NPCs also imitated Sikong Mao and slightly bowed to Emilia to show their respect.
Only Fang Heng was standing in a corner.
Emilia seemed to have sensed something. She suddenly reached out her hand and signalled Sikong Mao to be silent.
Her blue eyes focused on Fang Heng. She walked toward Fang Heng Step by step until she stopped in front of Fang Heng.
Everyone looked at Fang Heng in confusion.
Fang Heng calmly looked at Emilia.
He felt a faint sense of familiarity with Emilia.
“What a surprise. I can see my kind here.”
“My kind?”
Fang Heng suddenly understood.
That’s right!
Vampires!
This sense of familiarity came from their bloodline.
Sikong Mao frowned, feeling extremely puzzled.
He was also a vampire?
But why did he appear in Server 5 Zombie Apocalypse?
“My name is Emilia, I’m from the Ruimur clan,” Emilia smiled and said, “How should I address you?”
“Fang Shuo.”
Sikong Mao stepped forward and explained, “Emilia, this is Fang Shuo. With his help, we were able to complete the time passage stabilizer in such a short period.”
Emilia averted her gaze from Fang Heng.
“Mr Sikong, just like what the rumours say, you are a trustworthy partner.”
“As promised, time is of the essence. Can we begin?”
Emilia raised her head to look at the time and continued, “The construction of the passage is faster than expected. There are still two hours before sunset and we still need Mr Sikong’s help.”
“I’m willing to help.”
As the few of them were talking, the time passage that had been opened started to fluctuate again.
Eh? What was that?
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and looked at the time passage.
A few humans carrying boxes of materials walked out of the teleportation passage.
No! They were not humans!
They looked almost the same as humans on the outside, but the spine of their bodies was strangely bent. The hair on their bodies had fallen off, and their exposed skin was frighteningly pale.
Blood slaves!
These two words appeared in Fang Heng’s mind, and at the same time, he felt a sense of disgust from the bottom of his heart.
Blood slaves were the product of failure after receiving the inheritance of vampires.
They did not die, but they also did not successfully advance to become vampires and turn into a kind of inferior life form.

The evolution failed and the physical quality of the blood slaves did not improve. Instead, they became extremely afraid of the sun and they needed to drink blood every once in a while to maintain their lives.
In the Vampire Apocalypse, the blood slaves were considered to be unclean degenerates.
They were the lowest level creature, even worse than humans who were kept in captivity. They could only do some low-level labour.
Apart from that, the low-level blood slaves were born to submit to the high-level vampires.
Therefore, even though the orthodox vampires despised creatures like the blood slaves, they all admitted that using them as slaves was the most convenient method.

The blood slaves moved the boxes filled with blue square crystals into the hall through the teleportation passage as the energy source for the stabilizer. Then, they moved the remaining blue crystal raw ores in the hall back through the teleportation passage.

“Before that, we still need to replenish the energy source for the stabilizer. When night falls, the vampires from the Ruimur clan will officially launch a war against the Federation players in District 5.”
Emilia smiled. “Mr Sikong, are you ready?”
“Of course. I’ve been looking forward to this day for a long time.”
Sikong nodded. “Be careful of the Federation’s sniping. When the time comes, I’ll stay here to prevent the Federation’s surprise attack from destroying the teleportation passage.”
In the Federation’s meeting hall.

The high-ranking military officers of District 5 Zombie Apocalypse were having a long-distance meeting to review the events that happened in Shelter No. 2 last night, trying to figure out the movements of Night Owl and the other anti-federal organizations.
Before they could figure out the reason, the door of the meeting room in the main hall was pushed open.
A soldier hurriedly handed a report to the commander of District 5’s United Front commander, Qian Yuan.
“Minister Qian, the latest emergency information.”
Seeing the contents of the report, Qian Yuan’s expression changed.
He nodded and signalled the soldier to announce the contents.
“Yes!”

The soldier faced the officers and announced, “Five minutes ago, a large-scale spatial fluctuation appeared in Zombie Apocalypse District 5. The intensity of the fluctuation was 100-150 times greater than the fluctuation near our second shelter yesterday.”
“According to the intelligence analysis, a space tearing passage across worlds is being established in District 5.”
Almost at the same time, two words appeared in the minds of all the participants.
Dimensional invasion!
Server 5 was being invaded by other dimensional worlds!
A high ranking Federation officer asked, “Where is the location of the disturbance?”
“Currently searching. We have confirmed that it is within the Eastern region of the Federation’s District 5.”
“In half an hour, we will be able to determine within an error range of 1000 kilometres. In two hours, we will be able to locate the exact coordinates of the passage.”
“Which world is it from?”

“We have yet to receive any reports from other worlds. The cost of invading a low-tier game world from a high-tier world is too high. The intelligence department has determined that it is an invasion from the same dimension. There is a high probability that it is the Vampire Apocalypse.”
The hearts of all the military officers in the Eastern region sank.
This was troublesome.

The danger level of the Vampire Apocalypse and the Zombie Apocalypse were on par. However, the overall strength of the players in the Vampire Apocalypse was stronger than that of the players in the Zombie Apocalypse!
Qian Yuan said in a deep voice, “I announce that Server 5 has entered an emergency state. Everyone is online and ready for battle.”
“Gather everyone within half an hour and attack the source of the teleportation point in one hour. We must win this battle!”
“Yes!”
Two hours passed in the blink of an eye.
The sky gradually darkened.
The entire central control room was filled with a large number of low-level vampires.
The real vampires looked no different from ordinary humans.

They could walk openly under the sun. They also had a physique and vitality that exceeded that of ordinary people. They could also gather strength from their blood and quickly recover their life by absorbing blood.

After advancing to the middle-level vampires, the vampires could have higher blood control abilities. Their biggest characteristic was that their vitality had greatly increased. They could also transform into vampire bats within a short period and could fly for a short period.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Blood Slave
paragraphs: “I don’t think we need them anymore.”
Emilia was thinking about something.
High-level vampires possessed powerful energy. Rashly entering the passage would cause the passage to become chaotic or even collapse.
It would take some time for the time passage to stabilize. Only then would mid-level vampires be able to gradually enter the battlefield through the teleportation passage.
Sikong Mao walked forward and said, “Emilia, the Federation has completed locating the time passage and confirmed its location.”

“20 minutes ago, a large number of Federation players entered the wilderness. The other anti-federation forces are working together to resist the invasion of the Federation army. They won’t be able to hold on for long.”

“Mr Sikong, according to our agreement, the safety of the time passage will be left to you. The follow-up support of the vampires will also come through the teleportation passage to join the frontline battlefield.”
“Vampires are most suitable for fighting at night. Their combat power will be greatly weakened during the day. We can’t waste time.”
“Understood. I will protect the passage well.”
Before leaving, Emilia glanced at Fang Heng.
“It’s rare to see a player with such a pure bloodline and it happens to be in District 5. How did you do it, Fang Shuo?”
“Secret.”
“Alright, Fang Shuo, I’m leaving now. Do you want to come?”
“I’m sorry, I don’t like to participate in battles and I need to stay here to look after it.”
Fang Heng pointed at the central time passage and shook his head. “It may break easily.”
“What a pity. I still want to share fresh blood with you.”
Emilia used her finger to brush her lips.
“Next time.”
As she moved her gaze away from Fang Heng, Emilia’s pupils were covered with a layer of silver.
Suddenly, Fang Heng felt a surge of blood.
All the vampires in the hall faced Emilia and knelt on one knee to show their submission.
After Emilia left the hall, the low-level vampires stood up and followed Emilia out of the main control room.
The departure of the vampires’ army greatly reduced the pressure on the players.
With a large number of vampires present, they felt like they were prey.
The door of the teleportation passage was still open.
An endless stream of low-level vampires entered Zombie Apocalypse District 5 through the time passage.
The newly arrived vampires didn’t stay in the hall. After stepping out of the time passage, they followed Emilia.

“The Federation will attack the research institute soon. I’ll bring some people to set up guards outside. Su Jincheng, you’ll be in charge of the research institute for the time being. If there’s anything urgent, contact me.”
A young man stood out. “Understood!”
“Units 3, 4, 5 and 6, follow me!”
“The rest of the members will enter emergency combat mode!”
“Yes!”
Fang Heng stood aside and watched as Sikong Mao led a large group of Night Owl organization players out of the main control room.
The opportunity that he had been waiting for was finally coming.
Just like Fang Heng’s original plan.
After completely opening the teleportation passage, Sikong Mao had already begun to trust him.
Sikong Mao would leave the research institute to carry out the next step of his plan to destroy the Federation.
The interior of the research institute was empty. This was the best time for him to search for the first-generation meteorite!
Wait a little longer.
After Sikong Mao had completely left the research institute, he would go to the sixth basement to take a look.
To avoid being discovered, it was best to first turn off the internal surveillance of the research institute.
He had to think of a way.
Fang Heng focused his gaze on the few blood slaves in the room and fell into deep thought.
Vampires could control the blood slaves through the strength of their blood.
He also had the vampire bloodline. Could he control the blood slaves to do some work?
Fang Heng had a premonition that with the vampire bloodline, he could give some orders to the blood slaves.
The blood slaves’ bodies stiffened. They sensed something and slowly raised their heads to look at Fang Heng. Their pupils emitted a turbid yellow light.
“Go.”
Fang Heng made a mouth gesture and a layer of red light enveloped his pupils.
The blood slaves received Fang Heng’s order and slowly walked toward the space tearing device in the centre of the hall.
[Hint: Due to your vampire bloodline, you have given an order to the blood slaves.]
[Hint: Your current vampire bloodline level is Level 7. You can control up to 20 blood slaves at the same time. Controlling the blood slaves will consume a small amount of mental strength.]
[Hint: The blood slaves can perform some tasks and basic operations, but they cannot perform operations such as producing or building.]
Success!
Fang Heng quickly checked the mission log.
There were a lot of restrictions on controlling the blood slaves. Not to mention the limited number, the blood slaves could not produce yet. They were not as useful as the zombie clones.
“Hey! What are you doing?”
Parason, who had been paying attention to the operation of the stabilizer, was the first to notice the strange actions of the blood slaves. He shouted at them.
More than ten blood slaves turned a deaf ear to Parason’s words and continued to walk toward the time passage stabilizer in the centre.
What the hell!
In his panic, Parason suddenly dared to rush forward and pull a blood slave.
“I said stop! Don’t go near there!”
The blood slaves were grabbed and stopped on the spot. The remaining blood slaves continued to walk forward slowly.
“Hurry! Stop them!”
Parason was going crazy. He couldn’t understand why these low-level blood slaves were so interested in the stabilizers.
Su Jincheng immediately ordered the players to help. “Hurry! Help Him! Stop those vampires!”
The players of the Night Owl organization went up one after another and blocked the blood slaves who were trying to get close to the stabilizer of the central teleportation passage.
Taking advantage of the chaos, Fang Heng walked to the main control console alone and looked through the internal information of the research institute.
Soon, Fang Heng found the internal structure of the research institute.

It was very strange. The structure only showed buildings on the first to sixth basements, and there was an automatic protection alarm device on the sixth basement. It could detect the intrusion of living beings and send out an alarm.
Fang Heng tried it but found that he could not directly turn off the alarm remotely.
After a careful check, it turned out that the sixth basement had a separate control system, which was controlled entirely in the sixth basement.
Fang Heng called up the research institute’s internal surveillance system.
The surveillance system only reflected the situation on the pathway outside the laboratory in the sixth basement.
Fang Heng called up the surveillance system and counted them one by one.
There were already eight Night Owl organization players guarding the interior of the passage alone.
“The security is so tight... looks like I have to find another way to go to the sixth basement.”
Fang Heng muttered softly and quickly came up with a plan.
He lightly tapped a few buttons on the main console and manually shut down the surveillance camera and video recording function in the research institute, emptying the recording.
After doing all this, Fang Heng opened the game log again.
At this time, the Lickers were entrenched in the ventilation duct.
It was up to them.
Under Fang Heng’s control, two Lickers were rapidly climbing to the sixth basement of the research institute through the ventilation duct system in the shelter.
On the other side, Parason and the Night Owl organization players had to spend a lot of effort to control the blood slaves that had gone out of control.
“What’s going on?”
“I don’t know.”
Parason was also baffled. He wiped the sweat off his forehead and nervously looked up at the big screen.
His gaze was focused on the various values of the teleportation stabilizer, afraid that something would suddenly go wrong with the teleportation stabilizer.
Fortunately, all the values were normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Alert Triggered
paragraphs: “What’s the situation in the passage?”
Su Jincheng was also nervous. He walked to Parason and asked.
“It’s not bad.”
Parason had just taken a breath and was about to say something.
The next second, the entire shelter sounded an alarm.
“Alert! Alert!”
“Unknown lifeform has been detected!”
“Alert! Alert!”
Su Jincheng’s already tense nerves were triggered again. He asked loudly, “What’s the situation?”
“It’s an alert from the sixth basement. An unauthorized creature has been detected!”
A research personnel lowered his head to control the main control system. He was sweating profusely.
“Unauthorized creature? What’s that?”
“I’m not sure, I’m still checking...”
“It’s the Licker Invasion.”
Fang Heng interrupted the conversation between the two and conveniently controlled the main control console. He switched the screen projection to a monitor on the sixth basement.
“Dong! Dong Dong!!”
On the screen, the ventilation duct’s net was forcefully pushed open by the Lickers.
Two Lickers crawled out from the ventilation duct and quickly climbed along the wall.
In the corridor, two members of the Night Owl organization realized the zombie invasion and immediately pulled out their guns and fired.
“Bang, Bang, Bang, Bang!!”
The passage was narrow and the Lickers were immediately hit by a few bullets.
However, the bullets didn’t stop the Lickers. They continued to move along the ceiling at an extremely fast speed and passed over the two players of the Night Owl organization.
“Not good! They’re heading towards the central research room!”
Fang Heng once again switched to the surveillance screen, positioning the screen outside the research room in the sixth basement.
The four Night Owl organization players were ready for battle. They held their automatic rifles tightly in their hands and faced the corner of the passage.
“Shoosh!”
Two red shadows flashed past the corner.
“Bang Bang Bang!!! Bang Bang! Bang Bang!”
The four players pulled the trigger almost at the same time.
The Lickers kept changing its angle and flew along the wall towards the Night Owl player.
“They’re coming!”
A flashbang was thrown out of the player’s hand.
“Pa!”
A strong light flashed.
“Weng...”
The ultra-high frequency sound wave emitted by the flashbang was a great restraint on the Lickers.
Affected by the sound wave, the two Lickers lost their sense of direction and fell from the air.
“Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Following that, the bullets landed on the two Lickers.
Su Jincheng stared at the screen.
The Lickers on the screen looked very familiar.
He thought of the group of Lickers he saw outside the Federation’s shelter last night.
Vaguely, Su Jincheng noticed a red light appearing under the Lickers’ skin.
“Oh no!”
Su Jincheng suddenly shouted, “Run!!!”
“Boom!!!”
He was still one step too late. The two Lickers’ bodies exploded in the passage.
Red blood splashed out in all directions.
The four players were still quite far away. Two of them were unlucky, but the blood splashed on the silver mask.
Almost instantly, the thin layer of the silver mask was dissolved by the blood!
The blood stained the skin.
The two players immediately cried out in pain and subconsciously reached out to touch the silver mask.
The blood had dissolved a large part of their faces.
When their hands touched it, it was instantly a bloody mess!
“F*ck! Don’t move! Don’t touch the wound!”
The other two players were also shocked by the horrifying scene. They immediately took out the first aid spray, grabbed the struggling victims and sprayed wildly at the wounds.
Affected by the explosion, a large part of the passage was corroded by the Lickers’ blood.
In front of the monitor screen, the players looked serious.
“The Lickers with the self-destruct ability is the same batch that we saw last night.”
Sikong Mao was not here and Su Jincheng knew that he could not control the situation in front of him.
He forced himself to remain calm. He looked at Parason and asked, “Are they from the Federation?”
“I don’t know. The Federation isn’t that fast, right? And aren’t they still dealing with the vampires outside? It doesn’t make sense that they’ve already broken into the shelter...”
“Then where did they come from?”
“How do I know... Have you contacted Sikong Mao?”
“I’ve already contacted him. Due to the signal, I haven’t received a reply yet.”
“Then what should we do?”
Parason was very nervous. He was both shocked and afraid.

Fortunately, the two Lickers did not come towards the central stabilizer. Otherwise, once they self-destructed, the entire passage stabilizer would be paralyzed and the time passage would be destroyed!
Fang Heng pursed his lips and switched the big screen projection to the ventilation duct’s exit.
“Both of you, now is not the time to argue. I don’t think we should sit and wait for death. From the current situation, the Lickers entered the shelter through the ventilation duct as an entrance.”

Fang Heng encouraged him at the right time, “There are no internal surveillance cameras in the laboratory on the sixth basement. Should we go there and check? It would be better to seal the ventilation duct’s exit as well.”
“And those wounded...”
After Fang Heng’s reminder, Su Jincheng and Parason couldn’t help but look at each other.
That’s right!
The sixth basement!
That was the secret research room that Sikong Mao had specially set up. It was also part of this plan.
There must be no mistakes!
Su Jincheng gathered all his men and left a portion of the Night Owl players to guard the time passage. He brought another group of players and rushed to the sixth basement to provide support.

In the passage opening on the sixth basement, a few Night Owl players were guarding below the entrance of the ventilation duct that had been broken open. They aimed their muzzles at the opening of the ventilation duct and were on guard against Lickers who could jump out of the passage at any time.
“Have you checked them all?”
“I’ve roughly checked them, but the ventilation duct is very deep. I don’t know where the Lickers invaded from.”
One Night Owl player was still frightened. He shrunk his neck and carefully explained, “We can’t climb into the ventilation duct and thoroughly check it.”
Fang Heng followed Su Jincheng and the other players and raised his head to look at the ventilation duct entrance above.
It was dark inside the entrance.
The space inside the ventilation duct was narrow. It was troublesome for an ordinary person to turn around. If they met a Licker, they would be courting death.
Su Jincheng also realized the problem and frowned.
“Think of a way to seal it first. Seal the other ventilation duct openings as well.”
“Yes!”
Fang Heng curled his lips and asked, “What’s the situation in the laboratory? Is there a ventilation duct opening inside?”
“This, the security level in the laboratory is even higher. We don’t know.”
Su Jincheng’s heart tightened again when he heard that.
“Let’s go! Bring me to take a look!”
Su Jincheng brought everyone to the laboratory’s door and verified their identities before opening the metal door.
Everything in the laboratory was safe and sound.
More than ten researchers raised their heads at the same time and looked at the people outside the door.
Seeing the scene in the laboratory, Fang Heng’s pupils suddenly constricted.
This...
Cultivation pods?!
More than half of the entire sixth basement laboratory was occupied by large cultivation pods.
Many researchers were doing data calculations around the cultivation pods.
Fang Heng had a rough look and there were at least 40 of them.
More importantly, Fang Heng found that these cultivation pods were extremely familiar!

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - Cultivation Pod
paragraphs: Could it be...
Fang Heng’s heart pounded wildly.
“There’s been an accident on the sixth basement. We need to check it out. It’ll be quick. ”
Su Jincheng waved his hand as he spoke. The Night Owl players behind him rushed into the room one after another and began to check every corner of the room.
Fang Heng carefully walked to the front of the cultivation pod and observed it.
Inside the cultivation pod, a Tyrant form was soaking in a special solution.
Fang Heng was ecstatic.
Wasn’t that the Tyrant form evolution device that he had found in Meteorite Company in Pine City?
Back then, he had used the same device to evolve a normal zombie clone into a Tyrant form!
The Night Owl organization had actually achieved such a step and could create infinite controllable Tyrant forms?
Fang Heng’s heart was perturbed. He stretched out his hand and gently pressed on the evolution device.
A series of game hints appeared in his vision.
“Item: Tyrant T103’s cultivation pod (mass-produced) . ”
“It’s him, all right!” Fang Heng thought.
His heart was getting more and more excited.
Fang Heng once again looked around the entire laboratory.
There were a total of 42 Tyrant form evolution devices!
Based on the 30% success rate, there should be at least 10 Tyrant forms that could successfully complete the evolution.
If he was greedy enough, he could think of a way to leave a mechanical cultivation pod and fusion culture fluid and bring them all back for research!
With the evolution device, he could definitely greatly increase the speed of experimentation on Tyrant forms!
“Fang Shuo, what do you think? Isn’t it amazing? ”
When Parason saw Fang Heng standing in front of the Tyrant form cultivation pods, he also walked over and stood beside him.
“This is a Tyrant form cultivation pod? ”
Parason, feeling quite proud, nodded and said, “Yes, this is a secret of our research institute. Don’t leak it out. ”
“But why are there so many? You can already mass produce them yourself? ”
“We only did some repairs. Mr. Sikong was the one who got people to collect these. ”
Parason put his hand on the cultivation pod and explained, “Over the years, Mr. Sikong has been trying to use his special talent skill to control the Tyrants. ”
“Talent? His talent is to control zombies? ”
Fang Heng was very surprised to find out that there was someone with similar talent to him.
He thought of the group of zombies that attacked the federal shelter the night before.
Was that group of zombies controlled by Sikong Mao?

“It’s not exactly controlling. Mr. Sikong’s special talent can temporarily control the hatred of the zombie team and make them cooperate to attack the Federation army team. Coincidentally, the Tyrant forms are products of Meteorite Company’s biological weapon project. The company has been trying to control Tyrant forms through spirit. We have done many experiments to modify the Tyrant forms. Only the combination of the Tyrant forms and Mr. Sikong Mao’s talent skill has shown considerable effectiveness. ”

Parason continued, “Currently, Mr. Sikong can already control the Tyrant forms within a short period of time and give more complicated battle orders to them. Unfortunately, due to the influence of mental strength, after controlling the Tyrant forms for a short period of time, they will still enter a rampage state and can only be considered. So, they are just half-finished products for one-time experiments. It took us eight years to gather this batch of Tyrant forms. ”
“Impressive. ”
Despite his praise, Fang Heng didn’t feel particularly amazed.
It sounded like Sikong Mao’s ability was much weaker than his own, so he was relieved.
Fang Heng shifted his gaze to a large room behind the laboratory that was separated by a glass door.
There was no one in the room, and there were five giant empty coffins.
“What about those? What’s in the coffins? ”
Parason followed Fang Heng to the front of the glass.
“Giant zombies are placed inside. ”
“Giant zombies? Tier 5 mutated zombies? ”
Fang Heng was shocked once again.
Then, he couldn’t help but feel ecstatic, thinking that the research institute was basically a treasure trove!
The night before, he didn’t manage to get a live sample of a giant zombie, so he felt shortchanged.
But now, an opportunity was here!
He didn’t need the live sample anymore. He just needed to bring the whole frozen giant zombie back!
But, how could he bring back such a big giant zombie?
For a moment, Fang Heng was a little troubled.
He really wanted to move the entire research institute back.
Parason couldn’t see Fang Heng’s happiness under the mask. Seeing that Fang Heng didn’t say anything for a long time, he thought that Fang Heng was shocked by the five giant zombies.
He felt that although Fang Heng was very good at mechanical maintenance, he was still an amateur in zombie research.
The laboratory on the sixth basement was the result of the hard work of Parason over the years. He couldn’t help but want to show off in front of Fang Heng.
“Well, to tell you the truth, we spent a lot of effort collecting these giant zombies over the years, especially putting them into hibernation mode. It’s a very troublesome process. ”
Fang Heng keenly sensed something. Inwardly, he mused, “Wait. A Tier 5 zombie is extremely powerful. How did Night Owl manage to put the Tier 5 zombies into hibernation mode? ”
Fang Heng immediately asked, “How did you do that? ”
“It was through the initial... ”
Parason’s words were about to come out of his mouth, but he suddenly froze.
“Ignore what I said, Mr. Fang Shuo. I’m sorry. This is our organization’s internal secret. ”
“It’s okay. I understand. ”
Fang Heng waved his hand, feeling a little disappointed. He pretended to have no ulterior motives and said, “I overstepped my boundaries. ”

Parason uttered, “Originally, there were eight giant zombies here. We lost three in the previous operation, and now, there are only five left. They are currently frozen. Mr. Sikong said that if the Tyrants alone can not resist the Federation, we will thaw the giant zombies. Then, Mr. Sikong will use his special ability to shift the hatred and use them to stop the Federation. ”
“I didn’t expect Mr. Sikong to be able to control Tier 5 mutated zombies. He probably possesses an S-level talent, right? ”
“That’s right. ”
While they were talking, Su Jincheng and the Night Owl players had already carefully searched the interior of the laboratory in the sixth basement.
“There’s no sign of an invasion, and we haven’t found any ventilation ducts that connect to the outside. ”
“Okay. ”
Su Jincheng finally let out a sigh of relief. He turned around and looked at Parason and Fang Heng.
“We’ve contacted Mr. Sikong. He wants us to return to the teleportation passage immediately. ”
“I’ll handle the Licker inside the ventilation duct. ”
“Wait a minute. What about behind that door? Are you sure you guys don’t want to check it out? ”
Fang Heng pointed at a metal door at the back of the laboratory and walked toward it.
He had noticed the metal door a long time ago.
“Don’t. ”
Parason quickly took two steps forward to stop Fang Heng. “Don’t open that door. ”
“Why? ”
“Don’t ask. There’s nothing inside. Let’s go back quickly. Ever since Mr. Sikong left, my heart has been pounding. I keep feeling like something is going to happen. ”
“All right. ”
Fang Heng shrugged and no longer insisted. He left the laboratory in the sixth basement with the others.
Before leaving, Fang Heng took one last look at the heavy metal door.
The surface of the metal door seemed matte, hinting that it was made of a special alloy, one that was used to
It seemed to be used to prevent radiation from spreading.
