chapters.title: Chapter 371 - Disadvantaged
paragraphs: “Ruoruo, the head of the Xiao family happens to be out of town these two days. He won’t be back until two days later. ”
“Mr. Sun, here. This is the present I brought for you when I went on a trip to the capital last week. These are for Mdm. Zhang, Mr. Li, and Mdm. Chen. ”
Xiao Ruoruo handed over a few beautifully wrapped gifts with both hands.
“Ruoruo, you’re too kind. I’ll have Mdm. Zhang cook something delicious for you tonight. ”
“Thank you, Mr. Sun. I’m craving steamed chicken. ”
“Okay. I’ll take you to the guest room first. ”
Butler Sun liked Xiao Ruoruo very much. He led her to the guest room to rest.
“Hmm? Mr. Sun, am I not staying in Room No. 3 this time? ”
“The guest room on the east side is occupied. It’s not appropriate for men and women to live in proximity. This time, I’ve arranged for you to stay in the guest room on the west side. ”
“Huh? Are there other guests? ”
“Yes, it is the family head’s guest and also a friend of Mr. Mo Jiawei. ”
“Mr. Mo? ”
Xiao Ruoruo was a little surprised.
She and Mo Jiawei had played together since they were young.
She remembered that Mo Jiawei loved to play, but he almost never brought his friends to his house.
“But, why would Mr.Mo’s friend be staying here? ”
Xiao Ruoruo’s eyes lit up, and she asked, “Is he here to borrow books like me? ”
“Yes, Mr. Fang has been staying here for quite some time. ”
“Oh. Is he learning Occult as well? Can I ask him for advice? ”
“Well... I think it’s better not to. ”
Butler Sun pondered for a moment and sighed silently in his heart. Exasperated, he thought, “It’s better not to ask Fang Heng for advice and learn stuff you shouldn’t. ”
“We’re here, Ruoruo. This is Room No. 8. ”
Bringing Xiao Ruoruo into the room, Butler Sun unconsciously frowned.
There was a huge floor-to-ceiling window by the side of the garden in the room. Originally, they would have been able to see the small bridge and flowing water in the garden through the window.
But now, they could only see piles of broken stones beside the small bridge and flowing water.
It was a failed surprise.
“This is... ”
Xiao Ruoruo was stunned for a moment, and she covered her mouth in surprise.
Butler Sun felt his head throb.

“Ruo Ruo, sorry that you had to see this. These stones were temporarily stored there by the guest in Room No. 2. He said that they were of high value. I’ve already told him that I will soon send someone to move these broken stones away. ”
“Butler Sun, are you serious? ”
Xiao Ruoruo’s gaze stopped on those so-called broken stones.
“Those aren’t broken stones. Those are all raw blue crystal ores. ”
“Huh? What ores? ”

Xiao Ruoruo uttered with a hint of excitement in her voice, “In Occult, raw blue crystal ores contain natural energy. They’re very rare. Although they don’t contain much natural energy, they have a very high research value. ”
Butler Sun was at a loss. He saw that Xiao Ruoruo’s little face was red.
“Oh, I forgot. Mr. Sun doesn’t know Occult. I’ll go over and take a look. ”
Xiao Ruoruo hadn’t seen the raw blue crystal ores with her own eyes. She ran straight to the back garden.
Butler Sun was confused. He didn’t understand young people nowadays.
“No Way. Could it really be some precious ore? ” he thought.
At 10:30 p.m., a great battle broke out in District Five.
Vampires invaded!
In the command room of Zombie Apocalypse District 5, the federation players were in a terrible state.
Urgent reports were made one after another to Qian Yuan.
“Reporting! Shelter No. 1 has been attacked by a large number of vampires! ”
“Reporting! Shelters No. 2, 5, 6, 7, and 8 have been attacked by vampires! ”
“Reporting! Shelter No. 1 has sent a request for help. It can last another 20 minutes at most. ”
In the game, reports of various shelters being attacked kept ringing out.
One bad news after another caused the atmosphere in the hall to drop to a freezing point.
Qian Yuan’s face was extremely gloomy.
Request for help?
Where to ask for help?
Could it be to ask for help in the high-dimensional game?
They could only rely on themselves in the Invasion War of the world.
However, as the chief commander, Qian Yuan could not say such words to hurt the team’s morale.

“Tell the people of Shelter No. 1 to retreat. The reinforcements from the western region, the northern region, and the southern region are already on their way. Hold up against this wave and counterattack tomorrow morning. ”
They relied on the other three regions to replenish their player forces, and the reinforcements from the vampires were also pouring into the battlefield.
However, Qian Yuan knew very well that fighting on home ground guaranteed victory of the Federation.
The Federation could not afford to lose.
If they failed, the entire District 5 would fall into the hands of the anti-federation forces.
Qian Yuan thought that the only chance to kill was in the time passage.
As long as they could destroy the time passage, the backup troops of the vampires would not be able to reach the battlefield.
Qian Yuan had already made a plan in the first instance. All the elite teams in District 5 of the Federation had been sent out to destroy the time passage.
Destroying the passage was key to victory.
Meanwhile, inside the main control room of District 5’s research institute, the time passage was still in operation.
An endless stream of low-level vampires entered District 5 through the teleportation passage and headed to the battlefield on the front line.
Fang Heng stood in front of the command station. He seemed to be observing the situation outside, but in fact, he was using the game log to control the zombie team.
The ventilation duct inside the research institute was directly connected to the sewer.
The sewer was connected to the outside of the research institute.
Even though Night Owl had already set up a defense and sealed a few connecting points in advance, it didn’t make things difficult for Fang Heng.
He spent some time getting the zombie clones to dig at the sealed passages again.
Outside, Night Owl and the federal forces were fighting for their lives. They didn’t have the time to bother with the small zombie team that was staggering toward the sewer under the night sky.
Ever since Fang Heng saw the Tyrant form cultivation pods in the sixth basement a few hours ago, he grew greedy.
There were a total of 42 Tyrant form cultivation pods. Taking that into consideration, he didn’t have enough vine zombies.
From the morning until now, it took more than ten hours for the vine zombies to reach the sewer.
Next, Fang Heng had them enter the ventilation duct through the sewer, climb to the second floor to get tools, and then climb back to the sixth basement.
Fang Heng was controlling the zombie team from a distance when he suddenly sense something.
Fang Heng turned around and looked toward the time passage, narrowing his eyes.
He could feel that the approaching vampires were stronger than the low-level vampires from before.
“Mid-level vampires... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself.
The time passage began to stabilize after running for a while.
The mid-level vampires also began to pass through the passage.
Fang Heng looked away and lowered his head to observe the situation outside through the surveillance monitors.
Outside the shelter, the Night Owl organization had already fought with the Federation elites.
The weapons and equipment of the Federation were more advanced, and their players’ physiques were better.

However, Sikong Mao’s side had long been prepared for battle. They had the geographical advantage of the research institute being behind them. Besides, it was nighttime, adding to the Federation’s disadvantage.
The battle had entered its climax.
However, Fang Heng was well-aware of the situation.
The Federation did not bring about any real threat to the research institute, and Sikong Mao had not even revealed his trump card.
However, at the very least, the Federation had given Sikong Mao a certain amount of pressure, forcing him to direct his attention away from inside the research institute.
It was time to make a move!

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - Secret Plan
paragraphs: Fang Heng opened the game log.
The vine zombie team had successfully entered the ventilation duct and was heading to the storage room on the second floor.
Fang Heng glanced at Su Jincheng, who was a little anxious.
Su Jincheng had been worried about the Licker in the ventilation duct. He was barely holding his uneasiness in.
Seeing that, Fang Heng immediately controlled the zombie team hidden in the ventilation duct to gather at the control center hall in the third basement.
“Alert! Alert! Unknown creature has been detected! ”
Soon, another ear-piercing alarm sounded in the main control room.
Su Jincheng’s heart was in his throat. He stood up from his seat with a whoosh.
“What’s going on? ! ”
“Lickersa! A large number of Lickers detected! ”
The researcher’s forehead was covered with cold sweat, and he looked panicked.
On the surveillance monitors, more than ten Lickers crawled out of the broken ventilation duct!
Earlier, there were only two Lickers, and they had already caused so much trouble.
“Not good! They are coming toward our main control room! ”
“Quick! Gather all of the teams! ” Su Jincheng immediately ordered.
What was bound to come had come!

It had been three hours since anything had happened. Su Jincheng was still trying to convince himself that what had just happened was just an accident. Who knew that as soon as he relaxed, a large number of Lickers appeared.
“Stop them! We must not let them destroy the teleportation passage! ”

Fang Heng turned to look at Su Jincheng and reminded him calmly, “Mr. Su, I suggest that you don’t let the Lickers break into the main control room. From the surveillance footage just now, after the Lickers self-destruct, their highly corrosive blood spews over a wide range. A slight corrosion could cause damage to the stabilizer and affect the normal operation of the teleportation passage. ”
“D*mn it! Parason, come with me! ”
Su Jincheng clearly realized how tricky the situation was. He quickly counted his men and personally led them to guard the passage entrance.
Parason was scared to death, but he still followed the team out to check the situation.
Instantly, there were only five Night Owl players and three NPC researcher survivors left in the main control room.
The researchers were busy in front of the command station while the five Night Owl players were guarding the entrance of the main control room.
However, their minds were mostly focused on the big screen in the control room.
The big screen was playing the surveillance footage of the various passages in the third basement.
“There’s a fluctuation in the stabilizer’s energy. You guys, quickly go and check the operation of the stabilizer! ” Fang Heng found a random excuse to send the three NPC researcher survivors away.
“Yes! ”
He then walked to the main control platform.
Clearing his throat, Fang Heng pressed the loudspeaker button for the sixth basement.

“Warning! Lickers detected! Attention, large numbers of Lickers have been detected approaching the sixth basement. Estimated arrival in five minutes. Please protect and help evacuate the researchers to the research personnel lounge in the fifth basement. The ventilation duct on the fifth basement has been cleaned and reinforced. Before receiving new orders, please protect the research personnel and guard the passage to the fifth basement. ”
Fang Heng continued, “I repeat! Warning! Lickers detected... ”
In the sixth basement, four Night Owl organization players who were standing guard heard the warning from the loudspeaker and immediately felt a chill run down their spines.

They had limited manpower, to begin with. Not long ago, two of them were injured, and then four more were transferred away. Currently, only they, the last four players, were left to guard the passage on the sixth basement.
They were alone, yet they were about to engage a large number of Lickers.
How could they survive?
Sacrificing for their ideals was one thing, but throwing their lives away for nothing was another.
Hearing sounds coming from the ceiling, the few of them subconsciously raised their heads.
Something was climbing in the ventilation duct above the ceiling!
It was obviously a Licker!
“Hurry up! Take the research personnel to the fifth basement! ”
“Let’s go! ”
“Hurry up and retreat! ”
The Night Owl players never suspected that it could be a false order. They immediately used the magnetic card to open the door of the secret laboratory and evacuate the research personnel.
Through the surveillance monitors, Fang Heng had been monitoring the sixth basement players’ every move.
Looking at the players quickly retreating, Fang Heng could not help but exclaim in awe. “Heh, they retreated quite quickly. ”

Upon seeing that the Night Owl players had led the research personnel and evacuated from the sixth basement, Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and immediately entered a string of commands into the command station.
Meanwhile, the four Night Owl players had just managed to escape from the sixth basement to the fifth basement alongside the research personnel.
Before they could catch their breaths, they heard a loud sound from the passage entrance to the fifth basement.
Turning back, they saw that the iron gate at the end of the passage was closed.
What happened?
Why was the iron gate of the passage closed?
The Night Owl players looked at each other in dismay, and the remaining NPC researchers also became nervous.

A player thought of something. She looked at the surveillance camera facing everyone and said, “Don’t be nervous. The iron gate was probably closed to protect us, to prevent the Lickers from breaking in from the sixth basement. We’ll just wait here for support. ”
The players felt that it made sense.
However, in the next second, they heard a familiar shuffling sound.
“A licker? ! ” they thought unanimously.
The sound, akin to a life-threatening curse, made the faces of the players change again. They raised their guns and aimed in the direction of the sound.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The net of the ventilation duct in the corner was instantly broken.
A few red figures darted out from the opening of the duct.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The reaction speed of the Night Owl organization’s players was much faster than that of ordinary players!
Almost instantly, four players opened fire at the same time.
Hum...
They threw a flashbang forward.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The four players raised their submachine guns and kept firing at the Lickers.
However, there were too many Lickers!
The Lickers kept coming out from the passage entrance. The Night Owl players realized in despair that even if they used flashbangs, their damage output was not enough to kill the Lickers!
They wanted to escape, but their only escape route, the iron gate, was closed.
It was over.
For a moment, all the players felt despair rising in their hearts.
After recovering their senses, the Lickers pounced at the players again.
Three minutes later, the fifth basement fell into silence once again.
“Mr. Fang Shuo, we’ve checked all aspects of the stabilizer. There’s no problem! ”
Without even turning his head, Fang Heng answered, “No! The data is still wrong! Check it again! Check it carefully! ”
“Yes! ”
Fang Heng continued to control the zombie team in the fifth basement to drag the corpses into the ventilation duct and clean up the crime scene.
“Okay, I’ve found the problem. Come back, all of you. ”
The NPC researchers didn’t know what was going on. They simply listened to Fang Heng’s command and walked back one by one, continuing to operate the main control platform.
No one realized what had happened in the short ten minutes.
Finally, Fang Heng raised his head and glanced at the few Night Owl players in the main control room. He then quietly left the main control room.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - Cultivation by Batch
paragraphs: Fang Heng took the elevator to the sixth basement.
He was blocked by the alloy metal gate of the laboratory at the end of the passage.
Crack, crack...
The ventilation system on the ceiling of the passage behind him was broken again.
Crack, crack...
One after another, a large number of vine zombies holding iron shovels and hammers fell from the top.
They slowly stood up and scattered on the spot.
A zombie staggered to Fang Heng’s side and handed him a blood-stained magnetic ID card.
The ID card was earlier found on a researcher on the fifth basement.
Fang Heng took the card and scanned it on the card reader.
“Beep Beep Beep... ID verified. Welcome, Dr. Liu. ”
The alloy metal gate opened in front of Fang Heng.
Fang Heng stepped into the laboratory.
“Ha, I’m coming for you, babe. ”
Fang Heng was in a good mood when he saw the laboratory filled with Tyrant form cultivation pods.

Previously, he had lured the players and NPCs from the sixth basement into the fifth basement to kill them. While he did it to prevent triggering the alarm of the sixth basement, Fang Heng was more worried that the battle would result in the destruction of the cultivation pods.
Since they could be used to create Tyrants, even the destruction of one would make Fang Heng feel pained.
Fang Heng walked forward and extended his hand to touch a Tyrant form cultivation pod.
“Item: Tyrant T103’s cultivation pod (mass-produced) . Hint: this cultivation pod is in operation. Cultivation completion rate: 90% . A catalyst can be used to accelerate cultivation. ”
Fang Heng walked to the experimental command station at the side.
He had learned about the operation of Tyrant T103’s cultivation pod (mass-produced) when he was in Pine City.
In fact, he had even personally practiced operating it.
The Tyrant forms in the cultivation pods had yet to fully take shape. When the pods were first designed, Meteorite Company had set up an emergency cancellation feature in them for safety reasons.
Once the feature was activated, an special anti-virus liquid would be injected, and those half-finished products could be easily killed.
Fang Heng skillfully entered a string of commands on the experimental command station.
Buzz... Ka Ka Ka...
The 42 Tyrant form cultivation pods’ emergency cancellation features were activated at the same time.
The pale yellow liquid in the cultivation pods was slowly extracted, and green anti-virus liquid was poured into them.
Gulp, gulp, gulp...
A series of bubbles emerged from the Tyrant forms’ bodies that were soaked in the green liquid.
Their originally strong bodies rapidly dissolved in the green liquid.
“Hint: you have activated the Tyrant T103’s cultivation pod (mass-produced) ‘s emergency cancellation feature. The Tyrant forms in cultivation have died. ”
Fang Heng reached out and pressed the red button.
The green liquid in the cultivation pods was extracted again.
Bang! Bang Bang!
When the liquid was drained, the cultivation pod doors opened automatically one after another.
“It’s your turn. ”

As Fang Heng spoke, the vine zombies standing beside Fang Heng walked forward one by one. They removed the zombies that had been deeply decomposed from the cultivation pods and walked into the cultivation pods.
“I hope I’m lucky enough to get more Tyrant form zombies this time. ” Fang Heng rubbed his hands nervously.
“Damn it, I wish Old Mr. Mo was here. ”
While talking to himself, Fang Heng pressed the red button.
Bang!
The pod doors closed again.
With the injection of the yellow viral nutrient solution, rows of game hints appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: your zombie clone is experiencing abnormality. ”
“Hint: Your zombie clone is attempting to undergo an even more high-tier transformation. ”
“Hint: authentication completed. Currently, you can only target your zombie clone. Transformation can not be used on a proliferator. ”
“Hint: current transformation success rate: 31% . ”
“Hint: current remaining transformation time: 300 hours. ”
“Hint: you can use up survival points to greatly reduce the transformation time. ”
“Hint: detected that the zombie clone has undergone corpse vine transformation. Current transformation can be fused with the original transformation at the same time. Estimated fusion level: low... ”

“Hint: you can choose transformation overlay (after overlaying, the original corpse vine transformation’s enhancement effect disappears) . Alternatively, you can choose fusion transformation (after fusion transformation is completed, the corpse vine transformation’s effect will remain) . ”
“Hint: current transformation overlay success rate: 31% ; current fusion transformation success rate: 17% . ”
“Hint: after the transformation is completed, there is still a great risk. Player will need to spend additional survival points and evolution crystals to eliminate this risk. ”

“Hint: because Tyrant T103’s cultivation pod (mass-produced)’s evolution liquid has been specially modified, per Tyrant T103, you can additionally spend 1,000 survival points, twenty complete crystallization crystals, and one Tier 1 crystallization crystal to access the additional options available. Option 1 (highly-efficient evolution overlay) : transformation overlay success rate increases to 45%. No fusion transformation ability. Option 2 (highly-efficient fusion evolution) : fusion transformation success rate increases to 27% . No transformation overlay ability. ”
Seeing the game hints that appeared, Fang Heng was stunned.
Those in Night Owl actually modified the Tyrant form cultivation pods’ solution such that there were two different options to choose from for leveling up.
It was a pleasant surprise to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng felt that those in Night Owl were interesting, and he checked the explanation again.

The so-called transformation overlay was to transform the vine zombies into Tyrant form zombies, and the fusion transformation was to transform the vine zombies into a combination of Tyrant form and vine zombie.
Of course, Fang Heng was going to do things to the end and choose fusion transformation.
However, there was a problem. There were a total of 42 zombies that needed to be evolved.
Fang Heng’s survival points were adequate, but where would he get the evolution crystals needed?
Just the first transformation required 840 complete crystallization crystals and 42 Tier 1 crystallization crystals.
Apart from that, after the fusion with the Tyrant forms was completed, Fang Heng would need to use Tier 1 evolution crystals to make the zombie clones’ evolution permanent.

The crystallization crystals that he owned were all left in District 8. Currently, he only had three high-energy crystals which could not be put to use since he the number of required crystals were much higher.
At this juncture, where could he find evolution crystals?
Fang Heng scratched his hair in annoyance and narrowed his eyes.
There was no other way at the moment, so he could only bite the bullet and take some from the Night Owl players.
Fang Heng calculated in his heart for a moment, then returned to the main control room in the third basement.

In the main control room, a few Night Owl players stood guard at the entrance, but their eyes could not help but look at the big surveillance monitors, paying attention to the battle situation in the passage of the third basement.
The three NPC researchers were still focused on operating the main control platform and analyzing various data.
Fang Heng walked to the stabilizer and looked around.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Fang Heng kicked a weak part of the stabilizer.
Thud!
A faint sound was heard.
The next second, an ear-piercing alarm sounded once again throughout the entire third basement.
“Alert! The stabilizer of the space tearing device has been damaged! Its operating efficiency has decreased. Please repair it in time! ”
Hearing the alarm, the players and NPCs in the main control room were shocked. They all turned their heads to look at the stabilizer and Fang Heng.
Fang Heng’s expression was calm, and his voice was loud and clear.
“Don’t panic. It’s just a small problem. Leave it to me. All of you, stick to your assigned tasks! ”

Even though Fang Heng did not have the authority to command, the few Night Owl players did not suspect Fang Heng’s answer at all. They continued to stand guard at the entrance of the main control room.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - Excavation
paragraphs: In the passage, a fierce battle was going on.
Su Jincheng was about to be driven mad by those Lickers!
The group of Lickers shuttled through the passage and went around in circles, not attacking head-on.
After a long time, Su Jincheng and the few players he brought along didn’t manage to kill any Lickers. Instead, they wasted a lot of ammunition.
Su Jincheng was unsettled by the Lickers.
He had no choice but to defend the entrance of the few main passages outside the control center hall.

After waiting for a while, he found that the surroundings were quiet. Su Jincheng thought that the Lickers had retreated, but just as he turned around to go back, they suddenly came out from the ventilation duct.
Parason was a support player. Most of the time, he hid at the back of the team and shivered.
He felt that it was still okay if the Lickers did not fight head-on.
After all, they might not be able to handle the Lickers charging over at the same time.
As he was lost in his thoughts, a sharp alarm sounded in the passage.
“Alert! The stabilizer of the space tearing device has been damaged! Its operating efficiency has decreased. Please repair it in time! ”
“It’s broken? Troubles are coming one after another,” thought Parason as his eyelids twitched.
He stood up abruptly and was about to turn back to check when Lickers swarmed over at the passage entrance in front.
Almost instantly, the Night Owl players raised their guns and fired.
As gunshots rang out, Parason quickly hugged his head and squatted down, hiding behind a bunker.
When the gunshots stopped, Parason felt someone pat his shoulder.
“Fang Shuo? ” Seeing the red mask on the person’s face, Parazon asked anxiously, “What’s the situation with the stabilizer? ”
“Not too good. Do you have any evolution crystals? ”
“Evolution crystals? ” Hearing Fang Heng’s words, Parason was stunned.

“The central part of the stabilizer for the space tearing device has been damaged. It probably won’t be able to hold on for long. To completely solve this problem, we need to replace the converter. The manufacture of the converter parts requires a large number of evolution crystals. ”
“Oh, so that’s how it is. ” When Parason heard Fang Heng’s explanation, he did not doubt it.
Fang Heng’s explanation was very logical. Coupled with his anxious tone, it appeared very realistic.
“I have some on me. I’ll give them all to you. ”

District 5 was an old server. The overall standard of the players was several grades higher than District 8. Tier 1 crystallization crystals were all publicly traded, so they were not considered particularly rare items.
Since they weren’t heavy, Parason had a lot of crystals on him.
He immediately traded all the evolution crystals in his backpack to Fang Heng.
“Hint: you have obtained 2271 evolution crystal fragments, 588 complete crystallization crystals, and 57 Tier 1 evolution crystals. ”
“Parason has quite a lot, ” thought Fang Heng.
He calculated with his fingers and found that the evolution crystals provided by Parason were enough for the zombie clones to evolve.
However, after the initial evolution, Tier 1 evolution crystals were still needed for the stabilization of the evolution form. During the process, additional Tier 1 evolution crystals were needed.
“I’m still short of some Tier 1 evolution crystals. Do you have more? ” asked Fang Heng.

“There should be some spare materials in the second basement’s warehouse. However, there is a security lock at the door there. We need Su Jincheng to go over to unlock it. ” Parason was distressed. “We can’t go there in this situation. ”
“Try to think of another way. I’ll go back and temporarily strengthen the spacial rift stabilizer. It won’t be able to hold on for long. We need to replace the stabilizer immediately. ”
“I understand. I’ll think of a way. ”
Troubled, Parason carefully poked his head out and looked outside.
The Lickers that had just launched a surprise attack retreated.
After a round of battle, not a single Licker died, and a lot of bullets were wasted.
“I’ll be going, ” said Fang Heng.

“Hey! Be careful! ” Parason turned his head, but before he could stop Fang Heng, the latter had already slipped through the other side of the passage and was quickly running back to the control center hall.
Parason, still in shock, thought Fang Heng was really stupid and bold to have run out despite the risk of a Licker appearing in the passage.

“Hint: player has consumed 42,000 survival points, 84 complete crystallization crystals, and 42 Tier 1 crystallization crystals to perform a zombie clone fusion transformation. Fusion transformation success rate: 27% . Consumption of survival points has shortened the time needed for evolution. ”
Fang Heng still had a lot of points left, so he used a large amount to further shorten the time needed for evolution.
“Hint: player has consumed 124,000 survival points to accelerate the completion. Remaining time needed for evolution: 180 minutes. ”
Gulp Gulp...
A series of bubbles emerged from the cultivation pods, and the zombie clones’ bodies expanded like a beating heart.
“I must have as many successful fusion transformations as possible! ” Fang Heng secretly prayed.
All that was left was to wait for three hours, and the transformation process would be done.
During that duration, Fang Heng thought he might as well think of a way to obtain the first-generation meteorite.
After that, he could quickly run away.
Fang Heng felt that he should not stay there for long. With the Federation and Night Owl fighting so vigorously, he might risk getting entangled in the mess.
Turning around, Fang Heng walked to the front of the alloy metal door at the back of the laboratory.
If his guess was correct, the metal door led to the seventh basement where the first-generation meteorite was probably hidden at.
Fang Heng tried to use the researcher’s magnetic card to scan the card reader on the door.
“Beep Beep Beep... Access denied. ”
As Fang Heng expected, he was unable to open the door.
He reached out and tried to push the heavy metal door again.
With a hammer, Fang Heng immediately acquired knowledge of the total durability of the metal door from the game log: 5.5 million.
However, every knock of the hammer only deducted 5 to 20 durability.
“Looks like I can only resort to that. ”
Fang Heng controlled two vine zombie proliferators to walk to the door and fight each other.
When their HP dropped to 10% , they self-destructed.
A large amount of blood splashed on the metal door, and a white mist rose.
The metal door corroded, and its durability had dropped by nearly 800 points.
It was too little of a decrease.
Fang Heng did a rough calculation in his mind. Even if he self-detonated all the zombies he brought with him, he would not be able to open the metal door.
“What should I do? ” Fang Heng mused as he suddenly thought of something. “I must be an idiot! ”
Since he had confirmed the building layout and confirmed that the secret laboratory was directly below the sixth basement, he should just directly dig downward!
“Why should I try to knock down this metal door? ”
Fang Heng took out the initial blueprint of the Meteorite Company for reference. Then, he controlled the zombie clones to gather in an inconspicuous corner of the laboratory.
The zombies took out the shovels that they had gotten from the storage room and started digging at the floor of the research room.

Fang Heng wasn’t in a hurry to leave. He simply sat down on the spot. While supervising, he opened the game log and controlled the Lickers in the third basement to tease the players from the Night Owl organization.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - Meteorite
paragraphs: Ten minutes later.
The zombie team dug down about one meter.
Just then, a dull knocking sound echoed.
Fang Heng was alerted and stood up to look at the dug floor.
Beneath was a dark black layer of lead.
“It’s lead! Lead effectively blocks radiation! The first-generation meteorite must be there, like I thought! ”
Fang Heng felt a lot more at ease and continued to control the zombies to continue digging downward.
For a full 40 minutes, the zombies dug away while Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to play guerrilla with Su Jincheng and the Night Owl players.
Two game hints quickly flashed across Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: you are currently exposed to a special radiation environment. As your physique is higher than 30 points, you are immune to the current radiation damage. ”
“Hint: after being exposed to radiation for a long time, the radiation damage will gradually increase. ”
“Is it done? ” Fang Heng stood up and walked to the hole dug by the zombie team. He stuck his head out and looked down.
It was very dark down there, so the night vision effect of the vampires was not obvious. Fang Heng could only roughly tell that there was an empty hall down there.
Fang Heng did not want to waste time, so he commanded the two zombie clones to jump down first.
Not sensing any danger, Fang Heng jumped down as well.
Thud!
As soon as they landed, Fang Heng immediately smelled a thick, bloody smell.
Then, the sensor light in the hall lit up, illuminating the entire hall.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted immediately.
In the center of the room, a red meteorite that was almost as tall as a person was soaked in blood, facing Fang Heng.
Why is the first-generation meteorite soaked in blood? ” Fang Heng thought as he carefully looked around.
The entire hall was empty aside from a pool with a radius of about five meters in the middle.
The pool was filled with dark red blood, with two-thirds of the first-generation meteorite submerged in it.
The scene in front of Fang Heng was a strange one.
He carefully walked forward.
Standing beside the blood pool, Fang Heng reached out his hand and touched the meteorite.
“Hint: you have found an item: first-generation meteorite. ”
“Item: first-generation meteorite. ”

“Description: a meteorite from an unknown source. Meteorite Company is rumored to have extracted the first-generation virus from the first-generation meteorite. This item is too big to fit in a backpack. It is a special mission item. ”
“Hint: it has been detected that you possess the special talent Basic Occult (level 2) . You can use this skill to conduct occult analysis on the first-generation meteorite. ”
The game hints that appeared made Fang Heng quickly withdraw his hand.
“What a suggestion. ” Fang Heng was aware of the risks associated with occult analysis.
Occult analysis was often accompanied by extremely destructive power. It could potentially destroy the analytical product.
Fang Heng was not about to risk occult analysis ruining the first-generation meteorite he painstakingly found.
Retracting his hand, Fang Heng lowered his head to ponder.
“I’ve found the first-generation meteorite, but how do I bring it back? It’s so huge. Also, why is it being soaked in blood? ”
The mysterious setup seemed related to the vampires.
“Will there be serious consequences if I rashly take the meteorite out of the blood pool? ”
For a moment, Fang Heng was a little hesitant.
“Should I just directly smash the meteorite and bring back a small piece of it to complete the mission? ” he thought.
After all, the mission did not specify the size of the meteorite required.
However, the first-generation meteorite was very hard. It would not be so easy to break it open, so he needed to find some handy tools.
While he was thinking, a game hint surfaced on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked and successfully triggered its dodging ability. ”
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked, resulting in a severed limb. ”
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked. Its HP has reduced to 5%. Automatically triggering the skill to strengthen the body... ”
Fang Heng was bewildered.
The trashy players from the Night Owl organization left in the research institute would definitely not be able to cause such great damage to the Lickers.
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows, realizing that something must have gone wrong in the third basement.
He had to go back and take a look first!
Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to temporarily hide in the ventilation duct before taking the elevator back to the third basement.
The moment the elevator door opened, Fang Heng was met with a few vampires standing in the passage.
After discovering that Fang Heng was of the same race, they shifted their gazes away from Fang Heng.
“Vampires? They joined the battle, too? ” Fang Heng’s heart sank.
The vampires had entered the battlefield via a different passage. They took the time passage to District 5.
In order to avoid getting hated by the vampires, Fang Heng previously deliberately avoided them when controlling the Lickers.
Currently, there were many low-level vampires gathered in the passage to guard it.
Fang Heng returned to the control center hall by walking along the main passage.
In the control center hall, dozens of vampires stood around the edge of the hall’s wall.
Parason was still knocking on the command station, befuddled.
After Sikong Mao left, the entire research institute became a mess. It was so chaotic that nobody noticed what happened in the sixth basement.
Fang Heng walked to Parason’s side and asked in a low voice, “What’s with these vampires? ”
“I don’t know. ” Parason was also a little confused. He wiped the sweat on his forehead and said, “We were fighting with the Lickers, and then a group of vampires came to support us. ”
Parason looked to the right and said in a low voice, “The white-haired old man seems to be the leader. ”
Fang Heng looked at the spot where Parason was looking at.
Su Jincheng was talking to an old vampire, who held a purple cane. The vampire’s face was full of wrinkles, and his hair was gray.
Parason nudged Fang Heng and asked anxiously, “How is the stabilizer? ”
“It’s temporarily repaired. I estimate that it can last another seven to eight hours. To completely repair the stabilizer, we need more crystallization crystals to make a new converter. ”
“I’ve talked to Su Jincheng. Later, he’ll go to the storage room with you. There are still a lot of evolution crystals in reserve there. If you need any materials, just take them. ”
As they spoke, Su Jincheng and the old vampire finished their conversation.
The former walked back to the two of them.
“What’s the situation? What did they say? ”
“That person claimed to be the elder of vampires, Dai Ze. He and Emilia don’t belong to the same clan. ”
Su Jincheng held his throbbing head.
“There will be a batch of very important materials sent over later. This group of vampires will look after them personally. ”
Fang Heng was a little surprised.
“Important materials? As in, raw blue crystal ores? ” he thought.
“They’re here. ”
Outside the main control room, the vampires opened a path. Seven or eight blood slaves laboriously moved a large box into the teleportation passage.
The elder of the vampires, Dai Ze, stood at the time passage entrance and watched the blood slaves move the materials expressionlessly.
Fang Heng thought it was strange that the vampires did not guard as heavily as when they previously transported raw blue crystal ores.
“Could it be some other more valuable materials and resources? ” he wondered.
A steady stream of blood slaves slowly moved the boxes into the hall.
“Let’s ignore them. Mr. Sikong wants us to heed the vampires’ arrangements. ”

Su Jincheng was a little unhappy. “It’s better now that we have them to help guard the passage entrance. We don’t need to worry about those troublesome Lickers. We just need to maintain the operation of the stabilizer. Fang Shuo, I’ll take you to the storage room. ”

sentences.text: Ten minutes later.
The zombie team dug down about one meter.
Just then, a dull knocking sound echoed.
Fang Heng was alerted and stood up to look at the dug floor.
Beneath was a dark black layer of lead.
“It’s lead!
Lead effectively blocks radiation!
The first-generation meteorite must be there, like I thought! ”
Fang Heng felt a lot more at ease and continued to control the zombies to continue digging downward.
For a full 40 minutes, the zombies dug away while Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to play guerrilla with Su Jincheng and the Night Owl players.
Two game hints quickly flashed across Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: you are currently exposed to a special radiation environment.
As your physique is higher than 30 points, you are immune to the current radiation damage. ”
“Hint: after being exposed to radiation for a long time, the radiation damage will gradually increase. ”
“Is it done? ” Fang Heng stood up and walked to the hole dug by the zombie team.
He stuck his head out and looked down.
It was very dark down there, so the night vision effect of the vampires was not obvious.
Fang Heng could only roughly tell that there was an empty hall down there.
Fang Heng did not want to waste time, so he commanded the two zombie clones to jump down first.
Not sensing any danger, Fang Heng jumped down as well.
Thud!
As soon as they landed, Fang Heng immediately smelled a thick, bloody smell.
Then, the sensor light in the hall lit up, illuminating the entire hall.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted immediately.
In the center of the room, a red meteorite that was almost as tall as a person was soaked in blood, facing Fang Heng.
Why is the first-generation meteorite soaked in blood? ” Fang Heng thought as he carefully looked around.
The entire hall was empty aside from a pool with a radius of about five meters in the middle.
The pool was filled with dark red blood, with two-thirds of the first-generation meteorite submerged in it.
The scene in front of Fang Heng was a strange one.
He carefully walked forward.
Standing beside the blood pool, Fang Heng reached out his hand and touched the meteorite.
“Hint: you have found an item: first-generation meteorite. ”
“Item: first-generation meteorite. ”
“Description: a meteorite from an unknown source.
Meteorite Company is rumored to have extracted the first-generation virus from the first-generation meteorite.
This item is too big to fit in a backpack.
It is a special mission item. ”
“Hint: it has been detected that you possess the special talent Basic Occult (level 2) .
You can use this skill to conduct occult analysis on the first-generation meteorite. ”
The game hints that appeared made Fang Heng quickly withdraw his hand.
“What a suggestion. ” Fang Heng was aware of the risks associated with occult analysis.
Occult analysis was often accompanied by extremely destructive power.
It could potentially destroy the analytical product.
Fang Heng was not about to risk occult analysis ruining the first-generation meteorite he painstakingly found.
Retracting his hand, Fang Heng lowered his head to ponder.
“I’ve found the first-generation meteorite, but how do I bring it back?
It’s so huge.
Also, why is it being soaked in blood? ”
The mysterious setup seemed related to the vampires.
“Will there be serious consequences if I rashly take the meteorite out of the blood pool? ”
For a moment, Fang Heng was a little hesitant.
“Should I just directly smash the meteorite and bring back a small piece of it to complete the mission? ” he thought.
After all, the mission did not specify the size of the meteorite required.
However, the first-generation meteorite was very hard.
It would not be so easy to break it open, so he needed to find some handy tools.
While he was thinking, a game hint surfaced on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked and successfully triggered its dodging ability. ”
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked, resulting in a severed limb. ”
“Hint: Your Licker clone has been attacked.
Its HP has reduced to 5%.
Automatically triggering the skill to strengthen the body... ”
Fang Heng was bewildered.
The trashy players from the Night Owl organization left in the research institute would definitely not be able to cause such great damage to the Lickers.
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows, realizing that something must have gone wrong in the third basement.
He had to go back and take a look first!
Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to temporarily hide in the ventilation duct before taking the elevator back to the third basement.

After discovering that Fang Heng was of the same race, they shifted their gazes away from Fang Heng.
“Vampires?
They joined the battle, too? ” Fang Heng’s heart sank.
The vampires had entered the battlefield via a different passage.
They took the time passage to District 5.
In order to avoid getting hated by the vampires, Fang Heng previously deliberately avoided them when controlling the Lickers.
Currently, there were many low-level vampires gathered in the passage to guard it.
Fang Heng returned to the control center hall by walking along the main passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - Counterattack
paragraphs: “Mid-tier vampires have invaded District 5. Several super-large shelters, including Shelters 1, 2, 5, 6, 12, and 13, have fallen. Player losses have yet to be counted. During the day, vampires are most vulnerable as their recovery abilities will be greatly reduced. They won’t be able to use many special abilities during the day. Once the sun rises, we will immediately launch a counterattack. At the same time, we will attack the various shelter points and the research institute where the teleportation passage is located. In secret, we will carry out plan number two. We will form a special operations force to infiltrate the research institute and destroy the teleportation passage. Through the special tool we received as a reward during the last world war, Team Assembly Order, within 6 hours, we will be able to summon a special operations force to enter District 5. The force must have 5 to 8 Zombie Apocalypse players. ”
In the conference hall of the Federation, a senior military officer was reporting the battle plan.
Qian Yuan pondered for a moment, raised his head, and asked, “How are we going about the player selection for the elite team? ”

“The preliminary list of 11 players has been drawn up. Six of them are members of the Federation and are on standby. The remaining five are players who are in cooperation with us. We are currently communicating with them. The plan will be officially implemented in three hours. ”
Qian Yuan went through the list of candidates again and saw a familiar name.
“Fang Heng? ”

“Yes, Fang Heng has the ability to control Lickers. He was assessed to have S-level capabilities in Zombie Apocalypse. In addition, he also has a relatively higher mechanical maintenance level and a Tier 1 time teleportation equipment. He’s very suitable for this mission. ”
Fang Heng followed Su Jincheng back to the materials storage room on the second basement.
He opened his hand in front of the evolution crystals in the storage room.
“Hint: you have obtained 200 complete crystallization crystals and 100 Tier 1 evolution crystals. ”
Since the funds of the Night Owl organization could be considered dirty money, Fang Heng did not hold back at all and took the crystals.
“Don’t be in a hurry to leave. I still need some other replaceable parts. ”
Fang Heng pulled Su Jincheng into the storage room, trying to find a suitable weapon to cut a small piece of the first-generation meteorite and bring it back.
“That vampire just now was a bit strange. What did Mr. Sikong say? ”
Su Jincheng frowned. “Vampires also fight among themselves. Mr. Sikong didn’t say anything. He just asked us to cooperate with the vampires. ”
While they were talking, a few Lickers quickly entered the materials storage room.
“What about those boxes? What are they filled with? ”
“I’m not sure. The boxes were all moved in from the outside. ”
Fang Heng searched the storage room but didn’t find anything that could break a meteorite. He could only put a few rare parts into his backpack.

“I’ll go back to my room and make another converter. There are too many vampires in the control room. I wouldn’t be able to concentrate on making it there, and I’m afraid that will affect the success rate. I suggest you go back and keep an eye on those vampires. There’s something fishy about them. ”
“Yes, I know. ” Su Jincheng locked the storage room again and brought Fang Heng to the second basement.
“There’s no need to send me off. ”
“Okay. ”
Fang Heng was alone at the elevator entrance. He turned around to look at the closing elevator door, then walked toward the abandoned warehouse outside the lounge.
After returning to the abandoned warehouse, Fang Heng jumped up and climbed into the ventilation duct.

Fang Heng followed the ventilation duct and climbed into the underground sewer. Only when he left the area of the research institute did he get out of range of the research institute’s special magnetic field.
After exhausting so much effort, he could finally go offline!
Fang Heng left two Lickers behind to stand guard, threw down a sleeping bag on the spot, and went offline.
Returning to the real world, before Fang Heng had time to open the door of the game cabin, he heard the buzzing sound of a vibrating cell phone outside.
Coming out of the cabin door, Fang Heng picked up the cell phone on the table.
Was It Chen Yu?
Fang Heng picked up the phone. “Hello? ”
“Fang Heng, this is Chen Yu speaking. It’s an emergency. The following information is related to the confidentiality clause. You need to keep it a secret from the public. ”
“Okay, speak. ”
“District 5 is in big trouble! ”
“Uh? ”
Fang Heng thought to himself, “Things are just getting started. I haven’t shown everything yet. Your Federation has to hold on. ”

“Server 5 is currently under attack from the world of vampires. Night Owl has directly opened a special teleportation passage. This time, they are coming in huge numbers. Server 5 is in danger of being wiped out at any moment. ”
“Hey, Chen Yu. ”
“Huh? ”
“To be honest, isn’t it a little miserable of you guys to be overwhelmed by a small organization like Night Owl? ”
“Fang Heng, I’m not joking with you. District 5 doesn’t usually have many players, but if it becomes completely controlled by Night Owl... ”
Chen Yu took a deep breath. He really couldn’t laugh as the matter was too serious.

“We’re currently forming a team to try and destroy the teleportation passage established by the vampires. You’re also on the team’s candidate list, and your ranking is high. If you agree to participate in this operation, I’ll immediately report your name. ”
“Me? You want me to transfer to Server 5? ”

“No, there is no need to transfer. We have a short-term summoning scroll. It is an extremely rare item that can be used for short-term teleportation for six hours. Our Federation needs your help. The reward this time will definitely satisfy you. ”
Hearing the word “reward”, Fang Heng wavered.
“King of Gods’ points? ”
“Yes! ”
“All right, I’ll participate. ”

“That’s great. I’ll immediately report your name. Also, if you use a scroll to summon yourself to a different server, the items in your backpack will be temporarily emptied. If you need any equipment, we’ll try our best to prepare it. ”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“Really? I need a high hardness cutting device, the kind that can cut through diamonds... ”
Fang Heng pondered in his heart, “The hardness of the first-generation meteorite is extremely high. With a cutting device, it should be able to cut it open, shouldn’t it? ”
Chen Yu was stunned on the other end of the phone. For a moment, he even suspected that he had heard wrong.
“What? What did you say? ”
“Cutting device. That kind of thing can cut through high-strength alloy metal doors. Do you understand what I mean? ”
“That... ”
Chen Yu felt a bit of a headache, but he still recorded Fang Heng’s request.

“I’ll think of a way. The team will set off in two and a half hours. Pay attention to the game log’s hint. After receiving the hint, you must accept the request within five minutes. Otherwise, the assembly will be ineffective. ”
“No problem. ”
The problem of cutting through the meteorite was solved.
After hanging up, Fang Heng rubbed his wrist. He found the phone number previously left by Old Black and called him.
After two rings, Old Black picked up the phone.

“Fang Heng, good job. I have received news that the teleportation passage in District 5 has been opened ahead of schedule. Their plans were clearly going smoothly, but the research institute became a mess, and they were even invaded by Lickers. You must have found the first-generation meteorite, right? ”
Fang Heng pursed his lips. “You guessed it again. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - Re-Establishing the Plan
paragraphs: “Tell me, what problems are you facing? Otherwise, you wouldn’t have called me personally, right? ”
“Hahaha, listen to yourself. ”
Fang Heng laughed.

“But seriously speaking, there’s indeed a problem. The first-generation meteorite is too big. I can’t bring it all back. Moreover, it’s soaking in a blood pool. Do you know anything about the blood pool? ”
“I’m not too sure about the blood pool. As for moving the meteorite... ”
Old Black paused, then said, “Fang Heng, think about it. Is there really no way? Don’t forget, your world also has time teleportation equipment. ”
“What do you mean? ”

“Change the structure of the stabilizer and adjust the teleportation coordinates to connect the other end of the Server 5’s teleportation passage to Server 8’s world. This shouldn’t be difficult for you, right? ”
Fang Heng was stunned, wondering if that was really possible.
Thinking about it carefully, it seemed quite plausible.
If it was really possible, not only could the entire first-generation meteorite be transported back, but the five frozen Tier 5 giant zombies could also be taken away!
“Right, there’s also a large number of blue energy crystals left in the hall! ” Fang Heng thought, pleased.
“Fang Heng, I’ve already done what I promised you. Remember what you promised me. ”
“I remember. So, what do you need me to do? ”
“There’s no rush. Let’s talk about it after you bring the meteorite back. I wish you good luck. ”
After hanging up, Fang Heng quickly thought about Old Black’s plan and deemed it workable.
He modified and operated the space tearing stabilizing device, directly changing its path to Server 8.
In order to complete the plan, he needed Server 8’s cooperation.
“It’s going to be a big operation. ”
Fang Heng immediately looked up Mo Jiawei’s phone number.
In the middle of the night, Mo Jiawei was sleeping soundly. When he heard the phone ring, he picked it up.
“Old Mr. Mo? You’re already asleep? ”
“God, it’s so late. Why did you call? ”
“Wake up. It’s time to work. We have something big to do. ”
Mo Jiawei instantly woke up.
“Tell me the details. ”
After communicating with Mo Jiawei about the next step of building the world passage, Fang Heng returned to the game again.
Taking the converter that he had casually made, Fang Heng rushed back to the main control room in the third basement.
Many vampires were gathered in the main control room.
As the teleportation passage could only be used one way at any given point, traffic was slow, and the blood slaves were stuck at the passage entrance for a long time.
Fang Heng looked around and saw that there were already a lot of boxes in the corner of the hall.
“Fang Shuo, how is it? ” Parason saw Fang Heng coming back and quickly came over to ask.
“It’s done. ” Fang Heng raised his hand, showing the converter in his hand.
“That’s great. ” Parason heaved a huge sigh of relief.
“How’s the situation outside? ”
“It’s fine. The Federation’s attacks have started to weaken. I think they’re waiting for daybreak. ”

Fang Heng swept a glance at the large screen which showed the battle situation outside, then nodded and said, “I’ll go repair the stabilizer. You continue to stay here at the monitoring platform. There might be a slight fluctuation in the stabilizer’s data. ”
“Okay. ”
Fang Heng walked to the space tearing stabilizing device in the middle of the hall and pretended to change the middleware while secretly checking it.
The stabilizer was originally used for the world of vampires, and its various values had been adjusted.
But now, Fang Heng needed to transform it into an inter-world teleportation passage.
Fang Heng inwardly estimated that theoretically, the energy consumption of the stabilizer was one-third lower, and the requirements for the stabilizer’s components were also one-quarter lower.
A line of game hints immediately appeared on his retina.
“Hint: player has level 18 mechanical mastery. Player has the current blueprint of the building. Estimated time to complete the customized modification will be 120 minutes. ”
It seemed that there was no problem with the modification of the stabilizer.

“In addition to the modification of the stabilizer, there’s also a need to change the parameters on the main control platform to connect to the world of Server 8. ” Fang Heng turned his head and focused his gaze on the vampires in the hall before continuing, “There’s also a need to get rid of these vampires! ”
About two hours later, a message appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: you have received a teleportation invitation from player Wu Xingwen. Do you accept it? ”

“Hint: after accepting the invitation, you will be teleported to Server 5 of Zombie Apocalypse. The coordinates are (23190,52833) . After six hours, you will be teleported back to your original location. Remaining time for teleportation: 5 minutes. ”
“I agree to teleport. ”
In the storage room, Fang Heng reached out his hand and tapped on the “agree” button.
His body was enveloped by a dim yellow light, and Fang Heng instantly disappeared from where he was.
Outside the research institute that was occupied by the Night Owl organization, the Federation had set up a front-line position in the surroundings.
Six players entered the temporary tent through the teleportation scroll in succession.
Fang Heng quickly scanned the surroundings.
There were a total of eight people in the tent.
“Welcome. Everyone is here. I’m Wu Xingwen, the person in charge of this operation. My innate ability is close combat proficiency and long-range heavy weapon suppression. ”
Wu Xingwen and the other four Federation members wore the same uniform. The five of them gathered together naturally.

“This is Chen Ziyang. He’s good at controlling magnetic field efficacy and explosions. This is the research scientist of the vampires, Liu Huiying. She’s good at setting up occult enchantments. The other two are temporary Federation fighters. They all have high-tier long-range heavy firepower suppression skills and the like. ”
After the brief introduction, Wu Xingwen looked at the remaining three players.
“Time is limited. Each of you, please briefly introduce yourselves. ”
The middle-aged man, who looked more experienced, nodded and said, “I’m Zhou Lei, and my talent skill is demon-hunting. I’m good at dealing with vampires. ”

The chestnut-haired girl said, “Hello, everyone. My name is Nie Feiran. My ability is group teleportation. I can lead a group to carry out short-distance teleportation. The number of people can be between one to eight. There are also some special restrictions on teleportation, such as that some special rocks and metal layers cannot be penetrated. ”
Immediately after, everyone looked at Fang Heng who was at the end.
“Me? ”
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then said, “I have more friends, so it should be a good advantage. ”
Hearing what Fang Heng said, the others instantly felt baffled.
“You mean Lickers, right? ” Zhou Lei looked at Fang Heng and said, “I saw your video on the Internet. The Lickers you control are very powerful. ”
“Thank you. ” Fang Heng smiled.

Zhou Lei looked at Wu Xingwen. “Chief Wu, my talent skill is demon-hunting, but I don’t have any attribute bonuses. The fact that I can’t bring a tool into Server 5 has a big impact on my ability. Have you prepared everything I need? ”
“We have tried our best and managed to get most of the items, but given the tight time limit, we missed out some. ”
Wu Xingwen led Zhou Lei to a low table at the side.
“These are all the things we have gathered so far. ”

sentences.text: “Tell me, what problems are you facing?
Otherwise, you wouldn’t have called me personally, right? ”
“Hahaha, listen to yourself. ”
Fang Heng laughed.
“But seriously speaking, there’s indeed a problem.
The first-generation meteorite is too big.
I can’t bring it all back.
Moreover, it’s soaking in a blood pool.
Do you know anything about the blood pool? ”
“I’m not too sure about the blood pool.
As for moving the meteorite... ”
Old Black paused, then said, “Fang Heng, think about it.
Is there really no way?
Don’t forget, your world also has time teleportation equipment. ”
“What do you mean? ”
“Change the structure of the stabilizer and adjust the teleportation coordinates to connect the other end of the Server 5’s teleportation passage to Server 8’s world.
This shouldn’t be difficult for you, right? ”
Fang Heng was stunned, wondering if that was really possible.
Thinking about it carefully, it seemed quite plausible.
If it was really possible, not only could the entire first-generation meteorite be transported back, but the five frozen Tier 5 giant zombies could also be taken away!
“Right, there’s also a large number of blue energy crystals left in the hall! ” Fang Heng thought, pleased.
“Fang Heng, I’ve already done what I promised you.
Remember what you promised me. ”
“I remember.
So, what do you need me to do? ”
“There’s no rush.
Let’s talk about it after you bring the meteorite back.
I wish you good luck. ”
After hanging up, Fang Heng quickly thought about Old Black’s plan and deemed it workable.
He modified and operated the space tearing stabilizing device, directly changing its path to Server 8.
In order to complete the plan, he needed Server 8’s cooperation.
“It’s going to be a big operation. ”
Fang Heng immediately looked up Mo Jiawei’s phone number.
In the middle of the night, Mo Jiawei was sleeping soundly.
When he heard the phone ring, he picked it up.
“Old Mr.
Mo?
You’re already asleep? ”
“God, it’s so late.
Why did you call? ”
“Wake up.
It’s time to work.
We have something big to do. ”
Mo Jiawei instantly woke up.
“Tell me the details. ”
After communicating with Mo Jiawei about the next step of building the world passage, Fang Heng returned to the game again.
Taking the converter that he had casually made, Fang Heng rushed back to the main control room in the third basement.
Many vampires were gathered in the main control room.
As the teleportation passage could only be used one way at any given point, traffic was slow, and the blood slaves were stuck at the passage entrance for a long time.
Fang Heng looked around and saw that there were already a lot of boxes in the corner of the hall.
“Fang Shuo, how is it? ” Parason saw Fang Heng coming back and quickly came over to ask.
“It’s done. ” Fang Heng raised his hand, showing the converter in his hand.
“That’s great. ” Parason heaved a huge sigh of relief.
“How’s the situation outside? ”
“It’s fine.
The Federation’s attacks have started to weaken.
I think they’re waiting for daybreak. ”
Fang Heng swept a glance at the large screen which showed the battle situation outside, then nodded and said, “I’ll go repair the stabilizer.
You continue to stay here at the monitoring platform.
There might be a slight fluctuation in the stabilizer’s data. ”
“Okay. ”
Fang Heng walked to the space tearing stabilizing device in the middle of the hall and pretended to change the middleware while secretly checking it.
The stabilizer was originally used for the world of vampires, and its various values had been adjusted.
But now, Fang Heng needed to transform it into an inter-world teleportation passage.
Fang Heng inwardly estimated that theoretically, the energy consumption of the stabilizer was one-third lower, and the requirements for the stabilizer’s components were also one-quarter lower.
A line of game hints immediately appeared on his retina.
“Hint: player has level 18 mechanical mastery.
Player has the current blueprint of the building.
Estimated time to complete the customized modification will be 120 minutes. ”
It seemed that there was no problem with the modification of the stabilizer.

“In addition to the modification of the stabilizer, there’s also a need to change the parameters on the main control platform to connect to the world of Server 8. ” Fang Heng turned his head and focused his gaze on the vampires in the hall before continuing, “There’s also a need to get rid of these vampires! ”
About two hours later, a message appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: you have received a teleportation invitation from player Wu Xingwen.
Do you accept it? ”
“Hint: after accepting the invitation, you will be teleported to Server 5 of Zombie Apocalypse.
The coordinates are (23190,52833) .
After six hours, you will be teleported back to your original location.
Remaining time for teleportation: 5 minutes. ”
“I agree to teleport. ”
In the storage room, Fang Heng reached out his hand and tapped on the “agree” button.
His body was enveloped by a dim yellow light, and Fang Heng instantly disappeared from where he was.
Outside the research institute that was occupied by the Night Owl organization, the Federation had set up a front-line position in the surroundings.
Six players entered the temporary tent through the teleportation scroll in succession.
Fang Heng quickly scanned the surroundings.
There were a total of eight people in the tent.

Everyone is here.
I’m Wu Xingwen, the person in charge of this operation.
My innate ability is close combat proficiency and long-range heavy weapon suppression. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - Infiltrating the Team
paragraphs: “A small part of the special silver bullets have been made by Liu Huiying. There aren’t many of them, so we need to use them sparingly. ”
Zhou Lei nodded and checked the materials on the low table one by one.
Soon, he picked up a holy scripture on the table, put his hand on the front of the scripture, and chanted.
A faint light appeared on Zhou Lei’s palm.
Fang Heng looked at Zhou Lei curiously.
“With such a specialized talent skill like demon-hunting, why didn’t he choose to go to Vampire Apocalypse instead? ”
After Zhou Lei finished his prayer, he poured eight glasses of water.
“This is holy water after prayer. It has a certain restraining effect on vampires. Drinking it can reduce the damage of vampires to us. ”
Everyone picked up their glasses and drank the water in one gulp.
Fang Heng also took a glass.
Before the liquid reached his mouth, Fang Heng instinctively resisted it.
“Oh, right. I’m also a vampire. ” Fang Heng thought to himself and put the glass to the side.
Only Fang Heng did not drink the water. Everyone looked at him in confusion.
Ahem.
Fang Heng coughed lightly and explained, “I’m not good at fighting. I’m just a support player, so I won’t be drinking it. ”
Zhou Lei nodded, not forcing him to drink the holy water. He drank a bottle of ice cola to recover his strength. Then, he continued to make tools at the table.
Fang Heng yawned and asked, “Chief Wu, have you prepared what I asked for? ”
“Yes. The thing you wanted is a little rare. I spent some effort on getting it. ”
Wu Xingwen remembered Fang Heng as the latter’s requested item had left a deep impression.
Although they did not know the true purpose of the stone cutter, the Federation still tried its best to satisfy Fang Heng’s demand. They spent a lot of effort to get a cutter.
“Meteorite Company’s large stone cutter model W-23 can only be used after it’s been charged. ”
Wu Xingwen took a 1.5-meter-long large cutter from his backpack and placed it heavily on the table.
“Also, this is a small generator and a regulator. ”
Fang Heng walked to the table and picked up the large cutter, playing with it in front of his eyes.

“It’s good stuff! With this, I can cut two pieces from the first-generation meteorite and put them into my backpack. One piece can be used for occult research, and the other piece can be kept as a sample, ” he thought.
Fang Heng did not dare to guarantee the success of connecting the teleportation passage to Server 8.
Even if the plan failed, at least one of the first-generation meteorites could be brought back to complete the main storyline.
“This is great. With this stone cutter, our success rate for this mission will increase by at least half. ”
“Stone cutter? ” Nie Feiran came over curiously and looked at Fang Heng suspiciously. “Fang Heng, are you serious? Are you sure that it can help us with this mission? ”
“Of course. Listen, this thing is very useful... ”
Wu Xingwen looked at Fang Heng easily lifting the stone cutter with one hand, surprised.
He himself was a strength-based battle-type player.
After a long period of training by the Federation, he had absorbed a total of seven strength-related skill books. Only then could he easily lift the stone cutter with one hand.
Looking at how easily Fang Heng lifted it up, Wu Xingwen deduced that his strength attribute was definitely not low!
Therefore, Fang Heng’s words about being a support player were a lie.
Perhaps he indeed had special uses for the stone cutter.
Wu Xingwen shifted his gaze away from Fang Heng.

“I’ll interrupt everyone for a moment. Time is limited. Let me introduce the initial plan that will be carried out soon. There is still one hour and twelve minutes until daybreak. When daybreak breaks, the Federation will immediately launch an attack on the research institute. At that time, we will approach the research institute from the other side under the cover of the Federal sub-unit. Through Nie Feiran’s group teleportation ability, we will directly pass through the research institute’s external defense and teleport into the interior of the building. Then, we’ll think of a way to destroy the teleportation passage. ” Wu Xingwen roughly explained the plan. He then asked, “Do you have any questions or require any extra information? ”
Amidst the silence, Fang Heng slowly raised his hand.
“Please speak. ”
“Isn’t the risk of directly breaking in a little too high? ”

“Indeed, our plan is a risky one. After the subsequent teleportation into the research institute, we’ll also have to play by ear. The time is tight, so we have no choice but to resort to this. ” Wu Xingwen nodded. “Fang Heng, if you have a better plan, you can suggest it. ”
“Actually, I have a friend who knows a little about the research institute. It is said that there is an underground sewer that leads to the research institute. ”

“There is indeed an underground sewer that leads to the research institute, but we do not have the time to look for the entrance to the underground sewer now. Moreover, the evaluation team thinks that Night Owl has probably sealed all the entrances to the underground sewer. ”
“It doesn’t matter. My friend has his ways. He has already helped us break open the sealed sewer entrance. ”
Wu Xingwen raised his eyebrows in surprise and said, “Fang Heng, what is your confidence level? ”
“High. I guarantee to complete the mission. ”

Wu Xingwen was swift and decisive. He quickly thought for a moment and nodded. “Okay, then we’ll do as you say. We’ll sneak in directly through the sewer. Since we’re using the underground sewer directly, then we don’t have to wait until dawn. Let’s set off now! ”
In the darkness, everyone walked out of the temporary tent.
With the help of the Vampire Bloodline’s night vision ability, Fang Heng finally realized the devastation of the battlefield outside.
At night, the vampires left the research institute. They ignored the Federation players in the periphery and headed straight for the battlefield at the front line.
Night Owl greatly looked down on the Federation.

The defense of the research institute was extremely strong. In addition, a large number of vampires were harassing them from the side. They had no way to break in. They could only hide in the temporary defensive line.
If they forcefully attacked, they would only suffer greater losses.
They could only hold their ground and clear out the vampires in the periphery. They were prepared to attack after daybreak.
“Follow me. ”
Fang Heng’s pupils were shrouded in a layer of red light.
After discerning the direction clearly under the night sky, Fang Heng led the players and rushed toward the entrance of the sewer.
Very soon, Fang Heng found the entrance to the sewer by the side of a stream.

Extremely experienced in moving around in the sewer, he took out a mask that was sprayed with perfume from his backpack and wore it on his face. He was the first to enter the sewer through the entrance.
The other players looked at each other and imitated Fang Heng. They made a face cloth and put it on their faces, then followed Fang Heng.

At first, they didn’t sense anything odd. However, after following Fang Heng for a while, Wu Xingwen realized that Fang Heng seemed to be very familiar with the sewer, as if he had walked through it hundreds of times before.
Even stranger was the fact that not a single zombie appeared along the way.
Wu Xingwen, who had prepared himself for any unexpected situation forcing them into combat, found it very unusual.
“Fang Heng, is this your first time here? ”
“Of course. ”
Nie Feiran was also curious, so she asked, “But you seem to be very familiar with this place. ”
