chapters.title: Chapter 379 - The Cutter
paragraphs: “Yes. I have a friend, and he is quite nice. When he knew that we were coming, he helped to clean up the area in advance, ” said Fang Heng with a smile, as if indirectly expressing his vast personal network.
Fang Heng walked along the passage. After more than ten minutes, he stopped.
By now, the smelly sewer environment had affected Wu Xingwen and the others a little.
Wu Xingwen covered his mouth and nose and asked, “Have we reached the end? ”

Fang Heng explained, “There are two routes that lead to the inside of the research institute. For the first route, another 15 miles beyond this wall and we can directly reach the research institute’s second basement. For the second one, we can also continue forward along the sewer. Ten minutes later, we’ll be able to see the ventilation duct that connects to the research institute. We can climb into the research institute through the duct. However, the ventilation duct is very small, and the internal passage is also very winding, so this route will be more time-consuming. ”
The environment of the sewer was harsh. Wu Xingwen did not want to continue staying in there, so he looked at Nie Feiran.
Understanding Wu Xingwen’s gaze, Nie Feriran pinched her nose and replied, “The maximum distance of a single teleportation is 20 meters. ”
She walked to the wall and pressed her hand on the wall. “The wall is made of ordinary stone mixed with metal alloy. Group teleportation through this material composition is possible. ”
“All right. Let’s teleport in directly. ”
Hearing that, everyone took out their guns and loaded their bullets. They checked their equipment and got ready for battle.
When everyone was ready, Wu Xingwen gestured to everyone.
“Three, two, one! Teleport! ”
Fang Heng felt a white light flash in front of him.
The next second, he found himself in the passage of the first basement.
Snap!
Chen Ziyang snapped his fingers.
The surveillance cameras in the nearby passage were simultaneously affected by the magnetic field, and they were instantly disabled.
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He gave Chen Ziyang a thumbs up. “This move is pretty cool. ”
“So-so, ” Chen Ziyang responded and took out his gun while wary of the surroundings.
There were no enemies in the passage that everyone had teleported to.
The infiltration was smooth beyond their expectations.
Fang Heng shrugged and consciously shrank back to the back of the team.

“Everyone, this is the best my friend can do. We’ll have to rely on you guys for the rest. I’m not good at fighting. Judging from the location of the spatial rift stabilizer, the time passage probably connects from the third basement or the fourth basement. We’ll start from the third basement and go through the floors one by one. ”
Wu Xingwen looked at Nie Feiran and asked, “Can we directly teleport to the next basement? ”
Nie Feiran drank a bottle of Red Bull that could quickly recover her mental strength and said, “Each teleportation will take 10 minutes. ”
“I suggest we don’t teleport. ”
“Huh? ” Everyone looked at Zhou Lei.
Zhou Lei had been frowning ever since he stepped into the research institute.
He explained, “I can sense that there are a large number of vampires in the lower levels. If we were to rashly teleport down, we would be surrounded by the vampires and be in a difficult situation. ”
“What do you suggest we do? ”

Liu Huiying suggested, “I can create a sealing formation that targets the vampires. We can lure the vampires into the inner part of the formation and activate the magic in it to trap them. We can use this to take down a large number of vampires. ”
Fang Heng was stunned when he heard that.
The group of players gathered by the Federation seemed to be pretty capable.
However, he wondered, “Would I be recognized as a target by the sealing formation, too? ”
“All right. We’ll do as you say. We’ll split into two groups. I’ll bring some people to guard the entrance of the second basement-”
“Ah! ” Just as Wu Xingwen was assigning tasks, Fang Heng suddenly called out and interrupted him.
“What’s wrong? ” asked Wu Xingwen.

“I’m sorry. I think a few of my friends are calling me. I need to go into the ventilation duct to take a look. ” Fang Heng pointed at the ventilation duct beside him. “I won’t be of help here anyway. I’ll take my leave first. ”
Wu Xingwen frowned. He looked at the ventilation duct, unaware of what Fang Heng was up to. However, he had asked Chen Yu about Fang Heng in advance.
He heard that although Fang Heng would seem unconventional in going about tasks, he actually had deeper plans.
“Go and hurry back. ”
“Of course, ” Fang Heng agreed and skillfully slipped into the ventilation duct.
“Let’s continue. ”
The other players didn’t know much about Fang Heng, so they didn’t particularly feel his absence was a problem. Excluding Fang Heng, they quickly scattered to do their assigned tasks.

Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei worked together to set up a sealing formation against the vampires. Wu Xingwen took the remaining players to the entrance of the second basement and cleaned up the vampires along the way.

“The research institute has been infiltrated by the Federation. Parazon would probably discover them soon, right? I guess I’ll have them fight the vampires first. ” Fang Heng licked his lips and entered the sixth basement through the ventilation duct.
“Beep, beep, beep. Verification successful. Welcome back, Dr. Liu. ”
Returning to the laboratory in the sixth basement, Fang Heng felt uneasy and carefully walked to the command station of the cultivation pod.
It was time to see his luck.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and pulled himself together. He reached out and pressed the red button.
Gulp, gulp, gulp...
In the cultivation pod, the orange-yellow nutrient solution was quickly extracted.
Three lines of game hints showed on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: you have completed the cultivation of the Tyrant form. In total, there are 32 zombie clones (vine parasite) and 10 successful fusion transformations. ”

“Hint: the current zombie clones (modified Tyrant form, modified vine parasite) are considered abnormal. For each clone, you can spend 15 thousand survival points and 3 Tier 1 evolution crystals to completely eliminate the risk of unstable clone conditions and solidify the current fusion transformation status. ”
“Hint: after solidifying the clone, the clone will be able to maintain the Tyrant form and vine parasite fusion even in the situation of resurrection after death. ”
The doors of the cultivation pods opened at the same time.
The zombies that had failed to evolve melted into a puddle of meat. The remaining ten newly born Tyrant forms stepped out of the pods and stood in a row behind Fang Heng, looking quite imposing.
A total of ten Tyrant forms with heightened combat ability had been added.
Fang Heng secretly suppressed the excitement in his heart and lowered his head to do some calculations.

“Wait. The math doesn’t add up. With 42 Tyrant forms, the success rate is 27% . In theory, I would completed 11.3 Tyrants. Damn it! There’s one less! ” Fang Heng muttered to himself about how his luck that day was not very good.
“I want to use points to complete solidification! ”
“Hint: you have consumed 150 thousand survival points and 30 Tier 1 evolution crystals. Solidification of completed Tyrant forms is done. ”
Fang Heng let the few Tyrant forms stay where they were, then jumped down into the hole in the floor that he had made before, entering the seventh basement again.
Clack.
As soon as he landed, the thick smell of blood once again stimulated Fang Heng’s nostrils.
Raising his head, he saw the first-generation meteorite still quietly soaking in the blood pool.
Fang Heng walked forward, took out the cutter from his backpack, and connected it to the portable diesel generator.
“Hint: 20 strength points are required to operate the stone cutter. Player has met the conditions for using the stone cutter. ”

sentences.text: “Yes.
I have a friend, and he is quite nice.
When he knew that we were coming, he helped to clean up the area in advance, ” said Fang Heng with a smile, as if indirectly expressing his vast personal network.
Fang Heng walked along the passage.
After more than ten minutes, he stopped.
By now, the smelly sewer environment had affected Wu Xingwen and the others a little.
Wu Xingwen covered his mouth and nose and asked, “Have we reached the end? ”
Fang Heng explained, “There are two routes that lead to the inside of the research institute.
For the first route, another 15 miles beyond this wall and we can directly reach the research institute’s second basement.
For the second one, we can also continue forward along the sewer.
Ten minutes later, we’ll be able to see the ventilation duct that connects to the research institute.
We can climb into the research institute through the duct.
However, the ventilation duct is very small, and the internal passage is also very winding, so this route will be more time-consuming. ”
The environment of the sewer was harsh.
Wu Xingwen did not want to continue staying in there, so he looked at Nie Feiran.
Understanding Wu Xingwen’s gaze, Nie Feriran pinched her nose and replied, “The maximum distance of a single teleportation is 20 meters. ”
She walked to the wall and pressed her hand on the wall.
“The wall is made of ordinary stone mixed with metal alloy.
Group teleportation through this material composition is possible. ”
“All right.
Let’s teleport in directly. ”
Hearing that, everyone took out their guns and loaded their bullets.
They checked their equipment and got ready for battle.
When everyone was ready, Wu Xingwen gestured to everyone.
“Three, two, one!
Teleport! ”
Fang Heng felt a white light flash in front of him.
The next second, he found himself in the passage of the first basement.
Snap!
Chen Ziyang snapped his fingers.
The surveillance cameras in the nearby passage were simultaneously affected by the magnetic field, and they were instantly disabled.
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He gave Chen Ziyang a thumbs up.
“This move is pretty cool. ”
“So-so, ” Chen Ziyang responded and took out his gun while wary of the surroundings.
There were no enemies in the passage that everyone had teleported to.
The infiltration was smooth beyond their expectations.
Fang Heng shrugged and consciously shrank back to the back of the team.
“Everyone, this is the best my friend can do.
We’ll have to rely on you guys for the rest.
I’m not good at fighting.
Judging from the location of the spatial rift stabilizer, the time passage probably connects from the third basement or the fourth basement.
We’ll start from the third basement and go through the floors one by one. ”
Wu Xingwen looked at Nie Feiran and asked, “Can we directly teleport to the next basement? ”
Nie Feiran drank a bottle of Red Bull that could quickly recover her mental strength and said, “Each teleportation will take 10 minutes. ”
“I suggest we don’t teleport. ”
“Huh? ” Everyone looked at Zhou Lei.
Zhou Lei had been frowning ever since he stepped into the research institute.
He explained, “I can sense that there are a large number of vampires in the lower levels.
If we were to rashly teleport down, we would be surrounded by the vampires and be in a difficult situation. ”
“What do you suggest we do? ”
Liu Huiying suggested, “I can create a sealing formation that targets the vampires.
We can lure the vampires into the inner part of the formation and activate the magic in it to trap them.
We can use this to take down a large number of vampires. ”
Fang Heng was stunned when he heard that.
The group of players gathered by the Federation seemed to be pretty capable.
However, he wondered, “Would I be recognized as a target by the sealing formation, too? ”
“All right.
We’ll do as you say.
We’ll split into two groups.
I’ll bring some people to guard the entrance of the second basement-”
“Ah! ” Just as Wu Xingwen was assigning tasks, Fang Heng suddenly called out and interrupted him.
“What’s wrong? ” asked Wu Xingwen.
“I’m sorry.
I think a few of my friends are calling me.
I need to go into the ventilation duct to take a look. ” Fang Heng pointed at the ventilation duct beside him.
“I won’t be of help here anyway.
I’ll take my leave first. ”
Wu Xingwen frowned.
He looked at the ventilation duct, unaware of what Fang Heng was up to.
However, he had asked Chen Yu about Fang Heng in advance.
He heard that although Fang Heng would seem unconventional in going about tasks, he actually had deeper plans.
“Go and hurry back. ”
“Of course, ” Fang Heng agreed and skillfully slipped into the ventilation duct.
“Let’s continue. ”
The other players didn’t know much about Fang Heng, so they didn’t particularly feel his absence was a problem.
Excluding Fang Heng, they quickly scattered to do their assigned tasks.
Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei worked together to set up a sealing formation against the vampires.
Wu Xingwen took the remaining players to the entrance of the second basement and cleaned up the vampires along the way.
“The research institute has been infiltrated by the Federation.
Parazon would probably discover them soon, right?
I guess I’ll have them fight the vampires first. ” Fang Heng licked his lips and entered the sixth basement through the ventilation duct.
“Beep, beep, beep.
Verification successful.
Welcome back, Dr.
Liu. ”
Returning to the laboratory in the sixth basement, Fang Heng felt uneasy and carefully walked to the command station of the cultivation pod.
It was time to see his luck.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and pulled himself together.
He reached out and pressed the red button.
Gulp, gulp, gulp...
In the cultivation pod, the orange-yellow nutrient solution was quickly extracted.
Three lines of game hints showed on Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: you have completed the cultivation of the Tyrant form.
In total, there are 32 zombie clones (vine parasite) and 10 successful fusion transformations. ”
“Hint: the current zombie clones (modified Tyrant form, modified vine parasite) are considered abnormal.

For each clone, you can spend 15 thousand survival points and 3 Tier 1 evolution crystals to completely eliminate the risk of unstable clone conditions and solidify the current fusion transformation status. ”
“Hint: after solidifying the clone, the clone will be able to maintain the Tyrant form and vine parasite fusion even in the situation of resurrection after death. ”

Solidification of completed Tyrant forms is done. ”

Raising his head, he saw the first-generation meteorite still quietly soaking in the blood pool.

Player has met the conditions for using the stone cutter. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Meteorite Obtained
paragraphs: Fang Heng held the cutter with both hands and turned it on.
Bzz...
The cutting disc rotated at a high speed, emitting a loud sound.
Sparks flew in all directions.
The first-generation meteorite was extremely hard. It took Fang Heng a full two minutes to cut off a small protruding piece from the first-generation meteorite.
Fang Heng held it in his hand and examined it.
The small piece of the meteorite was only half the size of a fist.
Perhaps it was due to the heat emitted when cutting, but Fang Heng felt a burst of warmth from the meteorite.
“Hint: player has obtained a first-generation meteorite fragment. ”
Item: first-generation meteorite fragment.

Description: the item contains a large amount of radiation. After putting it into a backpack, it will continue to produce a radiation effect, causing a negative effect on the body (as time goes by, the radiation effect will gradually increase) .
“Hint: you have completed the current main storyline (Server 8) : obtain the first-generation meteorite. ”

“Hint: due to the insufficient amount of first-generation meteorite obtained, submitting the quest will receive a lower quest score and have a probability of affecting the subsequent main storylines. ”
“Hint: you can collect more of the first-generation meteorite before submitting the quest. ”
“I’ve succeeded! ” Seeing the game hints, Fang Heng completely relaxed.
Using a roundabout way, he finally obtained the first-generation meteorite.
This time, he did not visit Server 5 in vain.
Fang Heng decided to cut off another piece and use occult skills to research it.
He shook his right hand, which was slightly numb from the earlier vibration of the cutter, before turning the cutter on again.
Since he had gotten the hang of it, the second cut only took a minute.
Fang Heng cut off a smaller piece from the first-generation meteorite.
“Hint: you have obtained 1 first-generation meteorite fragment. ”
“Hint: it has been detected that you have a special skill: basic occult (level 2) . You can use this skill to analyze the first-generation meteorite through occult analysis. ”
“Hint: this analysis consumes 280 survival points. ”
“Commence the analysis! ”
Bzz...
The rune mark on the back of Fang Heng’s hand flashed once again.
The first-generation meteorite in Fang Heng’s hand was pulled by an invisible strength, and once again, it floated in the air, shaking violently.
Fang Heng had a bad premonition and took half a step back.
Bang!
Just as Fang Heng had expected, the first-generation meteorite in the air instantly exploded.
“Tch, it really exploded. ”
“Hint: you have used basic occult to analyze the first-generation meteorite for the first time. You have obtained 4873 basic experience points for the skill Occult. ”
“Hint: your skill — basic occult — has been upgraded to level 11. ”
“Such a huge jump? ” The sudden increase in experience points surprised Fang Heng.
The first-generation meteorite was indeed a high-tier product.
Analyzing it at once was equivalent to reading a few skill books.
Fang Heng calmed himself down and continued to open the game log.

“Hint: through basic occult (level11) detection, no spiritual energy or mental energy was found in the first-generation meteorite. Violent biological fluctuation and mild natural energy fluctuation found. ”
“Wait. There are worms in meteorites? ” Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and looked at the cracks carefully.
In the cracks, where the first-generation meteorite was shattered, a few small gray worms were wriggling and struggling violently.
Exposed to the air, they looked extremely uncomfortable. They struggled crazily and soon lost their vitality.
“Hint: you have found an unknown worm life form. This life form has a large amount of life energy. ”
“Meteorite... worm... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself as he put away the first-generation meteorite fragment and left the seventh basement.
In the passage of the second basement.
Wu Xingwen led two Federation players as they ran along the passage.
Behind them, a group of vampires chased after them crazily.
After running around a corner, Wu Xingwen shouted at the top of his lungs, “Do it! ”

In the middle of the passage of the second basement, Zhou Lei and Liu Huiying, who were kneeling on the ground, heard Wu Xingwen’s shout. They reached out their hands at the center of the anti-demon seal formation under their feet at the same time, concentrating mental strength on it.
Swoosh!
The anti-demon seal formation was instantly activated, and a purple light flashed!
Red light spread out in all directions, and a thin layer of red mist rose up from the ground across more than half of the passage of the second basement.
The ground beneath the feet of the vampires who were on a chase in the second basement was shrouded by the mist, and it was as if they had fallen into a swamp.
The substance-like mist trapped all the vampires on the spot!

“Get rid of them! ” Upon seeing this, Wu Xingwen and the two main damage dealers from the Federation no longer tried to escape. They turned around and took out the revolving machine gun from their backpacks. They assumed that the cannon was aimed at the vampires and fired wildly.
Bang, bang, bang, bang...
Large caliber bullets rained down crazily.
After more than ten minutes, the entire passage of the second basement was cleared of vampires.
“Are there many vampires left in the third basement? ”
Zhou Lei tried to sense for a while and frowned. “Almost two-thirds of them have been cleaned up, but there is still a lot left... ”
Chen Ziyang thought for a while and suggested, “Why don’t we lure some of them over in batches? ”
“Yes, the anti-demon seal formation can last for a while. ”
“Okay! ”
Wu Xingwen immediately gave a plan of action.
“We’ll move to the third basement and think of a way to attract a wave of vampires to deal with them. If we encounter any danger, we’ll immediately move back to the second basement! ”
Everyone nodded in unison.
Liu Huiying thought of something and looked around.
“Where’s Fang Heng? Isn’t he back yet? ”
“We won’t be waiting for him. He has the ability to protect himself. Let’s go first. ”
After saying that, Wu Xingwen took the lead and rushed into the third basement.
Just as they stepped into the passage opening of the third basement, several low-level vampires charged forward.
“Back off. I’ll take them on! ” Wu Xingwen shouted loudly. The muscles on his right arm swelled in the blink of an eye and expanded by several points!
He clenched his fist and threw a punch forward.
Bang!
The five low-level vampires were sent flying by Wu Xingwen’s punch and crashed into the wall behind them.
“Move! ” Wu Xingwen took a step forward and wanted to rush forward.
“Wait! ” Zhou Lei sensed something and reached out his hand to stop them from moving forward. He stared at the passage ahead.
A voice sounded, “I was wondering who it was. So it’s a demon hunter... ”
Looking in the direction of the voice, they saw an old vampire with a cane slowly walk out around the corner of the other end of the passage.
“Since you’ve come, you can stay here forever. ”
Zhou Lei held a demon-hunting talisman in his hand and said in a deep voice, “Be careful, it’s the Marquis of the vampires. ”
“I’ll take him on! ” Wu Xingwen strode forward and swung his fist at the old man.
A strong wind blew across Dai Ze’s face, and he jumped far away with a tap of his toes on the ground. The movements of the old vampire Dai Ze appeared to be light, which did not match his body.
“Fool... ” The old man raised his cane in the air and pointed it at Wu Xingwen.
Thump! Thump!
The moment he was hit by the cane, Wu Xingwen felt that the time around him seemed to have stopped for a moment. He heard two clear heartbeats in his ears.
It was as if something was gripping his heart hard.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
Seeing that, Liu Huiying raised her gun and fired.
Silver bullets with a special anti-demon rune on it were shot out of the pistol.
Dai Ze had no choice but to put away his cane.
With light footsteps, he moved around in the limited space of the passage, dodging all the incoming bullets.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Anti-vampire Formation
paragraphs: “Meeting the Marquis of the vampires here is troublesome. ” Zhou Lei quickly calculated the next steps to take in his mind.
“Huh? Silver bullets? ” Dai Ze snorted in disdain. “After so many years, is this still the only thing the demon hunters have? ”
As he said that, Dai Ze raised the cane in his hand and slammed it heavily on the ground.
Thud!
The moment the cane landed on the ground, dark purple ripples that could be seen with the naked eye spread out in all directions.
“Sh*t! Quick... ”
Liu Huiying’s pupils constricted.
She had just opened her mouth and wanted to call out to the players when her feet were already covered by the purple glow.
The next moment, Liu Huiying entered a state of silence.
A line of game hints flashed in her eyes.
“Hint: you have entered a state of silence. You are unable to use any active skills, unable to use your backpack, and unable to speak. ”
“Oh no! It’s over! ” Liu Huiying noticed that her other teammates had also entered a state of silence at the same time.
Zhou Lei’s expression darkened. “That cane’s one of the Thirteen Holy Artifacts! This is troublesome. In this state, we won’t be able to teleport away. ”
Wu Xingwen clenched his fists. He had a high explosive bomb on him. If he fought with all his might, he might be able to interrupt Dai Ze’s spellcasting state.
Bang!
Just as everyone was thinking about how to escape, several ventilation duct openings in the corner of the wall were forced open!
Several red figures scuttled out of the ventilation duct. After landing on the ground, they pounced on the vampire elder, Dai Ze.
It was the Lickers. There was a chance to escape!
Whoosh!
Holding his cane, the old man continuously dodged and deftly avoided the attacks of the Lickers.
However, there were a dozen lickers that had scuttled out of the passage!
In such a narrow environment, Dai Ze had no way to dodge. He could only retrieve his cane, raise it again, and point it at a Licker.
Thud!
The walking stick lightly touched a Licker’s forehead.
The Licker froze in midair for half a second.
Boom!
The Licker’s body exploded!
The moment the cane in Dai Ze’s hand left the ground, the silence spell immediately lost its effect.
“Quick! Teleport! ” Nie Feiran immediately used her spatial skill.
A white light flashed, and Nie Feiran led the team in the passage to the second basement.
In the second basement, Zhou Lei felt as if he had run for thousands of meters. His entire body was drained of energy.
He sat on the ground, gulped down a mouthful of cola, and panted heavily.
Liu Huiying’s face was also pale.
The silence spell cast by the vampire elder did not deal much damage to ordinary people, but it dealt a lot of damage to the two spirit-type players.
“Everyone, it seems that you have encountered some trouble. ”
Looking at Fang Heng who poked his head out from the ventilation duct at the side, Chen Ziyang raised his hand. “Thank you. ”

“Thank you to your friends, too. ” Zhou Lei panted and continued, “Ordinary seals are only effective against ordinary vampires. Against that Marquis of the vampires, the seal here is barely effective. With him guarding the entrance, it will be difficult for us to go in and destroy the passage. ”
Everyone fell into silence.
Ahem.
Fang Heng stretched out half of his body from the ventilation duct and raised his hand. “Everyone, I have a suggestion. ”
“Huh? ”
Everyone raised their heads and looked at Fang Heng who was lying in the ventilation duct.
“Fang Heng, why don’t you come down first before talking? ” Chen Ziyang felt that his stiff neck couldn’t take looking up at the ventilation duct anymore.
“No, it’s troublesome to crawl in and out. ”
The anti-demon seal formation on the ground was still in operation. Fang Heng had a bad feeling about setting foot on it.

“Actually, I have a few relatively strong friends. They can think of a way to sneak me alone into the teleportation array. I can secretly go and destroy the teleportation array alone. But once I make a move on the teleportation passage, the built-in alarm of the research institute will be triggered. That old vampire from earlier will come after me, so you have to think of a way to trap him for a while. ”

Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei looked at each other and said, “In addition to our team’s coordinated effort, if we set up an anti-vampire formation to kill vampires in advance, we can trap him for a while. The anti-vampire formation consumes a lot of energy, so we can only set it up once. Moreover, we will not be fit for combat after activating the formation. ”
Fang Heng asked, “How long can we trap Dai Ze for? ”
“It will take about fifteen minutes to set up the formation. Combining both the formation’s effects and our interference from the side, we can probably trap him for at least ten minutes. ”
Fang Heng made some calculations in his heart. “10 minutes is still too short. ”
It seemed that after he constructed the inter-server passage, he had to rush over and help the team deal with the elder of the vampires.
Thinking of that, Fang Heng said, “It’s about enough time for me to destroy the teleportation passage. I have no problem. ”
Wu Xingwen asked in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, your plan is very risky. How confident are you? ”
Fang Heng shrugged and said in a relaxed manner, “Of course I’m 100% confident. ”
Wu Xingwen no longer hesitated. “Check the time now. Execute the plan and activate the anti-vampire formation in 18 minutes... ”
Following the ventilation duct, Fang Heng climbed back to the third basement and returned to the control center hall.
The hall was somewhat chaotic.
Presently, the sky had already brightened in the outside world. The Federation, which lay low for the entire night, made its attack.
The huge contrast made the Night Owl organization’s side barely able to hold on.
Fang Heng noticed that Parason was controlling something in front of the main control platform, appearing anxious.
“What’s wrong, Parason? From your expression, the situation doesn’t seem very good. ”
Without checking Fang Heng’s position, Parason casually replied, “We’re in big trouble. I can’t contact the laboratory in the sixth basement. ”
“Oh? ”

“The Federation’s counterattack is unexpectedly fierce. Mr. Sikong is currently under a lot of pressure. He just contacted us to urgently activate the Tyrants and block the Federation’s first wave of attack. ”
“Mhm. ”
Parason was so anxious that his forehead was covered in sweat. “I can already try to establish contact with the laboratory on the sixth basement, but there’s no response from there. ”
“Right. ” Fang Heng understood and said, “Could it be that the sixth basement was attacked by a group of Lickers? ”

“No way... The laboratory in the sixth basement is a sealed space. Even if the passage of the sixth basement was attacked by a group of Lickers, the Lickers would still be unable to pass through the metal door. ”
Parason’s tone also became somewhat uncertain. Although he was very unwilling to admit it, he felt that Fang Heng was right.
“If what Fang Heng said is true... ” thought Parason.
Fang Heng suggested, “Why don’t you bring a few people to the sixth basement to take a look? ”

When Parason heard that, he immediately cowered. “Don’t tease me anymore. Earlier, the surveillance equipment on the second basement malfunctioned. Later, the vampires were also attacked. Now, the entire research institute might be invaded by the Federation. If we go to the sixth basement, we might be in danger. ”
“That makes sense. After all, our lives are our own. There’s no need to risk it so much. ” Fang Heng agreed very much.
As he spoke, he walked to the command station and pouted at the space-tearing stabilizing device in the center.

sentences.text: “Meeting the Marquis of the vampires here is troublesome. ” Zhou Lei quickly calculated the next steps to take in his mind.
“Huh?
Silver bullets? ” Dai Ze snorted in disdain.
“After so many years, is this still the only thing the demon hunters have? ”
As he said that, Dai Ze raised the cane in his hand and slammed it heavily on the ground.
Thud!
The moment the cane landed on the ground, dark purple ripples that could be seen with the naked eye spread out in all directions.
“Sh*t!
Quick... ”
Liu Huiying’s pupils constricted.
She had just opened her mouth and wanted to call out to the players when her feet were already covered by the purple glow.
The next moment, Liu Huiying entered a state of silence.
A line of game hints flashed in her eyes.
“Hint: you have entered a state of silence.
You are unable to use any active skills, unable to use your backpack, and unable to speak. ”
“Oh no!
It’s over! ” Liu Huiying noticed that her other teammates had also entered a state of silence at the same time.
Zhou Lei’s expression darkened.
“That cane’s one of the Thirteen Holy Artifacts!
This is troublesome.
In this state, we won’t be able to teleport away. ”
Wu Xingwen clenched his fists.
He had a high explosive bomb on him.
If he fought with all his might, he might be able to interrupt Dai Ze’s spellcasting state.
Bang!
Just as everyone was thinking about how to escape, several ventilation duct openings in the corner of the wall were forced open!
Several red figures scuttled out of the ventilation duct.
After landing on the ground, they pounced on the vampire elder, Dai Ze.
It was the Lickers.
There was a chance to escape!
Whoosh!
Holding his cane, the old man continuously dodged and deftly avoided the attacks of the Lickers.
However, there were a dozen lickers that had scuttled out of the passage!
In such a narrow environment, Dai Ze had no way to dodge.
He could only retrieve his cane, raise it again, and point it at a Licker.
Thud!
The walking stick lightly touched a Licker’s forehead.
The Licker froze in midair for half a second.
Boom!
The Licker’s body exploded!
The moment the cane in Dai Ze’s hand left the ground, the silence spell immediately lost its effect.
“Quick!
Teleport! ” Nie Feiran immediately used her spatial skill.
A white light flashed, and Nie Feiran led the team in the passage to the second basement.
In the second basement, Zhou Lei felt as if he had run for thousands of meters.
His entire body was drained of energy.
He sat on the ground, gulped down a mouthful of cola, and panted heavily.
Liu Huiying’s face was also pale.
The silence spell cast by the vampire elder did not deal much damage to ordinary people, but it dealt a lot of damage to the two spirit-type players.
“Everyone, it seems that you have encountered some trouble. ”
Looking at Fang Heng who poked his head out from the ventilation duct at the side, Chen Ziyang raised his hand.
“Thank you. ”
“Thank you to your friends, too. ” Zhou Lei panted and continued, “Ordinary seals are only effective against ordinary vampires.
Against that Marquis of the vampires, the seal here is barely effective.
With him guarding the entrance, it will be difficult for us to go in and destroy the passage. ”
Everyone fell into silence.
Ahem.
Fang Heng stretched out half of his body from the ventilation duct and raised his hand.
“Everyone, I have a suggestion. ”
“Huh? ”
Everyone raised their heads and looked at Fang Heng who was lying in the ventilation duct.
“Fang Heng, why don’t you come down first before talking? ” Chen Ziyang felt that his stiff neck couldn’t take looking up at the ventilation duct anymore.
“No, it’s troublesome to crawl in and out. ”
The anti-demon seal formation on the ground was still in operation.
Fang Heng had a bad feeling about setting foot on it.
“Actually, I have a few relatively strong friends.
They can think of a way to sneak me alone into the teleportation array.
I can secretly go and destroy the teleportation array alone.
But once I make a move on the teleportation passage, the built-in alarm of the research institute will be triggered.
That old vampire from earlier will come after me, so you have to think of a way to trap him for a while. ”
Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei looked at each other and said, “In addition to our team’s coordinated effort, if we set up an anti-vampire formation to kill vampires in advance, we can trap him for a while.
The anti-vampire formation consumes a lot of energy, so we can only set it up once.
Moreover, we will not be fit for combat after activating the formation. ”
Fang Heng asked, “How long can we trap Dai Ze for? ”
“It will take about fifteen minutes to set up the formation.
Combining both the formation’s effects and our interference from the side, we can probably trap him for at least ten minutes. ”
Fang Heng made some calculations in his heart.
“10 minutes is still too short. ”
It seemed that after he constructed the inter-server passage, he had to rush over and help the team deal with the elder of the vampires.
Thinking of that, Fang Heng said, “It’s about enough time for me to destroy the teleportation passage.
I have no problem. ”
Wu Xingwen asked in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, your plan is very risky.
How confident are you? ”
Fang Heng shrugged and said in a relaxed manner, “Of course I’m 100% confident. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Malfunction
paragraphs: “Don’t worry, Parason. At least the stabilizer is still operating steadily, right? ”
Presently, due to the terrible situation in the outside world, the blood slaves had already stopped sending ores into the time passage.
The vampires continued to send reinforcements through the teleportation passage, directly joining the battlefield outside the research institute.
“Probably. ”
Parason’s expression was uglier than a crying one, indicating that he was not comforted by Fang Heng’s words at all.
Fang Heng smiled, looked at the time, and gently tapped the button on the command station.
The stabilizer suddenly dimmed.
Hum...
The noise from the high-speed rotating stabilizer immediately softened by more than half.
Then, the entire shelter sounded an alarm.
“Warning! Teleportation passage has malfunctioned! Please fix it immediately! ”
“Warning! Teleportation passage has malfunctioned! Please fix it immediately! ”
In the second basement, Wu Xingwen and the players who had led the old vampire into the enhanced sealing formation also heard the alarm.
They knew that Fang Heng had followed the plan.
Dai Ze was trapped in the anti-vampire formation.
Hearing the alarm, he realized that he had been fooled by the humans.
Dai Ze’s originally dark eyes were covered with a layer of scarlet.
“Was it you guys? ”
“Shut up! ”
Liu Huiying raised her pistol and fired.
Parason turned pale with fright. “As I feared, the stabilizer really malfunctioned... and at this time, too... ”
He saw that the fixed operating power of the stabilizer as displayed on the status monitor decreased significantly in a short period of time.
The decrease in power caused the teleportation passage to shrink to one-tenth of its original size in an instant.
With such a small passage opening, it was impossible for the vampires to enter through teleportation!
The reinforcements of the vampires were cut off!
“This... Fang Shuo! What’s wrong? ”
Fang Heng shook his head with a solemn expression and said, “Looks like we’ve encountered some trouble again. ”
“I’m asking, what exactly did we encounter... ”
Boom!
The next second, a few muffled loud bangs came from the passage entrance outside the main control room.
Three Tyrant forms used their bodies to break through the alloy door on the right side of the passage and walked into the hall.
“A total of three Tyrant forms? Since when did they infiltrate the research institute? ” Parason turned pale with fright as cold sweat dripped down his face.

Fang Heng curled his lips and said to Parason, “It seems that our troubles are even greater. I guess our previous guess was right. The Tyrant forms in the sixth basement cultivation pods have already awakened. I suggest that we quickly contact Mr. Sikong to control these Tyrant forms. ”
Parason turned around and looked at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng did not pay mind to his reaction and said, “Otherwise, if these Tyrant forms lose control, we’ll be helpless. ”
“Please, don’t say more... ” Parason quickly pulled Fang Heng back and stopped him from continuing.
He felt that Fang Heng was a bad luck ghoul that day. Everything he said came true.
Bang!
A few vampires at the side tried to rush forward to block the Tyrants’ footsteps, but they were sent flying by the Tyrants’ punch.
The Tyrants continued to move forward, striding toward the teleportation passage in the control center hall.
The vampires who were originally guarding the control center hall also pounced toward the Tyrant forms, trying to block their attack.
At the same time, the automatic cannons hidden in the hall were also activated, firing at the passage entrance.
Under the concentrated fire and attacks of the vampires, the Tyrant forms were trapped at the entrance, unable to break through.
“Mr. Su, I suggest that we don’t let them get close to the teleportation passage. ”
“Of course I know! Quickly think of a way to repair the teleportation passage! ”
Su Jincheng’s brain was hurting just as badly.
He didn’t have time to think about how the Tyrant forms had lost control. He and the other Night Owl players raised their guns and aimed at the weak points of the Tyrant forms.
Parason looked at the Tyrant forms that had already rushed to the entrance of the hall and was extremely anxious.
He couldn’t help but urge, “Have you found the cause of the data anomaly? How long will it take to repair the passage? ”
“Relax. I’m still checking the data. This can’t be rushed. ”
Fang Heng’s face was calm.
“Faster! ”
As soon as Parason finished speaking, a few more sizzling sounds could be heard.
When Parason heard the sound, he immediately thought of something terrifying.
His body stiffened, and he slowly turned his head to look in the direction of the door.
Under the dense attacks of the automatic cannons, a dozen Lickers darted into the hall while sticking close to the wall, bearing the attacks of the automatic cannons!
“”F*ck! ” Su Jincheng cursed loudly and threw a flashbang.
Bzz...
A dazzling white light flashed.
Before the Night Owl players could clear the Lickers that were stunned, more Lickers swarmed in from the passage entrance in the next second!
“Why now?! It’s difficult enough with the Tyrant forms. ” Su Jincheng immediately fired another flashbang.
He knew very well that they couldn’t hold on any longer.
Flashbangs could only last for a few seconds, and the effect would be greatly reduced if he used it multiple times in a short period of time!
Su Jincheng pulled out the cleaver in his hand, jumped forward, and slashed down.
Hiss!
Broken limbs flew up!
The sharp claws of the Lickers had been cut off by Su Jincheng!

Fang Heng pretended to control the command station and looked at Su Jincheng in surprise, thinking, “Seems like Su Jincheng also has a character talent that can increase close combat damage output. But it’s useless, anyway. There are too many Lickers around. ”
More Lickers stuck closely to the wall and rushed into the control center hall.
The numerous Lickers formed a red stream and almost instantly swallowed the defense line set up by the Night Owl players!
Seeing that the passage entrance could not be defended, Parason was completely flustered. He subconsciously retreated, looking for cover everywhere, squatting down and holding his head.
A Licker charged at him from the front.
Hiss!
Sharp claws charged down toward him from the air.
“Get lost! ” In a panic, Parason gave in to his survival instinct and picked up the large wrench beside him to block the attack.
Crack!
Parason’s arms trembled.
He did not know where he got the strength in his hands to block the Licker’s sharp claws.
Parason stared at the Licker in front of him, not even daring to breathe heavily.
The distance between the two was a few centimeters. He could even smell the blood on the Licker’s body.
At that critical moment, Parason heard Fang Heng shouting.
“Parason! What’s the control center’s password? Quick! ”
Parason placed his last hope on Fang Heng and immediately shouted, “278123! ”
“Okay, thank you. ”
Parason was stunned. He suddenly realized that something was wrong.
“Fang Shuo, you... ”
In the next moment, Parason felt a strong force coming down on his hand.
The Licker’s sharp claws directly swung the wrench in Parason’s hands away.
A white shadow flashed past, and the sharp claws pressed against Parason’s neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Purple Spatial Crystals
paragraphs: Parason’s eyes flashed with fear.
For a moment, his mind went blank.
Then, several thoughts appeared again.
“There’s something amiss about him! Is he from the Federation? But... why? ” Parason really couldn’t understand Fang Heng’s motive.
If he was from the Federation, he could have easily done something to the passage, and their plan wouldn’t have been carried out to this stage.
Therefore, Parason had never suspected Fang Heng.
Who exactly was he?
“I’m sorry, Parason, but you’ve mistaken me for someone else. I’m not Fang Shuo. ”
The Licker’s sharp claws slashed across Parason’s neck.
Hiss!
Blood splattered.
Fang Heng lowered his head and quickly entered the password into the main control platform.
“Hint: password verified. You have obtained the highest level of authority for the space tearing stabilizing device. ”
Fang Heng quickly tapped on the screen with both hands, changing the preset coordinates while keeping the device running.
“You have set up a new receiving platform and are in the process of updating the configuration... Please confirm that you have reset the destination coordinates... ”
Behind Fang Heng, the Lickers finished cleaning up the last two Night Owl organization players in the hall.
More than ten zombie clones staggered in from the main control room.
They searched the corpses on the ground for a moment, searched for wrenches, picked them up one by one, and then staggered to the space tearing stabilizing device.
Eighteen zombie clones surrounded the device and began to modify it.

“Hint: as per the player’s custom modification template, your zombie clones have partially modified the stabilizer. Current modification progress: 4% ... You have completed the reset of the space passage. Searching for receiving space signals... ”

After resetting the destination coordinates of the teleportation passage, Fang Heng took the opportunity to walk to a corner of the hall while the zombie clones were modifying the teleportation passage.
There were about ten big boxes piled up in the corner.
Those boxes were all moved in by the blood slaves from the outside.
Previously, due to the blockage of the teleportation passage, those boxes were temporarily piled up in the corner of the control room.
What could be inside?
Fang Heng was a little curious.
He walked forward and lifted the lid of one of the boxes.
The box was filled with purple crystals.
“What are these? ”
Fang Heng had never seen such large purple crystals. He reached out and took one out of the box, holding it in his hand to observe.
“Hint: you have found a purple spatial crystal. ”
Item: Purple spatial crystal.
Description: A special purple crystal that has been absorbing spatial energy for a long time. It contains a high concentration of spatial energy.
Description: this item is unique to the elementary game of Zombie Apocalypse. It only appears in a few servers.
Description: this item can not be stored in a backpack.
“A crystal that contains spatial energy... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself, puzzled.
He did not have any memories related to the purple crystals.
“Did the vampires spend so much effort to capture Server 5 just for these crystals? Well, whatever. ” Fang Heng decided not to think too much.
Since he had already opened the time passage, he could conveniently bring the purple crystal ores back later.
Qiu Yaokang was a genius, so he could probably find out something after researching the crystals.
“Hint: your Zombie clone has completed the modification.”
“Hint: player’s custom space tearing stabilizing device has been modified. ”
“It’s starting. ” Fang Heng muttered to himself as he pressed the red button on the main control platform.
“Hint: locking spatial coordinates... Matching spatial coordinates... Establishing communication... ”
“Hint: Spatial coordinates matching complete. ”
“Hint: connecting... ”

In the center of the control center hall, the black space passage, which had a radius of fewer than ten centimeters, instantly shrunk to its limit, then expanded in all directions at an extremely fast speed.
Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle...
The space passage emitted a continuous sizzling sound of electricity.
“It’s a success! ” Fang Heng fixed his gaze on the time passage that was once again expanding.
A faint ripple appeared at the passage opening.
A zombie staggered out of the passage.
“Hmm? It’s my zombie clone? ” Realization hit Fang Heng as he controlled the zombie clone to walk back.
Then, Mo Jiawei stepped out of the passage opening.
He saw Fang Heng at once.
“Fang Heng? ! ”
Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but swear because he was too surprised.
“F*ck! This is District 5? ”
Mo Jiawei knew that Fang Heng was doing something big, but he didn’t expect that he would build a time passage between District 5 and District 8.
“D*mn! What’s going on now? Is he preparing to move all the things in District 5 back home? ” he mused.
Then, Lucia and the Dark Knights also emerged.

After the Dark Knights received the news about the first-generation meteorite, they immediately came to support them. In order to move the first-generation meteorite, they had already put on protective suits to protect themselves from radiation.
Walking out of the time passage, Lucia looked at everything around her curiously. She felt that the world was both unfamiliar and familiar.
“Is this the parallel world? I didn’t expect to witness all of this with my own eyes. It’s really amazing. ”
David clicked his tongue and sighed.

“David, thank you for coming over to help. This research institute is very dangerous now. It could be destroyed at any time. We need to move the first-generation meteorite back as soon as possible. ” Fang Heng walked forward and handed the magnetic card to the laboratory in the sixth basement. “The first-generation meteorite is still in the seventh basement. You guys use this to enter through the laboratory entrance in the sixth basement... I’ll come back and meet you after I’m done with what I have to do. ”
David put away the magnetic card and nodded. “Okay. Leave the transportation of the materials to us. ”
“Fang Heng. ” Lucia took two steps forward and stopped Fang Heng, who was about to leave. “Do you need my help? ”
“Help me control the zombie team in the fifth basement. Use them to transport the materials. ”
“Okay. You have to be careful. ”
Fang Heng waved his hand and ran toward the second basement.
The vampires were extremely difficult to deal with. Wu Xingwen and his team alone wouldn’t be able to deal with them easily. Fang Heng thought that he had to hurry over and help.
In the passage of the second basement.
In order to buy Fang Heng time, Wu Xingwen and his team spent a lot of effort trapping Dai Ze in anti-vampire formation.
The formation trapped Dai Ze on the spot, rendering him unable to move. However, they couldn’t really threaten Dai Ze.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
Dai Ze, who was bound on the spot, waved his black robe and blocked the bullets one by one.
Boom!
Wu Xingwen raised his huge fist and smashed it toward Dai Ze.
Dai Ze raised his cane and gently poked forward.
When the cane touched Wu Xingwen’s fist, Wu Xingwen felt a strong force surging toward him. He was sent flying and crashed into the wall behind him.
“You guys are really annoying. ”
After being delayed for nearly ten minutes, Dai Ze was almost losing his patience. He felt the seal under his feet weakening and slowly extended his hand forward.

sentences.text: Parason’s eyes flashed with fear.
For a moment, his mind went blank.
Then, several thoughts appeared again.
“There’s something amiss about him!
Is he from the Federation?
But... why? ” Parason really couldn’t understand Fang Heng’s motive.
If he was from the Federation, he could have easily done something to the passage, and their plan wouldn’t have been carried out to this stage.
Therefore, Parason had never suspected Fang Heng.
Who exactly was he?
“I’m sorry, Parason, but you’ve mistaken me for someone else.
I’m not Fang Shuo. ”
The Licker’s sharp claws slashed across Parason’s neck.
Hiss!
Blood splattered.
Fang Heng lowered his head and quickly entered the password into the main control platform.
“Hint: password verified.
You have obtained the highest level of authority for the space tearing stabilizing device. ”
Fang Heng quickly tapped on the screen with both hands, changing the preset coordinates while keeping the device running.
“You have set up a new receiving platform and are in the process of updating the configuration...
Please confirm that you have reset the destination coordinates... ”
Behind Fang Heng, the Lickers finished cleaning up the last two Night Owl organization players in the hall.
More than ten zombie clones staggered in from the main control room.
They searched the corpses on the ground for a moment, searched for wrenches, picked them up one by one, and then staggered to the space tearing stabilizing device.
Eighteen zombie clones surrounded the device and began to modify it.
“Hint: as per the player’s custom modification template, your zombie clones have partially modified the stabilizer.
Current modification progress: 4% ...
You have completed the reset of the space passage.
Searching for receiving space signals... ”

After resetting the destination coordinates of the teleportation passage, Fang Heng took the opportunity to walk to a corner of the hall while the zombie clones were modifying the teleportation passage.
There were about ten big boxes piled up in the corner.
Those boxes were all moved in by the blood slaves from the outside.
Previously, due to the blockage of the teleportation passage, those boxes were temporarily piled up in the corner of the control room.
What could be inside?
Fang Heng was a little curious.
He walked forward and lifted the lid of one of the boxes.
The box was filled with purple crystals.
“What are these? ”
Fang Heng had never seen such large purple crystals.
He reached out and took one out of the box, holding it in his hand to observe.
“Hint: you have found a purple spatial crystal. ”
Item: Purple spatial crystal.
Description: A special purple crystal that has been absorbing spatial energy for a long time.
It contains a high concentration of spatial energy.
Description: this item is unique to the elementary game of Zombie Apocalypse.
It only appears in a few servers.
Description: this item can not be stored in a backpack.
“A crystal that contains spatial energy... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself, puzzled.
He did not have any memories related to the purple crystals.
“Did the vampires spend so much effort to capture Server 5 just for these crystals?
Well, whatever. ” Fang Heng decided not to think too much.
Since he had already opened the time passage, he could conveniently bring the purple crystal ores back later.
Qiu Yaokang was a genius, so he could probably find out something after researching the crystals.
“Hint: your Zombie clone has completed the modification.”
“Hint: player’s custom space tearing stabilizing device has been modified. ”
“It’s starting. ” Fang Heng muttered to himself as he pressed the red button on the main control platform.
“Hint: locking spatial coordinates...
Matching spatial coordinates...
Establishing communication... ”
“Hint: Spatial coordinates matching complete. ”
“Hint: connecting... ”

In the center of the control center hall, the black space passage, which had a radius of fewer than ten centimeters, instantly shrunk to its limit, then expanded in all directions at an extremely fast speed.
Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle...
The space passage emitted a continuous sizzling sound of electricity.
“It’s a success! ” Fang Heng fixed his gaze on the time passage that was once again expanding.
A faint ripple appeared at the passage opening.
A zombie staggered out of the passage.
“Hmm?
It’s my zombie clone? ” Realization hit Fang Heng as he controlled the zombie clone to walk back.
Then, Mo Jiawei stepped out of the passage opening.
He saw Fang Heng at once.
“Fang Heng? ! ”
Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but swear because he was too surprised.
“F*ck!
This is District 5? ”
Mo Jiawei knew that Fang Heng was doing something big, but he didn’t expect that he would build a time passage between District 5 and District 8.
“D*mn!
What’s going on now?
Is he preparing to move all the things in District 5 back home? ” he mused.
Then, Lucia and the Dark Knights also emerged.
After the Dark Knights received the news about the first-generation meteorite, they immediately came to support them.
In order to move the first-generation meteorite, they had already put on protective suits to protect themselves from radiation.
Walking out of the time passage, Lucia looked at everything around her curiously.
She felt that the world was both unfamiliar and familiar.
“Is this the parallel world?
I didn’t expect to witness all of this with my own eyes.
It’s really amazing. ”
David clicked his tongue and sighed.
“David, thank you for coming over to help.
This research institute is very dangerous now.
It could be destroyed at any time.
We need to move the first-generation meteorite back as soon as possible. ” Fang Heng walked forward and handed the magnetic card to the laboratory in the sixth basement.
“The first-generation meteorite is still in the seventh basement.
You guys use this to enter through the laboratory entrance in the sixth basement...
I’ll come back and meet you after I’m done with what I have to do. ”
David put away the magnetic card and nodded.
“Okay.
Leave the transportation of the materials to us. ”
“Fang Heng. ” Lucia took two steps forward and stopped Fang Heng, who was about to leave.
“Do you need my help? ”
“Help me control the zombie team in the fifth basement.
Use them to transport the materials. ”
“Okay.
You have to be careful. ”
Fang Heng waved his hand and ran toward the second basement.
The vampires were extremely difficult to deal with.
Wu Xingwen and his team alone wouldn’t be able to deal with them easily.
Fang Heng thought that he had to hurry over and help.
In the passage of the second basement.
In order to buy Fang Heng time, Wu Xingwen and his team spent a lot of effort trapping Dai Ze in anti-vampire formation.
The formation trapped Dai Ze on the spot, rendering him unable to move.
However, they couldn’t really threaten Dai Ze.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
Dai Ze, who was bound on the spot, waved his black robe and blocked the bullets one by one.
Boom!
Wu Xingwen raised his huge fist and smashed it toward Dai Ze.
Dai Ze raised his cane and gently poked forward.
When the cane touched Wu Xingwen’s fist, Wu Xingwen felt a strong force surging toward him.
He was sent flying and crashed into the wall behind him.
“You guys are really annoying. ”
After being delayed for nearly ten minutes, Dai Ze was almost losing his patience.
He felt the seal under his feet weakening and slowly extended his hand forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Siege
paragraphs: Red blood condensed in the air and slowly gathered in Dai Ze’s palm.
“To be able to do this, the demon hunters... ”
As he spoke, Dai Ze suddenly felt something and frowned.
Bang!
The vent of the ventilation duct on the ceiling behind Dai Ze was smashed open with a bang.
A series of red shadows drilled out from the ceiling!
It was Lickers.
The Lickers pounced on Dai Ze once again.
Wu Xingwen and the others were pleasantly surprised.
Obviously, Fang Heng had come!
The Lickers surged toward Dai Ze and surrounded him, waving their sharp claws and attacking crazily.
Dai Ze’s feet were bound, and he could not move. He tried his best to dodge with his body.
However, there were too many Lickers. He was quickly tightly surrounded by them.
Thud!
Fang Heng jumped down from the ventilation duct behind Wu Xingwen and the others.
Seeing that Fang Heng had rushed over to support them, Zhou Lei was pleasantly surprised. He shouted, “Fang Heng! ”
Wu Xingwen was more concerned about the teleportation passage. He hurriedly asked, “How’s the teleportation passage? ”
“It’s done! ”
Fang Heng gave everyone a thumbs up.

Wu Xingwen and the others naturally thought that Fang Heng was referring to the fact that the teleportation passage had been destroyed. Immediately, they felt a huge weight lifted off their shoulders.

To the people of the Federation, as long as they could destroy the teleportation passage, the mission would be considered complete. Even if they had to hand over their lives here, it would still be worth it!
Chen Ziyang said excitedly, “Well done, Fang Heng! ”
Fang Heng was in a good mood as well. “I did okay. The credit goes to my friend, who’s reliable. ”
“Extremely reliable indeed! ”
Liu Huiying stared at Dai Ze who was in front of the Lickers and said in a deep voice, “Don’t be in a hurry to celebrate. Let’s get rid of this trouble first. ”
The Lickers that were attacking Dai Ze crazily emitted sizzling sounds.
Dai Ze’s entire body was burning with a layer of blood mist!
Affected by the blood mist, the Lickers that were attacking crazily had their HP dropped drastically.
Fang Heng’s game log instantly flooded the screen.
“Hint: your zombie clone (Licker) has been attacked by blood magic. ”
“Hint: Your zombie clone (Licker) has received a blood magic attack... ”
“Such quick HP loss? ” Fang Heng thought to himself.
“Quick! Fall back! ” Fang Heng shouted and took the lead to retreat to the back of the corner.
When the party heard that, they quickly retreated.
The Lickers’ HP quickly fell below 10% .
“Blood explosion! ” Fang Heng immediately cast his skill.
Boom! Boom!
The Lickers around Dai Ze self-destructed at close range.
The splashing blood corroded the surrounding walls into a few large black holes.

“Self-destruction... ” Zhou Lei was secretly shocked by the self-destructive power of the Lickers. “But why does this move seem so similar to the ability of vampires? ” he inwardly thought, casting a puzzled gaze at Fang Heng.
Wu Xingwen was also puzzled. He felt that the self-detonation of the Lickers was a little familiar, and it was very similar to the scene he previously saw in the video.
“All of you... must die! ”
A cold voice rang out in the middle of the passage.
Dai Ze was not dead.
His entire body was enveloped by a blood-colored mist that was constantly steaming.

His body had expanded by a few times. With the steaming blood-colored mist, it was impossible to see his face clearly. One could only vaguely see a blood-colored human figure that was constantly burning and emitting steam.
“This... ”
Zhou Lei and Liu Huiying looked at each other at the same time, thinking, “Burning Blood Transformation! ”

“Be careful. Burning Blood Transformation will cause permanent and irreversible damage to the vampires. However, it can also allow them to gain a powerful destructive ability for a period of time, ” Zhou Lei explained to the players in a low voice.
Crack crack, crack...
Relying on the strength boost from Burning Blood Transformation, Dai Ze tried to lift his right leg.
The countless seals that wrapped around Dai Ze’s legs were pulled to their limits!
Crack, crack, crack, crack!
The seals’ endurance reached their limit! Every single seal was broken!
Dai Ze’s greatest aggro was now focused on Fang Heng.
Fang Heng stood where he was and looked at the blood-red creature in front of him. His brows were tightly furrowed.
A special skill of the vampires?
Why did it sound so disgusting?

Fang Heng did not want to turn into Dai Ze’s disgusting appearance one day in the future. He was not inclined to use the abilities of the vampires as much. It would be enough to increase the basic attribute.
“Go to hell, demon hunter! ”
Dai Ze, whose entire body was burning with scarlet blood, strode toward Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng! Be careful! ” Chen Ziyang shouted.
Boom!
As soon as he said that, the side of the pathway in front of Fang Heng suddenly broke open.
A huge shadow rushed out from the broken wall.
It was a Tyrant form!
After breaking through the wall, the Tyrant used its shoulder to hit Dai ze.
Bang!
Dai Ze, who was in a Burning Blood state, was knocked away by this sudden collision.
Boom! Boom!
The Tyrant raised his fist and started thrashing Dai Ze.
Behind the passage, Zhou Lei was shocked by the scene. “A Tyrant? Fang Heng can actually control Tyrants to fight? ”
Wu Xingwen’s eyes were also flashing with surprise.
He had read Fang Heng’s report, and it contained some explanation regarding Fang Heng’s ability to control the Tyrant forms.
The Federation’s analysis team believed that it was a special ability that Fang Heng could use only under extremely special circumstances and that it could not be used for a long period of time.
But the scene in front of him told Wu Xingwen that Fang Heng could completely control the Tyrant forms!
“Has his ability evolved again? ” wondered Wu Xingwen.

The Tyrant form had an additional 50% attribute bonus from Fang Heng. In terms of attributes, it was stronger than ordinary Tyrants. Even so, the strength of the Tyrant form was slightly inferior to Dai Ze’s in the Burning Blood state.
The two entangled together and continuously swung their fists to fiercely attack each other.
It was one fist for one fist.
The dull sound of fists colliding could be heard in the passage.
A burning bloody mark was left on the Tyrant’s body as it continuously retreated.
“Think of a way to help him! ”
The players present had far better eyesight than ordinary people.
They could clearly see that the strength attribute of the Tyrant that Fang Heng controlled was far above that of ordinary Tyrant forms.
However, it was still a little inferior to Dai Ze who was in the Burning Blood Transformation state.
Dai Ze’s body was covered in a bloody mist. Once it touched the boiling blood mist, the Tyrant form would be greatly injured!
“Zhou Lei, help me. ”
“Okay! ”
Liu Huiying lowered her head, rummaged through her backpack, and began to set up a sealing formation to seal the vampire on the spot.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Suddenly, a few heavy sounds rang out.
Zhou Lei, who had lowered his head and was about to coordinate with Liu Huiying to set up the formation, was startled for a moment. He raised his head and looked toward the front of the passage.
Several more holes had been opened in the wall of the passage.
A total of eight Tyrant forms had drilled out from the holes in the wall!
When one-on-one against Dai Ze who was in the Burning Blood state, the Tyrant form was at a disadvantage.
But presently, a total of nine Tyrant forms had surrounded Dai Ze.
Bang! Bang Bang!
Dai Ze was surrounded in the middle and was continuously attacked by the numerous Tyrant forms like a sandbag.
