chapters.title: Chapter 385 - Vampiric Spirit Cane
paragraphs: In the passage, the players fell into a short silence.
Zhou Lei swallowed his saliva and carefully looked at Fang Heng.
“So many Tyrants? Fang Heng can control so many of them at the same time? ”

Taking into consideration that Fang Heng had played an important role in getting the operation to the current stage, Zhou Lei thought that his evaluation of Fang Heng was already very high. However, he did not expect that he still underestimated Fang Heng’s strength.
“I forgot to mention that I have quite a lot of friends! ” Fang Heng laughed lightly and was quite pleased with himself.
Compared to personally going up to fight, he preferred the feeling of calling his underlings to go up and gang up on the enemy. It was safe and efficient.
Liu Huiying quickly reacted and called out to Zhou Lei, who was still in a daze.
“Continue! Zhou Lei, quickly cooperate with me to set up the seal. ”
Zhou Lei came back to his senses. He continued to focus, lowering his head to help Liu Huiying set up the magic array.
“Eh? ” Noticing that the magic array that was originally set up had been changed, Zhou Lei let out a soft exclamation.
He raised his head to look at Liu Huiying and immediately understood. A flash of excitement flashed across his eyes. He kept his mouth shut and focused on setting up the magic array.
Meanwhile, the ten Tyrant forms surrounded Dai Ze, who was in the Burning Blood state, and beat him up for more than ten minutes!
When the Burning Blood state was at the maximum, just getting close to Dai Ze would result in damage, not to mention using one’s fist to attack him in close combat.
The fists of the Tyrant forms had already been burned into a bloody mess by the bloody mist.
However, the Tyrant forms also possessed a super strong self-healing ability, so they had a huge advantage in terms of HP!
The burning bloody mist gradually became illusory, and Dai Ze’s body, which was shrouded in bloody mist, began to sway slightly.
The Burning Blood Transformation required extremely high energy consumption, and Dai Ze gradually couldn’t hold on.
Bang!
The bloody figure exploded!
Fang Heng was slightly stunned. “Self-destruction? Blood explosion? No, wait... The blood splattered everywhere isn’t doing any damage! ”
In the next moment, the blood turned into a dense mass of blood-colored bats in the air!
Fang Heng raised his brows.
“What the hell? ”
The blood-colored bats scattered in all directions.
The Tyrant closest to them threw a punch at it.
Bang!
The blood-colored bat was instantly smashed into a pool of blood!
“You want to run now, Old Man? ”
Zhou Lei snorted lightly. He had long been prepared.
“Liu Huiying! ”

Liu Huiying completed the drawing of the magic array at the last moment. She pressed her palms together and placed them in the center of the magic array that had just been set up, pouring mental strength in.
The magic array instantly triggered a golden light that quickly extended forward along the floor, forming a clear dark golden barrier in front of the passage.
The barrier completely sealed the passage!
Screech...
The blood-colored bats that were fleeing in all directions crashed into the barrier, directly exploding into a cloud of blood mist.
“Quick! Take them out now! ” Zhou Lei shouted. “Use silver bullets! ”
When the players and Wu Xingwen heard that, they all switched to their special revolvers that were filled with silver bullets, aiming at the blood bats in the air and firing.

The silver bullets were engraved with magic patterns that targeted vampires. They were extremely effective against vampires. As long as the bullets grazed the bats, they would evaporate and burn into ashes.
In a moment, all the remaining blood-colored bats in the passage were completely slaughtered.
Following which, the last blood-colored bat landed on the ground.
The blood that was left on the ground solidified again and transformed into Dai Ze’s corpse.

“Hint: your team has killed a special character in the world of vampires, Dai Ze. The overall contribution has been determined. You have obtained a special item, Dai Ze’s blood crystal, 278 survival points, and a Tier 2 evolution crystal. ”
Fang Heng found a scarlet gem in his backpack.
Item: Dai Ze’s blood crystal.

Description: The blood crystal of the Marquis of the vampires, Dai Ze. You can exchange it for Demon Hunter Association reputation points after entering the world of the vampires. You can also try to find other ways to use it.

Special description (triggered by the skill low-level vampire level 7) : Try the energy of the blood crystal, and there is a chance of breaking through the upper limit of bloodlines. The success rate is related to the blood crystal (currently, the bloodline level has not been upgraded to level 15. Player can not use this ability).

Special description (triggered by the skill basic occult level 11) : the crystal of the vampires has relatively high life energy. It can be used as an advanced material in alchemy, potionology, occult, and so on.
“Oh... ” Fang Heng looked at the crystal’s description, and his eyes lit up.
“Breaking the upper limit of bloodlines? Does this mean that low-level vampire skills can be upgraded to mid-level ones? ”
Fang Heng opened the description of the low-level Vampire Bloodline skill. It was noted that the skills could be upgraded in certain ways.
“I’ll save it for when the Vampire Bloodline reaches level 15! ”
Screech, screech, screech!
A few Licker survivors in the passage smelled the blood and pounced on the miserable vampire corpse on the ground.
“Hint: your Licker has absorbed the blood’s strength. You have obtained 124 low-level vampire bloodline experience points. ”
“Hint: your Licker... ”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. “What a high number of experience points! ”
Ever since they learned the skill Vampire Bloodline, the zombie clones had also inherited the gnawing skill. The corpse of a high-level vampire was extremely attractive to them.
In the blink of an eye, the Lickers devoured Dai Ze’s corpse.
“Hint: your low-level Vampire Bloodline skill has been upgraded to level 11. ”
The level of Vampire Bloodline had increased by a whole 4 levels!
It seemed that the energy contained in the blood of the Marquis of the vampires was very high. After absorbing the blood, the skill level increased rapidly.
Fang Heng inwardly thought, “Hmm? What’s that? ”
Under the remains of the corpse, there was a wooden stick.
“Oh! It’s the cane that the old vampire kept holding. ”
For some reason, Fang Heng felt a strong desire to possess the cane from the bottom of his heart.
Fang Heng felt that something was not right. He slowly walked forward, squatted down, and reached out to pick up the cane.
“Be careful! ”
“Don’t touch it! ”
Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei stopped him almost at the same time.
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the two of them inquiringly. “Huh? ”
“Fang Heng, this is a holy weapon of the vampires. If you touch it rashly, you will suffer the backlash. ”

“Holy weapon of the vampires? ” Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly, musing. “From the name, it seems to be quite powerful. I also have Vampire Bloodline, so I shouldn’t suffer any backlash, right? ”
Fang Heng continued to reach for the cane.
The next second, a game hint flashed in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: bloodline authentication successful. You have obtained the item Vampiric Spirit Cane (inferior) . ”
Item: Vampiric Spirit Cane (inferior) .
Description: special item. Soul-binding. Occupies a special backpack slot. Can not be discarded. Will definitely drop after death.

Description: one of the Thirteen Holy Artifacts of the vampires rumored to possess great strength. Effects activate once placed into the backpack. Increases basic agility by 1, basic strength by 1, basic vitality by 1, and blood affinity by 3.
Description: additional silence skill.

Description: consumes mental strength, causing all living beings within the range to be unable to use skills, speak, or use their backpacks. This state requires continuous spellcasting movements and mental strength consumption. The maximum duration is 5 seconds. Cooldown time: 3 hours (skill consumption, skill effect range, maximum duration of the skill, and cooldown time are related to the level of Vampire Bloodline) .
Description: the Thirteen Holy Artifacts allegedly contain the greatest secret of the vampires. Additional effects can be obtained by obtaining more of the holy weapons of the vampires.
Description: Set effect of the next tier (three holy weapons) : player’s basic attribute will be increased by 2 points.

Description: this Spirit Cane is marked with a faint “2. ” Every Vampire Apocalypse will have its corresponding Thirteen Holy Artifacts of the vampires. Upon gathering five Vampiric Spirit Canes (inferior) , they can be synthesized into Vampiric Spirit Cane (elite) via a vampiric ritual.
Additional description: elite Vampiric Spirit Canes have a stronger effect. If the synthesis is successful, all the inferior Vampiric Spirit Canes will lose their effects.

sentences.text: In the passage, the players fell into a short silence.
Zhou Lei swallowed his saliva and carefully looked at Fang Heng.
“So many Tyrants?
Fang Heng can control so many of them at the same time? ”
Taking into consideration that Fang Heng had played an important role in getting the operation to the current stage, Zhou Lei thought that his evaluation of Fang Heng was already very high.
However, he did not expect that he still underestimated Fang Heng’s strength.
“I forgot to mention that I have quite a lot of friends! ” Fang Heng laughed lightly and was quite pleased with himself.
Compared to personally going up to fight, he preferred the feeling of calling his underlings to go up and gang up on the enemy.
It was safe and efficient.
Liu Huiying quickly reacted and called out to Zhou Lei, who was still in a daze.
“Continue!
Zhou Lei, quickly cooperate with me to set up the seal. ”
Zhou Lei came back to his senses.
He continued to focus, lowering his head to help Liu Huiying set up the magic array.
“Eh? ” Noticing that the magic array that was originally set up had been changed, Zhou Lei let out a soft exclamation.
He raised his head to look at Liu Huiying and immediately understood.
A flash of excitement flashed across his eyes.
He kept his mouth shut and focused on setting up the magic array.
Meanwhile, the ten Tyrant forms surrounded Dai Ze, who was in the Burning Blood state, and beat him up for more than ten minutes!
When the Burning Blood state was at the maximum, just getting close to Dai Ze would result in damage, not to mention using one’s fist to attack him in close combat.
The fists of the Tyrant forms had already been burned into a bloody mess by the bloody mist.
However, the Tyrant forms also possessed a super strong self-healing ability, so they had a huge advantage in terms of HP!
The burning bloody mist gradually became illusory, and Dai Ze’s body, which was shrouded in bloody mist, began to sway slightly.
The Burning Blood Transformation required extremely high energy consumption, and Dai Ze gradually couldn’t hold on.
Bang!
The bloody figure exploded!
Fang Heng was slightly stunned.
“Self-destruction?
Blood explosion?
No, wait...
The blood splattered everywhere isn’t doing any damage! ”
In the next moment, the blood turned into a dense mass of blood-colored bats in the air!
Fang Heng raised his brows.
“What the hell? ”
The blood-colored bats scattered in all directions.
The Tyrant closest to them threw a punch at it.
Bang!
The blood-colored bat was instantly smashed into a pool of blood!
“You want to run now, Old Man? ”
Zhou Lei snorted lightly.
He had long been prepared.
“Liu Huiying! ”
Liu Huiying completed the drawing of the magic array at the last moment.
She pressed her palms together and placed them in the center of the magic array that had just been set up, pouring mental strength in.
The magic array instantly triggered a golden light that quickly extended forward along the floor, forming a clear dark golden barrier in front of the passage.
The barrier completely sealed the passage!
Screech...
The blood-colored bats that were fleeing in all directions crashed into the barrier, directly exploding into a cloud of blood mist.
“Quick!
Take them out now! ” Zhou Lei shouted.
“Use silver bullets! ”
When the players and Wu Xingwen heard that, they all switched to their special revolvers that were filled with silver bullets, aiming at the blood bats in the air and firing.
The silver bullets were engraved with magic patterns that targeted vampires.
They were extremely effective against vampires.
As long as the bullets grazed the bats, they would evaporate and burn into ashes.
In a moment, all the remaining blood-colored bats in the passage were completely slaughtered.
Following which, the last blood-colored bat landed on the ground.
The blood that was left on the ground solidified again and transformed into Dai Ze’s corpse.
“Hint: your team has killed a special character in the world of vampires, Dai Ze.
The overall contribution has been determined.
You have obtained a special item, Dai Ze’s blood crystal, 278 survival points, and a Tier 2 evolution crystal. ”
Fang Heng found a scarlet gem in his backpack.
Item: Dai Ze’s blood crystal.
Description: The blood crystal of the Marquis of the vampires, Dai Ze.
You can exchange it for Demon Hunter Association reputation points after entering the world of the vampires.
You can also try to find other ways to use it.
Special description (triggered by the skill low-level vampire level 7) : Try the energy of the blood crystal, and there is a chance of breaking through the upper limit of bloodlines.
The success rate is related to the blood crystal (currently, the bloodline level has not been upgraded to level 15.
Player can not use this ability).
Special description (triggered by the skill basic occult level 11) : the crystal of the vampires has relatively high life energy.
It can be used as an advanced material in alchemy, potionology, occult, and so on.
“Oh... ” Fang Heng looked at the crystal’s description, and his eyes lit up.
“Breaking the upper limit of bloodlines?
Does this mean that low-level vampire skills can be upgraded to mid-level ones? ”
Fang Heng opened the description of the low-level Vampire Bloodline skill.
It was noted that the skills could be upgraded in certain ways.
“I’ll save it for when the Vampire Bloodline reaches level 15! ”
Screech, screech, screech!
A few Licker survivors in the passage smelled the blood and pounced on the miserable vampire corpse on the ground.
“Hint: your Licker has absorbed the blood’s strength.
You have obtained 124 low-level vampire bloodline experience points. ”
“Hint: your Licker... ”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
“What a high number of experience points! ”
Ever since they learned the skill Vampire Bloodline, the zombie clones had also inherited the gnawing skill.
The corpse of a high-level vampire was extremely attractive to them.
In the blink of an eye, the Lickers devoured Dai Ze’s corpse.
“Hint: your low-level Vampire Bloodline skill has been upgraded to level 11. ”
The level of Vampire Bloodline had increased by a whole 4 levels!
It seemed that the energy contained in the blood of the Marquis of the vampires was very high.
After absorbing the blood, the skill level increased rapidly.
Fang Heng inwardly thought, “Hmm?
What’s that? ”
Under the remains of the corpse, there was a wooden stick.
“Oh!
It’s the cane that the old vampire kept holding. ”
For some reason, Fang Heng felt a strong desire to possess the cane from the bottom of his heart.
Fang Heng felt that something was not right.
He slowly walked forward, squatted down, and reached out to pick up the cane.
“Be careful! ”
“Don’t touch it! ”
Liu Huiying and Zhou Lei stopped him almost at the same time.
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the two of them inquiringly.
“Huh? ”
“Fang Heng, this is a holy weapon of the vampires.
If you touch it rashly, you will suffer the backlash. ”
“Holy weapon of the vampires? ” Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly, musing.
“From the name, it seems to be quite powerful.
I also have Vampire Bloodline, so I shouldn’t suffer any backlash, right? ”
Fang Heng continued to reach for the cane.
The next second, a game hint flashed in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: bloodline authentication successful.
You have obtained the item Vampiric Spirit Cane (inferior) . ”

Will definitely drop after death.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Stock Up
paragraphs: It seemed to be a very powerful item.
Fang Heng pondered in his heart as he held the Spirit Cane in his hand and observed it.

“Its silence skill can be extremely useful in certain situations. The ‘2’ on it probably signifies that it’s from Server 2 of Vampire Apocalypse. Did the group of vampires come from there? ” Fang Heng pondered in his heart and openly put the Spirit Cane into his backpack.
Seeing that Fang Heng easily picked up the cane, the others were still relatively expressionless, but Zhou Lei and Liu Huiying were so shocked that they could not speak.
The two of them looked at each other and saw the shock in each other’s eyes. “How can a human easily pick up an item of the vampires? Not unless... he’s a vampire! ”
Zhou Lei looked at Fang Heng in a daze, not knowing what to say.
“Fang Heng, you... ”
Fang Heng didn’t show politeness. He held the cane in his hand. “Since no one can use it, how about I take it? ”
The other players in the party didn’t know much about the vampires’ holy weapons, so they weren’t as shocked as Zhou Lei and Liu Huiying.
Considering that they had had to rely on Fang Heng’s Tyrants to kill the zombies, no one had any objection to the distribution of the loot.
“Thank you. ” Fang Heng put the cane into his backpack as he spoke.
Wu Xingwen nodded and said, “Everyone, the mission has been completed. We must hurry and leave immediately. ”
“My mental strength has been used up too much. I can’t use my teleportation skill for a short period of time. ”
Previously, Nie Feiran had used her teleportation skill to trap Dai Ze in the magic array. At the moment, her mental strength could not withstand the strain of teleportation anymore.

“Then we can only use the ventilation duct. ” Fang Heng pointed at the ventilation duct on the ceiling behind him. “Climb up when inside. You will soon find the entrance to the sewer. It will lead the way for you. ”
As he spoke, a Licker that had survived the battle crawled to Wu Xingwen’s feet, looking very obedient.
Chen Ziyang looked at the Licker and swallowed his saliva carefully.
Wu Xingwen was stunned. “Eh? Are you not coming with us? ”
“No, I have to stay. ”
“Why? ”

“I found something when I destroyed the teleportation passage. Night Owl left 5 frozen Tier 5 giant zombies in the research institute. It must be Sikong Mao who wants to borrow the strength of the giant zombies to deal with the Federation. If we don’t deal with them, the Federation will suffer a huge loss. ”
Wu Xingwen was silent for a while before saying, “I’ll stay with you. The rest of you should leave first. ”
“Stop joking. You should hurry back. Givern your state, staying here won’t help. ”
Fang Heng waved his hand and said casually, “By the way, did you guys bring a lot of explosives? ”
Chen Ziyang rummaged through his backpack and said, “I have all the explosives. I was going to use the bombs to blow up the passage. ”
“Give them all to me. After I finish off the giant zombies, I’ll destroy the entire research institute and the teleportation passage beyond repair. ”

Everyone looked at each other. Of course, they knew that Fang Heng would take a huge risk if he stayed alone. Besides the possibility of lurking vampires, the research institute also had an automatic defense system, so there was also the possibility of encountering a player from the Night Owl organization.
Wu Xingwen took a step forward, saluted Fang Heng, and said solemnly, “On behalf of the Federation of Server 5, I thank you for the sacrifice you made for the glory and peace of Server 5. ”
“Who sacrificed? ” Fang Heng’s face darkened as he mused. “What are you doing? Are you going to make such a fuss and not pay? ”
Fang Heng waved at Wu Xingwen. “Hurry up and leave. Don’t waste time. I’m very safe. ”
“Okay! You must come back safely. ” After thinking carefully, Wu Xingwen felt relieved.
Probably, only Fang Heng, who had powerful Tyrants as support, could do whatever he wanted in the research institute.
“Let’s go. ” Wu Xingwen nodded at the team. He followed the pipe that Fang Heng pointed at. It was led by the Licker, and they climbed in one by one.
Main Control Room, second basement.
Elite Dark Knights were in full protective suits trying to move the first-generation meteorite into the teleportation passage.
On the other side, more than ten zombies were each waving a wrench around the mass-produced Tyrant T103 cultivation pod, preparing to chop it into pieces and bring it back to the shelter.
Mo Jiawei’s breathing was heavy, and his eyes were full of excitement. “D*ng! Seems like Fang Heng came to Server 5 to stock up! ”
With this trip to Server 5, they could earn a lot just from the blue crystals.
For a long time, they would not be troubled over blue energy crystals.

“Fang Heng, the blue energy crystals and the purple spatial crystals have been sent back to the shelter! ” Seeing Fang Heng return, Mo Jiawei excitedly waved his hand and reported the progress of the stock up to him. “The radiation from the first-generation meteorite is not strong. Victor is already rushing to create a temporary isolation room. Also, regarding the coffins for the giant zombies, it’s a bit troublesome. Genius Qiu wants to temporarily freeze them... ”

While the two were talking, David walked toward Fang Heng. “Fang Heng, finding the first-generation meteorite means a lot to us! I believe that we can definitely find a way to crack the Primogenitor virus. The day of the reconstruction of human civilization will soon come. ”
David couldn’t help but feel a little excited.
The Dark Knights had been trying to save the apocalypse ever since it was created.
After learning that the first-generation meteorite was destroyed, David once fell into despair.
He did not expect Fang Heng to bring him such a huge surprise!
“When we return, we will immediately start researching the first-generation meteorite. This is a big project, so we still need some time... I will contact you as soon as I have news. ”
“Hint: you have submitted the first-generation meteorite to the Dark Knights. ”
“Hint: you have completed the 16th stage main storyline: first-generation meteorite. ”
“Hint: you have received 20 thousand survival points. You have received 10 thousand Dark Knights Honor Points. Your reputation in the Dark Knights has increased. ”
“Hint: the next stage of the mission will be triggered after a period of time. ”
Fang Heng quickly scanned through the game hints.
Compared to the difficulty of searching for the first-generation meteorite, the mission reward was not very generous.
The resistance by Night Owl had caused him to take a long time. He had only found the first-generation meteorite after going around in circles.
Fang Heng thought to himself that Night Owl’s unluckiness was real. If they had not destroyed the first-generation meteorite in Server 8, he would not have come to Server 5 to disturb Night Owl.
After all, he had stolen a lot of good things from Night Owl on the current trip to Server 5.
He would just take it as getting some interest first and settle the debt with Night Owl in the future.
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then turned to look at David. “Oh right, David, I encountered something during my investigation of the first-generation meteorite. ”
“Oh? What is it? ”
“It’s a type of worm. ”
Fang Heng felt that it was necessary to remind David.

“When I was inspecting the first-generation meteorite, I discovered a strange type of worm. In another parallel world, the Dark Knights had a major accident while researching the first-generation meteorites. They need to be especially careful when researching the first generation meteorite... ”

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Greatly Encouraged
paragraphs: Fang Heng told David about what he had seen and heard in District 7.
“There was an accident in the research... the Scavenger Army... ”
David’s expression became more serious after hearing that.
“Thank you for your reminder, Fang Heng. I will set up a special laboratory when I go back to strictly guard against possible biological infections. ”
A game hint flashed in front of Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: your reminder to David will have a significant impact on the follow-up mission. ”
“Hint: the unknown impact is being determined... ”
It seemed that the reminder was effective!
He hoped that with the reminder, he could change the main storyline a little so that District 8 would not have a Scavenger Army.
Looking at the zombies enthusiastically transporting the goods, Fang Heng sighed in his heart. “What a pity! ”
He had suddenly remembered that there was still half a truck full of blue crystal raw ores outside that hadn’t been moved back in time!
The unobtained half-truck full of blue crystal raw ores had become the biggest regret of the trip to District 5.
After roughly estimating the time, Fang Heng installed the explosive device in the control center hall and set it to automatically detonate after 30 minutes.
After settling everything, Fang Heng prepared to return to District 8 first.
Just as he was about to step into the spatial rift, game hints appeared again.
“Hint: you are about to enter Server 8 through the teleportation passage. ”

“Hint: there are items in your backpack that can not pass through the spatial rift. If the items remain in your backpack (excluding the special grids and the warp backpack) , they will be cleared after passing through the spatial rift. ”
“Hint: player can move the item through the spatial rift but not directly through the backpack. ”
Fang Heng stopped walking.
Even after the spatial rift expanded, a player could not carry the backpack along for intra-server teleportation.
“Such troublesome settings, ” Fang Heng muttered and rummaged through his backpack.

The first-generation meteorite had already been sent back to Qiu Yaokang for research. Now, the more valuable things left in his backpack were just four books on Occult that were brought in from outside the game.
It was simple!
Fang Heng directly took the Occult books in his hand and passed through the spatial rift.
“Hint: you have returned to Server 8 through the space passage. ”
“Hint: the Team Assembly Order that you are bound to has become invalid. ”
“Quick! What are you doing! The blood in the bucket is a very valuable research item! It is stored in Warehouse No. 24 alone!”
“The purple spatial crystals also need to be stored alone. Has Storage Room No. 18 not been cleaned up yet? ”
The basement of the prison shelter was bustling with activity. Qiu Yaokang was in high spirits as he ordered the NPC survivors to sort out the materials that had been moved out from District 5.
Fang Heng yawned.
Strong drowsiness hit him. He really wanted to find a place to sleep.

“Fang Heng, you’re finally back. I’ve been looking for you for a long time. We need to build a freezing chamber immediately to seal the giant zombies. Furthermore, the first-generation meteorite fragments are relatively small, and the radiation level isn’t high. It shouldn’t be a problem for us to research it after wearing protective suits. ” Qiu Yaokang immediately walked over when he saw Fang Heng.
Even though Qiu Yaokang maintained a cold expression, his voice was still trembling slightly due to his excitement.

“Also, I don’t know how the Night Owl organization managed to put Tier 5 mutated giant zombies into a deep sleep and freeze them. I guess they must have more advanced methods. If we study them in detail, we should be able to get some information. There are also the purple spatial crystals. I’ve roughly observed their structures from the outside. It’s a special heptagon crystal space structure. I’ve never seen a similar structure before. I need to further examine the crystal and think of a way to stimulate the spatial energy contained in the crystals... ”

He continued, “I’m also very interested in the blood pool you mentioned earlier. There are indeed traces of various elements in the blood. In theory, these elements should have no effect on the meteorite. I still need to do some tests. You did very well this time. You even brought back the blood in the blood pool, so I can do more detailed tests. Remember to keep it up next time... ”
Qiu Yaokang’s eyes were blood red, and he was very excited.
He looked at Fang Heng, and his heart was burning. Even his eyes were shining.
Fang Heng was definitely a gift from God!
With one trip to District 7, Fang Heng brought back the divine potion. Before Qiu Yaokang could study it thoroughly, Fang Heng went to Server 5.
He had brought back so many treasures!
The purple spatial crystals, the Tyrant form cultivation pods, the Tier 5 giant zombie live samples, the first-generation meteorite fragments... All of them were enough for him to study for months!
“Ha... Okay, okay... ” Fang Heng couldn’t help but yawn.
After entering District 5, his mind had been tense. He had been struggling for two days without a good night’s sleep.
Now that he had relaxed, he felt even more tired.
Fang Heng felt his brain buzzing, and he was forced to accept Qiu Yaokang’s message.
Game hints were still flashing wildly in front of him.

“Hint: your shelter has obtained purple spatial crystals. Shelter’s research score has increased. Special research topic ‘spatial structure’ has been activated. Your shelter’s researchers are greatly encouraged. ”

“Hint: your shelter has obtained Tyrant form cultivation pods. Shelter’s research score has increased. Research speed of the current research topic ‘Tyrant forms’ has increased by 50% . Your shelter’s researchers are greatly encouraged. ”
“Hint: your shelter has obtained giant zombie live samples. Shelter’s research level has increased. Special research topic ‘giant zombies’ has been activated. ”
“Hint: shelter has obtained first-generation meteorite. Shelter level has increased. Shelter’s research level has increased. Shelter’s attractiveness has increased... ”
Fang Heng was so sleepy that his consciousness was fading in and out.
He did not even look at the game log carefully. He waved his hand and interrupted Qiu Yaokang’s research report.

“Qiu Yaokang, you are the research supervisor. You can make the follow-up research plans. However, the first-generation meteorite is very dangerous. In addition to the radiation, I found worms in the meteorite. I think those worms might be dangerous. ”
“Worms? Worms can survive in a radiation environment? ” Qiu Yaokang was stunned.
He quickly thought of something and lowered his head to think for a moment.
“Fang Heng, I suspect that the first-generation meteorites have a great connection with the divine potion. ”
Fang Heng forced himself to be alert. “You think so too? ”
“Yeah. I have some findings of the divine potion that you brought back last time. I was about to tell you. ”
As he spoke, Qiu Yaokang led Fang Heng to the experiment table at the side.
Qiu Yaokang picked up an analysis report. “I just got the experiment report last night. I’ll go straight to the point. I think the divine potion is a special culture liquid. ”
Fang Heng was dumbfounded. “What? Culture fluid? ”

“Yeah. Culture fluid for cultivating worm life forms. I used a small amount of the divine potion to do the preliminary biological tests. I noticed that after I use the divine potion, the worms will enter the body of a life form along with the divine potion. It lives in the body of a life form in a parasitic way. ”

sentences.text: Fang Heng told David about what he had seen and heard in District 7.
“There was an accident in the research... the Scavenger Army... ”
David’s expression became more serious after hearing that.
“Thank you for your reminder, Fang Heng.
I will set up a special laboratory when I go back to strictly guard against possible biological infections. ”
A game hint flashed in front of Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: your reminder to David will have a significant impact on the follow-up mission. ”
“Hint: the unknown impact is being determined... ”
It seemed that the reminder was effective!
He hoped that with the reminder, he could change the main storyline a little so that District 8 would not have a Scavenger Army.
Looking at the zombies enthusiastically transporting the goods, Fang Heng sighed in his heart.
“What a pity! ”
He had suddenly remembered that there was still half a truck full of blue crystal raw ores outside that hadn’t been moved back in time!
The unobtained half-truck full of blue crystal raw ores had become the biggest regret of the trip to District 5.
After roughly estimating the time, Fang Heng installed the explosive device in the control center hall and set it to automatically detonate after 30 minutes.
After settling everything, Fang Heng prepared to return to District 8 first.
Just as he was about to step into the spatial rift, game hints appeared again.
“Hint: you are about to enter Server 8 through the teleportation passage. ”
“Hint: there are items in your backpack that can not pass through the spatial rift.
If the items remain in your backpack (excluding the special grids and the warp backpack) , they will be cleared after passing through the spatial rift. ”
“Hint: player can move the item through the spatial rift but not directly through the backpack. ”
Fang Heng stopped walking.
Even after the spatial rift expanded, a player could not carry the backpack along for intra-server teleportation.
“Such troublesome settings, ” Fang Heng muttered and rummaged through his backpack.
The first-generation meteorite had already been sent back to Qiu Yaokang for research.
Now, the more valuable things left in his backpack were just four books on Occult that were brought in from outside the game.
It was simple!
Fang Heng directly took the Occult books in his hand and passed through the spatial rift.
“Hint: you have returned to Server 8 through the space passage. ”
“Hint: the Team Assembly Order that you are bound to has become invalid. ”
“Quick!
What are you doing!
The blood in the bucket is a very valuable research item!
It is stored in Warehouse No.
24 alone!”
“The purple spatial crystals also need to be stored alone.
Has Storage Room No.
18 not been cleaned up yet? ”
The basement of the prison shelter was bustling with activity.
Qiu Yaokang was in high spirits as he ordered the NPC survivors to sort out the materials that had been moved out from District 5.
Fang Heng yawned.
Strong drowsiness hit him.
He really wanted to find a place to sleep.
“Fang Heng, you’re finally back.
I’ve been looking for you for a long time.
We need to build a freezing chamber immediately to seal the giant zombies.
Furthermore, the first-generation meteorite fragments are relatively small, and the radiation level isn’t high.
It shouldn’t be a problem for us to research it after wearing protective suits. ” Qiu Yaokang immediately walked over when he saw Fang Heng.
Even though Qiu Yaokang maintained a cold expression, his voice was still trembling slightly due to his excitement.
“Also, I don’t know how the Night Owl organization managed to put Tier 5 mutated giant zombies into a deep sleep and freeze them.
I guess they must have more advanced methods.
If we study them in detail, we should be able to get some information.
There are also the purple spatial crystals.
I’ve roughly observed their structures from the outside.
It’s a special heptagon crystal space structure.
I’ve never seen a similar structure before.
I need to further examine the crystal and think of a way to stimulate the spatial energy contained in the crystals... ”
He continued, “I’m also very interested in the blood pool you mentioned earlier.
There are indeed traces of various elements in the blood.
In theory, these elements should have no effect on the meteorite.
I still need to do some tests.
You did very well this time.
You even brought back the blood in the blood pool, so I can do more detailed tests.
Remember to keep it up next time... ”
Qiu Yaokang’s eyes were blood red, and he was very excited.
He looked at Fang Heng, and his heart was burning.
Even his eyes were shining.
Fang Heng was definitely a gift from God!
With one trip to District 7, Fang Heng brought back the divine potion.
Before Qiu Yaokang could study it thoroughly, Fang Heng went to Server 5.
He had brought back so many treasures!
The purple spatial crystals, the Tyrant form cultivation pods, the Tier 5 giant zombie live samples, the first-generation meteorite fragments...
All of them were enough for him to study for months!
Okay, okay... ” Fang Heng couldn’t help but yawn.
After entering District 5, his mind had been tense.
He had been struggling for two days without a good night’s sleep.
Now that he had relaxed, he felt even more tired.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Parasitic Worms
paragraphs: “Nutrient solution allows the worms to grow better in the life form. As the worms grow, the host’s emotions will become high, and the values of various indicators will also increase, including strength and physique. However, such an increase is very dangerous. Under most circumstances, the worms will parasitize the animal’s brain. Once the worms lose control and lack certain nutrients, the worms will become irritable, and the host will also become irritable. I haven’t had the time to do more tests. Based on the current situation, the possibility of the worm causing great damage to the host under extreme circumstances is very high. ”
According to the description, the NPCs of the Scavenger Army in District 7 drank the potion and became the host of the worms.
Fang Heng roughly understood that that was the true effect of the divine potion.
“I still need time to analyze if the worms in the meteorites are from the same origin as the worms found in the divine potion. Next, I’ll start to study the first-generation meteorite. ”
“Oh, okay. Do as you see fit. ” Fang Heng rubbed his head that couldn’t catch up.
A wave of indescribable sleepiness hit him, making it impossible for him to continue thinking.
“Forget it! I’ll go offline to catch up on sleep first! ” he thought.
Before leaving, Fang Heng threw the four Occult-related books he had secretly brought into the game world to four zombie clones, telling them to read them overnight in the basement.
After arranging everything, Fang Heng waved at Mo Jiawei and said, “Old Mr. Mo, I’ll go offline to rest first. Keep an eye out. ”
“No problem! ” Mo Jiawei, who was taking stock of the great harvest from Server 5, was unusually excited. He waved at Fang Heng. “Leave it to me! ”
Meanwhile, outside the research institute at the temporary frontline camp set up by the Federation.

“In the end, we decided to leave Fang Heng alone to completely destroy the time passage and the Tier 5 giant zombies left behind by Sikong Mao in the laboratory... ” Wu Xingwen roughly reported the whole process of the infiltration operation to Qian Yuan.
“You didn’t confirm the status of the time passage? ”
Wu Xingwen was surprised for a moment, then said, “At that time, our situation didn’t allow it. ”
“Okay, I got it. ” Qian Yuan’s expression was uncertain.
“Chief, is there a problem? Has the time passage not been destroyed yet? ”

An officer came forward and reported “We believe that the time passage may not have been completely destroyed. The laboratory’s real-time detection showed that the time fluctuation is still there, but the amount of space fluctuation has decreased sharply. In addition, from about half an hour ago, the vampires’ follow-up military support has never appeared again. Based on this, we believe that from that point in time, the teleportation passage has been greatly affected. ”
Wu Xingwen frowned.
The time matched. Over half an hour ago, when they heard the alarm, they mistakenly thought that the spatial rift teleportation passage had been destroyed.
Just as they were thinking, suddenly, a violent tremor came from beneath Wu Xingwen’s feet!
Following that, a loud explosion sounded in their ears!
Boom!
“An explosion? ” Zhou Lei steadied himself and was the first to lift a corner of the command post tent to look outside.
Boom! Boom, boom!
The explosion sounds came from within the research institute.
The entire research institute had fallen into a sea of fire. Most of the automatic turrets outside the research institute had lost their effectiveness due to this explosion.
The Federation players seized the opportunity to launch a fierce attack on the Night Owl organization.
A Federation military officer reported loudly, “Chief! The time fluctuation signal has suddenly disappeared! ”

“Nice! It must be Fang Heng! He must have thought of a way to destroy the teleportation passage! ” Wu Xingwen was certain that Fang Heng must have detonated the bomb, and he secretly cheered for Fang Heng.
“Great! ” Zhou Lei could not help but wave his fist fiercely.
Only Chen Ziyang felt a little strange when he saw the large explosion outside the research institute.
Something was not right.
Due to the weight-bearing limitation of his backpack, he did not bring many time bombs into the research institute. Logically speaking, blowing up a large hall was the limit.
How could such a violent explosion be caused?
Without the automatic turrets, the research institute’s defensive capabilities were greatly reduced.
In the blink of an eye, the elite players of the Federation had already charged into the periphery of the research institute.
“Thank you for your hard work. ”

Seeing that the situation had been settled, Qian Yuan turned to look at Zhou Lei and Nie Feiran. “On behalf of the Federation, Zombie Apocalypse District 5 would like to thank you two for your assistance. I’ll get someone to bring you down to rest first. We’ll pay the follow-up compensation within three days. ”
“Of course, of course. Thank you. ”
After Zhou Lei and Nie Feiran were sent away, Qian Yuan let out a long sigh of relief.
They had won, but it was also a bitter victory.
It looked like they had wiped out the vampires, but the real trouble had just begun.
Due to the battle, the Federation’s strength had been greatly reduced, and its control over District 5 had weakened even more.
The anti-federation forces that were hiding in District 5 had long been itching to make a move.
They would definitely seize the present opportunity to do so.
Meanwhile, in the Federation’s Shelter No. 1 that had been taken over by the vampires.
“The research institute has fallen, and the time passage has been destroyed. Marquis Dai Ze died in this battle. His holy weapon that the Sinmore Clan had safekept for a long time was also lost. ”
Amelia’s face was gloomy as she listened to her subordinate’s report.

In the original plan, she would lead the vampires to occupy the entire Server 5, causing a greater impact on the Federation. In the end, she would monopolize the entire Server 5’s purple spatial crystal reserves,

“Trash! That short-sighted old fogey, Dai Ze! If it wasn’t for him bringing the Sinmore Clan members to disrupt the situation and transporting the purple spatial crystals back to Vampire Apocalypse in advance, hindering my family’s mid-level vampire reinforcements, I wouldn’t have failed so badly. ”
“The shame of the vampires! ” A few vampires half-kneeled on the ground.
“All right, there’s no point staying here any longer. Prepare to evacuate. ”
“Yes! ”
Amelia looked out the window at the Federation players who were launching an attack on the shelter.
No matter what, the biggest goal of the trip, the purple spatial crystal ores, had already been obtained.
After returning to the world of the vampires, there was no need for her to make a move. The Sinmore Clan members would definitely be punished for the loss of the holy weapon.
It was not a loss, but Amelia’s mood was very bad.
“Fang Heng? ”
“Yes... It’s me... ”
Fang Heng’s sleep lasted from day to night, and then from night to dawn.
Still a little groggy, he reached out for the phone next to his pillow.
“Fang Heng, are you okay? Did you get caught in the explosion? ”
“No, I’m fine. ”
“Phew... That’s good. ”
Chen Yu also felt that Fang Heng wouldn’t so easily die in District 5.
He had just read the detailed report on what happened in District 5.
After reading the report, Chen Yu was shocked again.
He had always known that Fang Heng was very powerful, but he didn’t expect that Fang Heng had already reached such a level.
He could already control 10 Tyrant form zombies to fight at the same time.
If Fang Heng hadn’t cooperated with the Federation all the while, he would have long been on the Federation’s list of high-risk people and monitored by the Federation 24 hours a day.

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - Potionology
paragraphs: “How on Earth did you do it...”
“Huh? What?”
“No, it’s nothing. This mission has been a great trouble for you. The Federal authorities have decided to give you additional compensation.”
“Oh?”
Hearing the words “additional compensation,” Fang Heng immediately sobered up.
“King of Gods’ points?”
Chen Yu scratched his head, feeling slightly helpless.

“We will try our best to meet your requirements. However, as you know, every month, transactions involving the King of Gods’ points between players have to observe the rules set by the game. The more King of Gods’ points traded, the higher the processing fees. As for the direct exchange of King of Gods’ points, the losses will be high. I suggest that we opt for a direct exchange of the materials you need instead.”
“All right. I will give you a list of materials in a few days,” Fang Heng agreed without hesitation.
To establish the research room, he still needed a lot of rare minerals. It would be more convenient to purchase the minerals from the Federation.
“Also, the authorities asked me to ask you.”
“Hmm?”
“Do you have any plans to change servers and join Vampire Apocalypse?”
“Not interested,” Fang Heng refused.
“All right.” Chen Yu received the expected answer and sighed heavily.
“What is it?”

“You were involved in most of the matters in District 5, so the authorities believe that you should have the right to know. What I am about to say is a Federal secret. I hope that you will keep it a secret to avoid causing panic in the outside world.”
Fang Heng sat up straight on the bed and nodded. “Okay, go ahead.”

“Yesterday, the Federation took back all the shelters that were seized by the vampires. When we were counting the materials, we found that a batch of purple spatial crystals originally in Shelter No. 1 are lost.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
As for purple spatial crystals, not only had he seen them before, but he had also secretly transported more than ten boxes back to the shelter in District 8!
“What is that?”
“It’s a very high-level material. Purple spatial crystals have a kind of spatial energy that can be used to cast spells in space and open the teleportation passage.”
Chen Yu continued worriedly, “I hope the loss of the crystals is just a coincidence.”
Fang Heng was silent.
It was definitely not a coincidence.
The vampires valued the purple spatial crystals very much. The Marquis of the vampires, Dai Ze, had even transported a batch back to Vampire Apocalypse in the first instance.
Fang Heng even felt that the vampires had spent a lot of effort to come to Server 5 just to obtain the purple spatial crystals.
“Putting aside the vampires’ invasion of Server 5, there’s also the Vampiric Spirit Cane that you obtained.”
“Spirit Cane?”
“Yeah. That’s one of the Thirteen Holy Artifacts of the vampires. Under normal circumstances, before it’s purified or sealed, only the vampires have the ability to pick up that thing.”
Chen Yu scratched his head and asked curiously, “How did you do it?”
“Probably because I’m a vampire?”
“What?” Chen Yu was stunned for a moment.
He felt that Fang Heng was lying to him.

“Stop joking. Vampires will want to take it back anyway. Currently, Server 8 is still under Newbie Protection. The chances of the vampires forcefully entering Server 8 is very low, but it’s better to be cautious.”
“Okay, I know. Thanks.”
Fang Heng and Chen Yu continued to chat for a while. After agreeing on the payment for the operation, they hung up.
Fang Heng stretched, preparing to find some food.
Drawing open the curtains, Fang Heng was stunned for a moment. “Eh? Where are the raw blue crystal ores that were stored in the back garden?”
The back garden was empty, leaving only the beautiful scenery of a small bridge and flowing water.
Fang Heng put on his coat and went out to look for the ores.
Just as he opened the door, he met Butler Sun.
Fang Heng immediately asked, “Butler Sun, where are my stones?”

“Mr. Fang Heng, you’ve been resting, so I didn’t have the chance to tell you. If the stones were left outside, they would easily get lost and damp, so I took the initiative to temporarily store them in the storage room. I hope you don’t mind.”
“Oh, it’s fine. As long as they’re not lost.”
Butler Sun smiled bitterly at Fang Heng.
A piece of ore worth millions in the black market was just piled up in the backyard?
No matter how he looked at it, it didn’t seem real.

Butler Sun initially didn’t believe that Fang Heng’s ore was so valuable. However, after seeing how Xiao Ruoruo took out a book from the study and compared the ore with the original blue crystal raw ore in the book, he started to have doubts.
Fang Heng followed Butler Sun to the storage room and saw that the ores were still there. He was not worried anymore.

For the time being, he would leave them in the warehouse. After all, the storage room was a little too far, making to-and-fro transportation troublesome. When he had time, he would slowly bring them back to the shelter in batches.
“Butler Sun, thank you so much. Please carry on with your work.”
“All right. Do excuse me.”
Fang Heng casually dismissed Butler Sun and began to stuff the ores into his backpack.
After filling up a small portion of the blue crystal raw ores and returning to the game, Fang Heng noticed a row of game hints appear before his eyes.
“Hint: you have completed the reading of the books ‘Travel Log to a Foreign Fantasy Land’, ‘Analysis of Potionology’, and ‘Occult Knowledge’. You have gained 322 occult experience points.”
“Hint: you have mastered the skill ‘basic potionology’ while reading.”
Skill: basic potionology (level 1).

Skill description: you have mastered basic potionology. You can rely on mental strength to refine potions (the success rate of the skill is related to the player’s basic attribute, skill level, and basic occult level).
Skill description: this skill can be upgraded to level 10 at most, and the skill can not exceed the player’s level.
“Eh? A skill for free? Reading books is still useful!”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately opened the skill panel to check.
Although he had mastered the skill of basic potionology, when he opened the sub-attribute panel of potionology, there was nothing inside.
There was not a single potionology formula. It was as if learning it was equivalent to not learning it.
Did he need some potionology materials to trigger it?
Fang Heng was thinking when the warehouse door was opened.

“Fang Heng, there you are.” Mo Jiawei stood at the door and greeted Fang Heng excitedly. “I’ve been looking for you for a long time. Genius Qiu has made a big discovery about the first-generation meteorite!”
There was news about the main storyline?
Fang Heng was delighted and immediately put potionology aside.
“Let’s go take a look!”
In the shelter’s laboratory.
Qiu Yaokang, who had stayed up for three nights in a row, was still excited.
The night before, he pulled the shelter’s research team to study the first-generation meteorite overnight.
Even now, the shelter’s research team operated at full capacity as if they were on steroids.

Seeing Fang Heng, Qiu Yaokang picked up the report on the experiment table. “Fang Heng, you’re finally here. There’s good news. I’ve extracted a part of the worm within the first-generation meteorite as a biological sample and confirmed that there’s a gene sequence related to the Primogenitor virus in the worm’s body.”

He continued, “It’s very strange. Once the worm is artificially isolated from the meteorite, it will immediately die. For safety reasons, I haven’t conducted any biological experiments yet. Our research room needs to level up first.”

sentences.text: “How on Earth did you do it...”
“Huh?
What?”
“No, it’s nothing.
This mission has been a great trouble for you.
The Federal authorities have decided to give you additional compensation.”
“Oh?”
Hearing the words “additional compensation,” Fang Heng immediately sobered up.
“King of Gods’ points?”
Chen Yu scratched his head, feeling slightly helpless.
“We will try our best to meet your requirements.
However, as you know, every month, transactions involving the King of Gods’ points between players have to observe the rules set by the game.
The more King of Gods’ points traded, the higher the processing fees.
As for the direct exchange of King of Gods’ points, the losses will be high.
I suggest that we opt for a direct exchange of the materials you need instead.”
“All right.
I will give you a list of materials in a few days,” Fang Heng agreed without hesitation.
To establish the research room, he still needed a lot of rare minerals.
It would be more convenient to purchase the minerals from the Federation.
“Also, the authorities asked me to ask you.”
“Hmm?”
“Do you have any plans to change servers and join Vampire Apocalypse?”
“Not interested,” Fang Heng refused.
“All right.” Chen Yu received the expected answer and sighed heavily.
“What is it?”
“You were involved in most of the matters in District 5, so the authorities believe that you should have the right to know.
What I am about to say is a Federal secret.
I hope that you will keep it a secret to avoid causing panic in the outside world.”
Fang Heng sat up straight on the bed and nodded.
“Okay, go ahead.”
“Yesterday, the Federation took back all the shelters that were seized by the vampires.
When we were counting the materials, we found that a batch of purple spatial crystals originally in Shelter No.
1 are lost.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
As for purple spatial crystals, not only had he seen them before, but he had also secretly transported more than ten boxes back to the shelter in District 8!
“What is that?”
“It’s a very high-level material.
Purple spatial crystals have a kind of spatial energy that can be used to cast spells in space and open the teleportation passage.”
Chen Yu continued worriedly, “I hope the loss of the crystals is just a coincidence.”
Fang Heng was silent.
It was definitely not a coincidence.
The vampires valued the purple spatial crystals very much.
The Marquis of the vampires, Dai Ze, had even transported a batch back to Vampire Apocalypse in the first instance.
Fang Heng even felt that the vampires had spent a lot of effort to come to Server 5 just to obtain the purple spatial crystals.
“Putting aside the vampires’ invasion of Server 5, there’s also the Vampiric Spirit Cane that you obtained.”
“Spirit Cane?”
“Yeah.
That’s one of the Thirteen Holy Artifacts of the vampires.
Under normal circumstances, before it’s purified or sealed, only the vampires have the ability to pick up that thing.”
Chen Yu scratched his head and asked curiously, “How did you do it?”
“Probably because I’m a vampire?”
“What?” Chen Yu was stunned for a moment.
He felt that Fang Heng was lying to him.
“Stop joking.
Vampires will want to take it back anyway.
Currently, Server 8 is still under Newbie Protection.
The chances of the vampires forcefully entering Server 8 is very low, but it’s better to be cautious.”
“Okay, I know.
Thanks.”
Fang Heng and Chen Yu continued to chat for a while.
After agreeing on the payment for the operation, they hung up.
Fang Heng stretched, preparing to find some food.
Drawing open the curtains, Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.
“Eh?
Where are the raw blue crystal ores that were stored in the back garden?”
The back garden was empty, leaving only the beautiful scenery of a small bridge and flowing water.
Fang Heng put on his coat and went out to look for the ores.
Just as he opened the door, he met Butler Sun.
Fang Heng immediately asked, “Butler Sun, where are my stones?”
“Mr.
Fang Heng, you’ve been resting, so I didn’t have the chance to tell you.
If the stones were left outside, they would easily get lost and damp, so I took the initiative to temporarily store them in the storage room.
I hope you don’t mind.”
“Oh, it’s fine.
As long as they’re not lost.”
Butler Sun smiled bitterly at Fang Heng.
A piece of ore worth millions in the black market was just piled up in the backyard?
No matter how he looked at it, it didn’t seem real.
Butler Sun initially didn’t believe that Fang Heng’s ore was so valuable.
However, after seeing how Xiao Ruoruo took out a book from the study and compared the ore with the original blue crystal raw ore in the book, he started to have doubts.
Fang Heng followed Butler Sun to the storage room and saw that the ores were still there.
He was not worried anymore.
For the time being, he would leave them in the warehouse.
After all, the storage room was a little too far, making to-and-fro transportation troublesome.
When he had time, he would slowly bring them back to the shelter in batches.
“Butler Sun, thank you so much.
Please carry on with your work.”
“All right.
Do excuse me.”

You have gained 322 occult experience points.”
“Hint: you have mastered the skill ‘basic potionology’ while reading.”
Skill: basic potionology (level 1).
Skill description: you have mastered basic potionology.
You can rely on mental strength to refine potions (the success rate of the skill is related to the player’s basic attribute, skill level, and basic occult level).
Skill description: this skill can be upgraded to level 10 at most, and the skill can not exceed the player’s level.

A skill for free?
Reading books is still useful!”

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - The Next Journey
paragraphs: Qiu Yaokang adjusted his glasses as he spoke.

“In addition, according to my estimation, as long as we can figure out the relationship between the worms and the first-generation meteorite, we will be able to find a way to completely solve the zombie virus. Earlier on, I communicated with David of the Dark Knights about the discovery of the worms. We will work together, with each of us focusing on a different item. The Dark Knights will mainly study the meteorite while we will mainly study the worms. Hopefully, this will help boost our research speed. ”
Fang Heng saw new game hints appearing in front of him.
“Hint: you have cracked part of the secret of the first-generation meteorite in advance. ”

“Hint: due to your interference with the main storyline, the main storyline progress has undergone a major change. The progress of the main storyline has greatly increased. You have received additional main storyline contribution points. ”
“Hint: the current main storyline in this server has reached 58.9% . The game will announce the ranking of the contribution points for the main storyline in the entire server in 24 hours. ”
“Hint: your contribution points for the main storyline are 276,200. You are temporarily ranked first in this server. ”
“Hint: you can use up 100 King of Gods’ points to delay the announcement of the main storyline for a week. ”
“Hint: after a week, you can use up additional King of Gods’ points to delay the announcement by another 3 days. Each delay will cost twice as many King of Gods’ points as the previous time. ”
“Hint: player, please choose whether to use up 100 King of Gods’ points to delay the announcement. ”
The series of game hints made Fang Heng a little confused.
“F*ck! ”
After carefully reading through the game log, Fang Heng was cursing in his heart.
Why did the completion rate of the main storyline suddenly approach 59% ?

In his original plan, Fang Heng had planned to take advantage of the fact that no one knew that he had acquired the first-generation meteorite to secretly develop himself and quietly do the main storyline.
He had not expected the main storyline to exceed 50% so quickly, and there was even the announcement of the ranking.
“Delay the announcement. ”
Fang Heng decided to spend 100 King of Gods’ points to delay the announcement for seven days.
Now was not the time to expose his main storyline progress.
The current completion rate of the main storyline was less than 60% , and the subsequent main storylines would not be so easy to complete. The game was bound to include interesting elements.
Moreover, in his memory, the federal team of Server 2 of Zombie Apocalypse had already completed the main storyline and successfully obtained the final authority of the game world in Server 2.
But now, Server 2 was still in the apocalyptic world where zombies were rampant.
The follow-up main storyline would definitely not be that simple!
Fang Heng was currently far ahead in terms of contribution points. It would probably be very difficult for others to snatch the first place in contribution points.

What he was most afraid of was the announcement of the main storyline rankings in District 8. At that time, he would become the target of public criticism. In addition, the Night Owl organization would add to his troubles and think of ways to disrupt the main storyline in District 8, adding to his troubles.
He had to take advantage of the next seven days to complete the main storyline.
Fang Heng suddenly felt a heavy pressure.
Seeing that Fang Heng did not speak, Qiu Yaokang turned his head curiously and asked, “Fang Heng? Did you think of something? ”
“Oh, no, nothing. ”

Fang Heng came to his senses. “Levelling up the research room is not a problem. Make a list of the missing materials as soon as possible. Also, how long will it take to have results from researching the first-generation meteorite? ”
“The research is very difficult. It will take at least three to four days to come to a preliminary conclusion. ”
“Three to four days? So slow? ”
“Slow? ”
Qiu Yaokang shook his head and said, “It’s already very fast, Fang Heng. ”

“After the analysis comes to a preliminary conclusion, it will take a very long time to develop the antibodies. Even with the help of the Dark Knights, it won’t be possible without at least a month’s time. ”
“A month? ”
Fang Heng’s heart sank. “Good heavens, a month’s time will be wasted just like that? ”
A week was equivalent to 100 King of Gods’ points. Toward the end, delaying the ranking announcement would require relatively more points.
He could not afford to drag on.
“Is there any way to speed up the research? ”
“Not at the moment. I suggest that you find some researchers to help. ”

Fang Heng lowered his head and began to think. “That’s right! Didn’t the Dark Knights from Server 7 do some research related to the first-generation meteorite? If I can get some information from them... ”
Fang Heng raised his head and said, “If there are research materials related to the first-generation meteorite, would it help speed up the research? ”
Qiu Yaokang was stunned when he heard that. He looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
“Do you have relevant information? ”
“Not at the moment, but I can think of a way to get some for you. ”
Qiu Yaokang thought for a moment and nodded. “If it’s also research on the first-generation meteorite, it should be of help. ”
Mo Jiawei, who had been listening by the side, had a realization. “Hey, Fang Heng, you’re not planning to drop by District 7, are you? ”

He thought, “What the heck, was he planning to drop by District 7 and do the main storyline without saying anything? Overpowered is overpowered indeed. He’s actually doing the main storyline in both servers. ”

“That’s right, I’m planning to go to the parallel world. The Dark Knights there have studied the first-generation meteorite for a period of time, and there might still be research data stored there. ”
The more Fang Heng thought about it, the more he felt that it was a workable plan.

The main storyline of District 7 was highly similar to that of District 8. Apart from searching the relevant information on the first-generation meteorite, he could cross-reference the main storyline flow in both servers.
That would help him speed up the progress of District 8’s missions, too.
If he got lucky and came into direct contact with the owner of the divine potion, he might be able to obtain some information related to the subsequent main storyline in advance.
“How’s the status of the space tearing device? ”
“Very good. Victor already checked and repaired it yesterday. It can be operated at any time. ”
“Good! Let’s not delay further. We’ll set off immediately! ”
With the blue energy crystals from District 5, the space tearing device had sufficient energy. It was enough for Fang Heng to warp for a period of time.
“I’ll go to District 7 now and try to get some information. We’ll do research on the worms in the first-generation meteorite for now. ”
“Okay. Remember to bring some live sample collectors. ” Qiu Yaokang left while shrouded in a frosty aura and went back to command the research team.

“What? God, are you going to Server 7 now? ” Mo Jiawei did not get game hints related to the main storyline. He only felt that Fang Heng was full of energy. The latter had just come back, yet he wanted to get right back into action and head for Server 7.
“Yeah. I’ll leave the shelter to you. Let’s keep in touch at all times. ” Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei on the shoulder.
Before he left, Fang Heng hesitated, asking, “There’s no danger in District 8 recently, is there? ”
Mo Jiawei first shook his head, then thought of something and nodded.
He looked at Fang Heng and said seriously, “In the entire District 8, the biggest danger should be the Tyrants in our prison, right? ”
“Stop joking... ”
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a while.

“This time, I’ll probably have to fight with the Scavenger Army in District 7. In order to complete the mission as soon as possible, it’s better to bring more fighters along with me. It should be enough to bring 10 Tyrants... ” Muttering in a low voice, Fang Heng opened the game log and controlled 100 vine zombies, 50 Lickers, and 10 Tyrants. They would be the sacrificial fighters.
