chapters.title: Chapter 391 - Potion Making
paragraphs: “Activating teleportation... ”
“Teleportation complete. ”
Opening his eyes again, Fang Heng found himself back in a dilapidated warehouse in Edge Creek Town.
It had been three days since he left District 7.
A few game hints immediately appeared.
“Hint: as you have not participated in the raids in Edge Creek Town recently, your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have slightly decreased. ”
“Hint: Roche’s friendship with you has declined slightly. ”
“It’s a bit troublesome... ” Fang Heng muttered in a low voice.
Running back and forth between the two servers, he couldn’t trigger some of the Scavenger Army’s quests, which directly caused their friendship value to drop.
If he delayed a week or two later, he would probably be expelled by the Scavenger Army.
Walking out of the dilapidated warehouse, Fang Heng returned to the town’s central square.
There were only a few scattered Scavenger Army NPCs in the square.
Fang Heng looked around and walked straight to the exchange merchant, Yatu, at the corner of the square.
“Fang Heng, where have you been these two days? Roche has dropped by to look for you several times, but you were never here. He’s very unhappy. ”
“Sleeping. ”
Fang Heng stretched his body muscles.
“I’ve been dozing off a lot recently. By the way, is it a side effect of the divine potion? ”
“Are you here to cheat me, friend? ” Yatu raised his eyelids and replied, “The divine potion can only make people excited and improve their physique. It’s not a sleeping pill. ”
“I’m just joking. ” Fang Heng laughed. “Where’s Roche? ”

“Early in the morning, he took his men to attack the survivors’ shelter. As you know, they’ve been very excited. Recently, the plan to attack Edge Creek Town has encountered a lot of obstacles. The survivor’s shelter has always been able to make defensive arrangements ahead of us. Roche has become more and more irritable. ”
“Oh. ” Fang Heng helplessly spread his hands. He thought, “With Cheng Ya, the Federation’s spy, in the Scavenger Army, it would be a wonder if Roche and the others could succeed so smoothly. ”
“Is there any mission that I can help you with? ” Fang Heng asked.
“You should ask Roche about this. ”
“Isn’t he coincidentally not here? ” Fang Heng checked the exchange column of Yatu and said, “I have nothing to do. What materials do you need? I can think of a way to help you find them. ”
Yatu replied, “I don’t lack materials. I only lack survivors who can make potions. If you can help me find a suitable person, I am willing to provide you with a satisfactory reward. ”
“Hint: you have triggered the mission ‘Troubled Yatu’ . ”
Mission description: Yatu is currently worrying about making potions. Please find some potioneers and bring them to him.
Mission reward: Scavenger Army points.
“Making potions? ” Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He had just learned potionology by reading books on Occult.
Potionology was a branch of Occult. In the current world of Zombie Apocalypse, potioneers belonged to the branch of potion making and medical treatment.
“Could Potionology be used to make common potions? ” Fang Heng wondered.
“It’s always the darkest under the lamp. ” Fang Heng pointed at himself. “Look, I’m a professional potioneer. ”
“You? ” Yatu looked confused, sizing up Fang Heng.
No matter how he looked at it, he felt that Fang Heng was talking nonsense.
“Of course. Before the zombie apocalypse, I had a professional potioneer’s license. Unfortunately, after the zombie apocalypse... ”
Yatu didn’t believe a single word Fang Heng said.
Ignoring Fang Heng’s long-windedness, Yatu turned around and took out five bottles of different colors from the small box behind him. He placed them on the ground one by one.
“Tell me what these bottles are. ”
“Huh, are you testing me? ”
Fang Heng appeared relaxed on the surface, but he wasn’t confident in his heart.
He casually reached out his hand and picked up a pale yellow potion to observe.
As soon as he held the potion bottle, a game hint refreshed in front of him.
“Hint: you have obtained an unappraised potion. ”
“Hint: detected that you currently possess the skill ‘potionology foundation. ‘ You can choose to consume mental strength to analyze and appraise the potion. ”
“Analyze, ” Fang Heng thought to himself.
A gentle stream of mental strength flowed into the potion.
If Yatu were to carefully observe the potion, he would definitely notice that there were tiny bubbles forming in the liquid.
After Fang Heng used less than a third of his mental strength, game hints appeared again.
“Hint: through the skill ‘basic potionology’ level 1, you have analyzed the potion formula and its effects. The potion has a short-term painkilling effect. ”
“Hint: you have obtained a new potion formula. Please name the potion. ”
“I can get formulas just by using a little mental strength? ” Fang Heng raised his eyebrows, thinking that the potionology skill was amazing.
An ordinary potioneer would have to spend money to buy the formula or work hard to get the formula.
“Painkilling potion. ”
“Hint: player has successfully named the potion. Player can choose the said potion in the formula column to make it (you need to prepare the ingredients in advance) . ”
A hint of surprise flashed in Yatu’s eyes. “Did he really make a judgment? And just by looking at it? ”
Usually, a potioneer would be extremely careful with determining unknown potions. They would need to go through various means of determination, and the final conclusion might not even be correct.

Yatu thought, “It’s not possible to determine the type of potion just by observing it with the naked eye. It could also be a random guess that Fang Heng made. Maybe he just happened to use such a potion before. ”
He then said, expressionlessly, “You’re right. ”
To increase the difficulty, Yatu pointed at a colorless potion. “Let’s see. What about this one? ”
Fang Heng picked up the potion and injected his mental strength again.
This time, more than half of his mental strength was consumed.

“Hint: through the skill ‘basic potionology’ (level 1) , you have analyzed the potion formula and its effects. You have determined that this potion is a basic-level potion. This potion has a short-term muscle response enhancement effect. It can quickly increase the player’s basic agility attribute. ”
“Hint: you have obtained a new potion formula. Please name the potion. ”
“Short-term basic agility enhancement potion, ” said Fang Heng.

“Hint: player has successfully named the potion ‘short-term basic agility enhancement potion. ‘ Player can select the potion in the formula column to make it (you need to prepare the ingredients in advance) . ”
Looking at the surprised look on Yatu’s face, Fang Heng curled his lips. “Yatu, It’s not that I want to say this, but isn’t the effect duration of your potion a little too short? ”
Yatu saw Fang Heng in a new light.
It could be passed as a fluke if the latter had guessed correctly once, but he had guessed correctly twice.
“Why aren’t you saying anything? Am I wrong? ”
“No, your analysis is correct. ” Yatu looked at Fang Heng. “How did you do it? ”
Fang Heng shrugged and said honestly, “Based on feeling. ”
“Based on feeling ? ! ” Yatu thought that Fang Heng simply didn’t want to reveal his tricks, so he pointed at another bottle. “Try this one. ”

sentences.text: “Activating teleportation... ”
“Teleportation complete. ”
Opening his eyes again, Fang Heng found himself back in a dilapidated warehouse in Edge Creek Town.
It had been three days since he left District 7.
A few game hints immediately appeared.
“Hint: as you have not participated in the raids in Edge Creek Town recently, your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have slightly decreased. ”
“Hint: Roche’s friendship with you has declined slightly. ”
“It’s a bit troublesome... ” Fang Heng muttered in a low voice.
Running back and forth between the two servers, he couldn’t trigger some of the Scavenger Army’s quests, which directly caused their friendship value to drop.
If he delayed a week or two later, he would probably be expelled by the Scavenger Army.
Walking out of the dilapidated warehouse, Fang Heng returned to the town’s central square.
There were only a few scattered Scavenger Army NPCs in the square.
Fang Heng looked around and walked straight to the exchange merchant, Yatu, at the corner of the square.
“Fang Heng, where have you been these two days?
Roche has dropped by to look for you several times, but you were never here.
He’s very unhappy. ”
“Sleeping. ”
Fang Heng stretched his body muscles.
“I’ve been dozing off a lot recently.
By the way, is it a side effect of the divine potion? ”
“Are you here to cheat me, friend? ” Yatu raised his eyelids and replied, “The divine potion can only make people excited and improve their physique.
It’s not a sleeping pill. ”
“I’m just joking. ” Fang Heng laughed.
“Where’s Roche? ”
“Early in the morning, he took his men to attack the survivors’ shelter.
As you know, they’ve been very excited.
Recently, the plan to attack Edge Creek Town has encountered a lot of obstacles.
The survivor’s shelter has always been able to make defensive arrangements ahead of us.
Roche has become more and more irritable. ”
“Oh. ” Fang Heng helplessly spread his hands.
He thought, “With Cheng Ya, the Federation’s spy, in the Scavenger Army, it would be a wonder if Roche and the others could succeed so smoothly. ”
“Is there any mission that I can help you with? ” Fang Heng asked.
“You should ask Roche about this. ”
“Isn’t he coincidentally not here? ” Fang Heng checked the exchange column of Yatu and said, “I have nothing to do.
What materials do you need?
I can think of a way to help you find them. ”
Yatu replied, “I don’t lack materials.
I only lack survivors who can make potions.
If you can help me find a suitable person, I am willing to provide you with a satisfactory reward. ”
“Hint: you have triggered the mission ‘Troubled Yatu’ . ”
Mission description: Yatu is currently worrying about making potions.
Please find some potioneers and bring them to him.
Mission reward: Scavenger Army points.
“Making potions? ” Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He had just learned potionology by reading books on Occult.
Potionology was a branch of Occult.
In the current world of Zombie Apocalypse, potioneers belonged to the branch of potion making and medical treatment.
“Could Potionology be used to make common potions? ” Fang Heng wondered.
“It’s always the darkest under the lamp. ” Fang Heng pointed at himself.
“Look, I’m a professional potioneer. ”
“You? ” Yatu looked confused, sizing up Fang Heng.
No matter how he looked at it, he felt that Fang Heng was talking nonsense.
“Of course.
Before the zombie apocalypse, I had a professional potioneer’s license.
Unfortunately, after the zombie apocalypse... ”
Yatu didn’t believe a single word Fang Heng said.
Ignoring Fang Heng’s long-windedness, Yatu turned around and took out five bottles of different colors from the small box behind him.
He placed them on the ground one by one.
“Tell me what these bottles are. ”
“Huh, are you testing me? ”
Fang Heng appeared relaxed on the surface, but he wasn’t confident in his heart.
He casually reached out his hand and picked up a pale yellow potion to observe.
As soon as he held the potion bottle, a game hint refreshed in front of him.
“Hint: you have obtained an unappraised potion. ”
“Hint: detected that you currently possess the skill ‘potionology foundation.
‘ You can choose to consume mental strength to analyze and appraise the potion. ”
“Analyze, ” Fang Heng thought to himself.
A gentle stream of mental strength flowed into the potion.
If Yatu were to carefully observe the potion, he would definitely notice that there were tiny bubbles forming in the liquid.
After Fang Heng used less than a third of his mental strength, game hints appeared again.
“Hint: through the skill ‘basic potionology’ level 1, you have analyzed the potion formula and its effects.
The potion has a short-term painkilling effect. ”
“Hint: you have obtained a new potion formula.
Please name the potion. ”
“I can get formulas just by using a little mental strength? ” Fang Heng raised his eyebrows, thinking that the potionology skill was amazing.
An ordinary potioneer would have to spend money to buy the formula or work hard to get the formula.
“Painkilling potion. ”
“Hint: player has successfully named the potion.
Player can choose the said potion in the formula column to make it (you need to prepare the ingredients in advance) . ”
A hint of surprise flashed in Yatu’s eyes.
“Did he really make a judgment?
And just by looking at it? ”
Usually, a potioneer would be extremely careful with determining unknown potions.
They would need to go through various means of determination, and the final conclusion might not even be correct.
Yatu thought, “It’s not possible to determine the type of potion just by observing it with the naked eye.
It could also be a random guess that Fang Heng made.
Maybe he just happened to use such a potion before. ”
He then said, expressionlessly, “You’re right. ”
To increase the difficulty, Yatu pointed at a colorless potion.
“Let’s see.
What about this one? ”

Am I wrong? ”
“No, your analysis is correct. ” Yatu looked at Fang Heng.
“How did you do it? ”
Fang Heng shrugged and said honestly, “Based on feeling. ”

“Try this one. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Exploitation
paragraphs: Fang Heng shook his head in refusal.
He also wanted to verify all the remaining potions and earn quite a few potion formulas for free from Yatu.
Unfortunately, the previous two consecutive potion analyses had already depleted most of Fang Heng’s remaining mental strength.
If things continued, he would probably mess things up.
“There’s no need for that, Yatu. You already know my ability. Don’t waste time with these games. ”
“All right. ”
Yatu didn’t insist and put away the bottles on the ground.
“You passed the test. Come with me. ”
“Hint: your potion making ability has been approved by Yatu. ”
“Hint: your friendship with Yatu has slightly improved. ”
Yatu took Fang Heng out of the square and walked to a temporarily reinforced small warehouse nearby.
Five Scavenger Army NPCs were standing at the entrance, discussing something in a low voice.
A Scavenger Army officer raised his head and asked, “Yatu, who is he? ”
“He is Fang Heng, a member who just joined a few days ago. He knows a little about potion making. I brought him here to help us make potions. ”
Osborne looked at Fang Heng, then turned to look at Yatu.
“Boss Shang is very dissatisfied with your efficiency. There’s only a week left until the delivery. You have to speed up. ”
“I know. Have the medicinal ingredient reserves arrived yet? ”
“They will arrive this afternoon. I will bring you in first. ”
As the two of them spoke, the two NPCs on both sides of the door opened the thick iron doors of the warehouse.
Fang Heng followed Yatu and Osborne into the warehouse.
He immediately smelled a strong medicinal fragrance.

“A large portion of the medicinal ingredients stored in the warehouse are the ones we collected during the recent raid. Most of them are the basic medicinal ingredients used to make the divine potion. ”
Fang Heng nodded and looked around.
The warehouse was very large. More than a dozen Scavenger Army NPCs carrying shotguns stood at the edge of the warehouse and were on alert.
There were also a few NPC survivors making potions on the console in the center of the warehouse.
Fang Heng looked at the back of the warehouse. There was an even larger warehouse behind the warehouse they were in. There were piles of small boxes stored inside.
The strong medicinal fragrance came from there.
“It’s a temporary warehouse for the current special circumstances. Just use it for now. ”

Yatu led Fang Heng to the inner part of the warehouse, introducing, “The Scavenger Army has plundered a lot of materials from Edge Creek Town. What we need to do is to further process the materials and then concoct warlord potion. ”
“Warlord potion? ” Fang Heng frowned. “Isn’t it divine potion? ”

“No, no. Those who have used the divine potion will become excited. All their bodily attributes will increase, and their bodies’ recovery ability will be strengthened. Also, their pain perception will reduce. It is indeed a very powerful potion. However, the divine potion is very complicated to make, and the ingredients needed to make it are scarce. For battle purposes, we have come up with a modified version of it, and that’s warlord potion. ”
He continued, “Simply put, the warlord potion is only effective on people who have taken the divine potion. It can quickly heal the injuries suffered by the human body and relieve fatigue... ”
Fang Heng was enlightened when he heard what Yatu said.
He had learned the truth about the divine potion.

The ordinary divine potion was mixed with nutrient solution for the parasitic worms. The worms then infect the human brain, simultaneously causing both players and NPCs to become sick and strengthening their bodies.
From the looks of it, the warlord potion was probably a knock-off nutrient solution. It could allow the worms to accelerate the host’s life recovery ability.
Putting aside the risk of being infected by the worm, the divine potion was really overpowered.

Yatu went forward and walked to one of the consoles. “The environment isn’t the best, but make do with it. We only need to make the warlord potion. To warriors who have taken the divine potion, the warlord potion is omnipotent. It can solve all problems. ”
“Hint: Yatu has issued you a mission ‘potion making. ‘ ”
Mission name: potion making.

Mission description: the Scavenger Army needs a large number of warlord potions as reserves. The few potioneers in the Scavenger Army are not able to make a large amount of warlord potions. Materials in the army are in short supply. Yatu hopes that you can help the army to make warlord potions.
Mission requirements: assist the Scavenger Army in producing warlord potions.
Mission reward: Scavenger Army contribution points (the reward is related to the quantity and quality of the warlord potion submitted. If the production fails, part of the reward will be deducted) .
Fang Heng quickly glanced at the game hints.

Yatu uttered, “The warlord potion requires a wide variety of medicinal ingredients, and many of them can be replaced with similar ingredients. Considering our limited resources, it is vital to play by ear and judge which ingredients to put into the mix. Try not to waste too much. ”
Fang Heng did not have any potion skills in the past, but he had learned about potionology on the internet for a while.

“Using a similar substitute medicinal ingredient, the quality of the finished potion will be reduced, right? If one mixes similar ingredients instead to achieve the desired medicinal property, the impurities in the potion will also be greatly increased, affecting the quality of the finished product. ”
On the side, Osborne said, “Quantity comes first, quality comes second. ”
“This is the formula. ” Yatu handed two pieces of paper filled with words to Fang Heng.
“Hint: you have obtained the potion blueprint for warlord potion. ”
“Hint: you have learned how to make warlord potion. ”

Fang Heng looked down and felt a little dizzy. He thought, “Wow, the formula for the warlord potion is really complicated. There are six kinds of main medicinal ingredients and almost twenty kinds of supplementary medicinal ingredients. The are also various ways of mixing in the supplementary medicinal ingredients. ”

“Our Edge Creek Town is responsible for supplying warlord potions to the nearby areas. We have most of the required ingredients here. The headquarters will also send us a small portion of the medicinal ingredients every day. In addition, including Edge Creek Town, the medicinal ingredients plundered from the nearby regions will also be provided to our factory in the first instance. ”
Fang Heng nodded and followed Yatu to the potion making console.
A potioneer was preparing the medicinal ingredients needed for the potion making.
A set of ingredients had just been prepared on the console.
“Hint: the materials have met the requirements. You can choose a suitable custom formula to try to make the warlord potion. ”

“Hint: you have chosen a custom formula to make the potion. This potion will consume 36 Vitality. Player’s current potionology level is 1. Success rate of making the potion is 27% , and the grade of the potion after success is C to F. ”
“The success rate of making the potion seems to be a little low, ” Fang Heng lowered his head and thought.
The warlord potion did not exactly belong to the category of potionology, and making the potion only consumed Vitality.
It meant that the zombie clones could also make the warlord potion.
With enough zombie clones and enough medicinal ingredients, he could possibly make unlimited potions to earn points.
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He raised his head and asked, “Yatu, how many potions do we need to make? ”
“Ha. ” Osborne, the commander of the Scavenger Army, sneered and said, “Young man, we need as many as you can make. ”
“As many as I can make? ” Fang Heng ignored Osborne’s tone and thought to himself, “This is great! ”
There was no limit to the Vitality of the zombie clones. When the time came, he could exploit their medicinal ingredients such that none would be left at the end of it all.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - Find Another Way
paragraphs: “Of course, I understand. ” Fang Heng nodded. He looked at the warehouse and asked, “But do I have to stay in this godforsaken place to make potions? ”
Osborne’s cold gaze swept across the potioneers in the warehouse.
“This is to ensure the safety of the potions. Of course, it’s also to ensure your safety. ”

Yatu was very straightforward. “There are many potioneers here who have been snatched from the outside. In order to prevent them from escaping, there are people watching them 24 hours a day. Their personal freedom is also restricted. Of course, you are not within the limits. You can leave at any time. However, every time you enter the warehouse and leave the warehouse, you need to be checked. You are not allowed to leave with the medicinal ingredients and warlord potions without permission. After making the warlord potion, of course, Osborne will give you the corresponding points as compensation. Do you have any questions? ”
“No, I can work at any time. ” Fang Heng massaged his shoulders, looking like he was ready to do something big.
“Good luck, young man. ” Osborne waved his hand and whispered something to Yatu. The two of them left the warehouse together.
When the door of the warehouse closed again, Fang Heng looked around.
The boxes at the edge of the warehouse were lined up in a row, each filled with different medicinal ingredients.
Fang Heng took out some of the medicinal ingredients from the boxes and walked to an empty experiment table.
Soon, Fang Heng customized a set of ingredients for the warlord potion according to the instructions of the warlord potion formula.

“Hint: the prerequisite conditions for making the warlord potion have been met. The consumption of Vitality this time is 37. Current success rate: 27% . Estimated potion quality after completion is C to F. Do you want to make it? ”
“Make it. ”
A long channeling bar appeared above Fang Heng’s head.
When the channeling bar reached its end, a red and bold hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion. Some of the ingredients have been destroyed. Player’s Vitality will be deducted by 45 points. ”
Fang Heng cursed in his heart.
Not far away, the other two NPC potioneers looked at Fang Heng sympathetically.
The warlord potion was one of the more difficult ones in potion making. The success rate of making it was already very low, so failure was expected.
Fang Heng was not discouraged. He prepared another set of potion ingredients and continued to make it.
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion, and part of the potion ingredients have been destroyed. ”
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion... ”
He failed another four times, and it was five times in a row!
“This... ”

In the warehouse, the potioneers looked at Fang Heng, holding back their laughter, their expressions a little twisted. They thought, “Five times in a row? He seems experienced, but isn’t his luck awfully bad? ”
Fang Heng took a deep breath and patted his cheeks, thinking, “This is really weird! Did the game change the success rate? With a 27% success rate, it should be one out of five times, right? ”
Fang Heng wanted to continue, but his Vitality had been exhausted, so he could not continue to concoct.
The situation could not go on.
The success rate was too low.
He had to think of a way to increase the success rate of the potion making.
Fang Heng thought about it.
Ordinary potionology and potion making skills could be used to make potions. If he learned the potion making skill, could it increase the additional success rate?
Moreover, the equipment here wasn’t very good. If he changed to better equipment, he would be able to increase his success rate more or less.
Fang Heng quickly came up with an idea. He got up and left the warehouse.

“He left? ” Outside the warehouse, Osborne was still talking about something at the door of Yatu. Seeing Fang Heng leave, Osborne’s eyes revealed a hint of disdain. “What? is the difficulty too high? Did you give up so quickly? ”
“No, I’m not giving up. I need some special tools. Do you want to check if I’m carrying any medicinal ingredients with me? ”
“No need, go ahead. ”
Watching Fang Heng leave, Osborne looked at Yatu. “This is the person you recommended? Did you misjudge him? Special tools? He really could have given a better excuse. I don’t know what he’s up to. ”
“Don’t worry, he’s different from ordinary people. He might give you a surprise. ”

Fang Heng returned to the square in the center of the town and found his minivan parked at the side. He immediately drove the minivan away from Edge Creek Town and headed to the apocalypse merchant camp.
Fang Heng waited in the apocalypse merchant camp for about two hours.
Ai Lei rushed over after receiving the news. “What’s so urgent? ”
“Good news, we’ve obtained the first-generation meteorite! ”
“Really? Where did you find it? ” Ai Lei was first surprised. Then, his face lit up as he hurriedly asked Fang Heng for details.

The first-generation meteorite of Server 7 had been destroyed. If District 8 could find the first-generation meteorite, they might be able to find some clues from the first-generation meteorite and end the apocalyptic world!
“I got it from another parallel world. ”
Fang Heng told Ai Lei about what had happened in Server 5.
Hearing the news of the Dark Knights being destroyed in the parallel world of District 5, Ai Lei frowned.
After that, hearing about the invasion from the world of the vampires, Ai Lei felt his heart skip a beat.
“Well done! Well done, Fang Heng! ”
After listening to the whole story, Ai Lei waved his arms excitedly.
He was also immersed in the story, and he still wanted more.
“Give me a bottle of beer and put it on his tab. ” Fang Heng was so thirsty that he waved his hand and asked for a bottle of beer from the boss of the apocalypse camp.
“But Fang Heng, how did you pick up the vampire’s Spirit Cane? ”
Ai Lei was very curious about vampires. “Where’s the vampires’ Spirit Cane? Can you show it to me? ”
The vampires’ Spirit Cane was bound to a special backpack grid, always on Fang Heng in the various game worlds.
Even in the real world, Fang Heng could see the vampires’ Spirit Cane in his backpack.
Unfortunately, while he could see it, he couldn’t take it out in reality.
Fang Heng gently turned his wrist, and the Spirit Cane of the vampires appeared in his palm.
“That’s it. ”
“Wow! It’s amazing. ”
Ai Lei felt itchy in his heart. He carefully reached out his hand and took the Spirit Cane of vampires on the table.
“Eh? Didn’t they say that ordinary people can’t pick it up? ”
“That’s under the condition of not recognizing the owner. ”
As Fang Heng spoke, he focused his mind.
Ai Lei immediately felt a strong force coming from the Spirit Cane in his hand, and he couldn’t hold it for a moment.
Whoosh!
The Spirit Cane was suddenly sucked into Fang Heng’s hand.
“Holy sh*t! This move is amazing! ” Ai Lei had never seen such a supernatural thing, and he couldn’t help but exclaim.
“All right, let’s get back to business. ” Fang Heng put the vampires’ Spirit Cane back into his backpack, and his face became solemn as he said, “I need your help. ”
“Tell me about it. I’ll try my best. ”
“I want to finish the research on the first-generation meteorite as soon as possible, so I want to get the research materials related to the first-generation meteorite in Division 7. ”

Ai Lei recalled for a moment and said, “Indeed, we have a backup of the research materials in the laboratory. They have been sealed in the headquarters of the Dark Knights for all these years, so we should be able to find them. ” Ai Lei hesitated for a moment. “But... ”
“What? ”

“Fang Heng, the other members of the Dark Knights may not believe in the time passage you mentioned. They may suspect that you have ulterior motives. In addition, I also hope to restart the investigation on the first-generation meteorite, so I have a request. ” Ai Lei pleaded, “I hope that you can provide us with a small piece of the first-generation meteorite to conduct research on. ”
“All right. ”
“Ha! Thank you! Fang Heng, I knew I could rely on you! ”
Seeing that Fang Heng agreed readily, Ai Lei was excited. He slammed the table and shouted, “Hwak, quick! Serve the beer! ”
“There’s no rush to drink. I still have a troublesome matter that I need you to help me think of a solution for. ”
“Just say it. ”
Fang Heng asked, “Do you have a skill book about potion making? ”
Ai Lei nodded and said, “It’s no big deal. Our Dark Knights have various skill books. If it really doesn’t work, we can buy one from others at a high price... ”

sentences.text: “Of course, I understand. ” Fang Heng nodded.
He looked at the warehouse and asked, “But do I have to stay in this godforsaken place to make potions? ”
Osborne’s cold gaze swept across the potioneers in the warehouse.
“This is to ensure the safety of the potions.
Of course, it’s also to ensure your safety. ”
Yatu was very straightforward.
“There are many potioneers here who have been snatched from the outside.
In order to prevent them from escaping, there are people watching them 24 hours a day.
Their personal freedom is also restricted.
Of course, you are not within the limits.
You can leave at any time.
However, every time you enter the warehouse and leave the warehouse, you need to be checked.
You are not allowed to leave with the medicinal ingredients and warlord potions without permission.
After making the warlord potion, of course, Osborne will give you the corresponding points as compensation.
Do you have any questions? ”
“No, I can work at any time. ” Fang Heng massaged his shoulders, looking like he was ready to do something big.
“Good luck, young man. ” Osborne waved his hand and whispered something to Yatu.
The two of them left the warehouse together.
When the door of the warehouse closed again, Fang Heng looked around.
The boxes at the edge of the warehouse were lined up in a row, each filled with different medicinal ingredients.
Fang Heng took out some of the medicinal ingredients from the boxes and walked to an empty experiment table.
Soon, Fang Heng customized a set of ingredients for the warlord potion according to the instructions of the warlord potion formula.
“Hint: the prerequisite conditions for making the warlord potion have been met.
The consumption of Vitality this time is 37.
Current success rate: 27% .
Estimated potion quality after completion is C to F.
Do you want to make it? ”
“Make it. ”
A long channeling bar appeared above Fang Heng’s head.
When the channeling bar reached its end, a red and bold hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion.
Some of the ingredients have been destroyed.
Player’s Vitality will be deducted by 45 points. ”
Fang Heng cursed in his heart.
Not far away, the other two NPC potioneers looked at Fang Heng sympathetically.
The warlord potion was one of the more difficult ones in potion making.
The success rate of making it was already very low, so failure was expected.
Fang Heng was not discouraged.
He prepared another set of potion ingredients and continued to make it.
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion, and part of the potion ingredients have been destroyed. ”
“Hint: player has failed to make the potion... ”
He failed another four times, and it was five times in a row!
“This... ”
In the warehouse, the potioneers looked at Fang Heng, holding back their laughter, their expressions a little twisted.
They thought, “Five times in a row?
He seems experienced, but isn’t his luck awfully bad? ”
Fang Heng took a deep breath and patted his cheeks, thinking, “This is really weird!
Did the game change the success rate?
With a 27% success rate, it should be one out of five times, right? ”
Fang Heng wanted to continue, but his Vitality had been exhausted, so he could not continue to concoct.
The situation could not go on.
The success rate was too low.
He had to think of a way to increase the success rate of the potion making.
Fang Heng thought about it.
Ordinary potionology and potion making skills could be used to make potions.
If he learned the potion making skill, could it increase the additional success rate?
Moreover, the equipment here wasn’t very good.
If he changed to better equipment, he would be able to increase his success rate more or less.
Fang Heng quickly came up with an idea.
He got up and left the warehouse.
“He left? ” Outside the warehouse, Osborne was still talking about something at the door of Yatu.
Seeing Fang Heng leave, Osborne’s eyes revealed a hint of disdain.
“What? is the difficulty too high?
Did you give up so quickly? ”
“No, I’m not giving up.
I need some special tools.
Do you want to check if I’m carrying any medicinal ingredients with me? ”
“No need, go ahead. ”
Watching Fang Heng leave, Osborne looked at Yatu.
“This is the person you recommended?
Did you misjudge him?
Special tools?
He really could have given a better excuse.
I don’t know what he’s up to. ”
“Don’t worry, he’s different from ordinary people.
He might give you a surprise. ”
Fang Heng returned to the square in the center of the town and found his minivan parked at the side.
He immediately drove the minivan away from Edge Creek Town and headed to the apocalypse merchant camp.
Fang Heng waited in the apocalypse merchant camp for about two hours.
Ai Lei rushed over after receiving the news.
“What’s so urgent? ”
“Good news, we’ve obtained the first-generation meteorite! ”
“Really?
Where did you find it? ” Ai Lei was first surprised.
Then, his face lit up as he hurriedly asked Fang Heng for details.
The first-generation meteorite of Server 7 had been destroyed.
If District 8 could find the first-generation meteorite, they might be able to find some clues from the first-generation meteorite and end the apocalyptic world!
“I got it from another parallel world. ”
Fang Heng told Ai Lei about what had happened in Server 5.
Hearing the news of the Dark Knights being destroyed in the parallel world of District 5, Ai Lei frowned.
After that, hearing about the invasion from the world of the vampires, Ai Lei felt his heart skip a beat.
“Well done!
Well done, Fang Heng! ”
After listening to the whole story, Ai Lei waved his arms excitedly.
He was also immersed in the story, and he still wanted more.
“Give me a bottle of beer and put it on his tab. ” Fang Heng was so thirsty that he waved his hand and asked for a bottle of beer from the boss of the apocalypse camp.
“But Fang Heng, how did you pick up the vampire’s Spirit Cane? ”
Ai Lei was very curious about vampires.
“Where’s the vampires’ Spirit Cane?
Can you show it to me? ”
The vampires’ Spirit Cane was bound to a special backpack grid, always on Fang Heng in the various game worlds.
Even in the real world, Fang Heng could see the vampires’ Spirit Cane in his backpack.
Unfortunately, while he could see it, he couldn’t take it out in reality.
Fang Heng gently turned his wrist, and the Spirit Cane of the vampires appeared in his palm.
“That’s it. ”

It’s amazing. ”

They have been sealed in the headquarters of the Dark Knights for all these years, so we should be able to find them. ” Ai Lei hesitated for a moment.
“What? ”

They may suspect that you have ulterior motives.

In addition, I also hope to restart the investigation on the first-generation meteorite, so I have a request. ” Ai Lei pleaded, “I hope that you can provide us with a small piece of the first-generation meteorite to conduct research on. ”
“All right. ”
“Ha!
Thank you!
Fang Heng, I knew I could rely on you! ”
Seeing that Fang Heng agreed readily, Ai Lei was excited.
He slammed the table and shouted, “Hwak, quick!
Serve the beer! ”
“There’s no rush to drink.
I still have a troublesome matter that I need you to help me think of a solution for. ”
“Just say it. ”

Our Dark Knights have various skill books.
If it really doesn’t work, we can buy one from others at a high price... ”

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - Ranked
paragraphs: At five o’clock in the afternoon, at the crossroads where Fang Heng had agreed to trade the first-generation meteorite.
Ai Lei and the other two members of the Dark Knights were fully armed. They each wore a full protective suit to insulate themselves from radiation and also brought a tool box.
Seeing that the sun was about to set, the three of them waited anxiously.
“Why isn’t it here yet? Is there any change? ”
“Don’t worry, let’s wait a little longer. It’s not time yet. ”
As they spoke, a small white van gradually drove over from the end of the path ahead.
Ai Lei’s heart relaxed, and he pretended to be relaxed as he said, “Look, he’s here. ”
The van stopped at the roadside.
Fang Heng walked out of the white van.
Yang Xia was surprised at Fang Heng’s youth.
“Fang Heng, you’re late. ”
“You guys came too early. ”
Fang Heng stretched his back muscles.
Apart from a large number of blue crystals, using the teleportation passage required prior maintenance checks, which was very time-consuming.
In addition, Fang Heng also lost 3,000 honor points to cut off a small bit of the first-generation meteorite that belonged to the Dark Knights of District 8.
Yang Xia turned to look at the white van behind Fang Heng.
“Where’s the first-generation meteorite? ”
“Don’t look for it. It’s in my hands. ”
Fang Heng flipped his wrist and handed over a first-generation meteorite fragment.
Yang Xia and the others were frightened.
For a moment, they thought that Fang Heng was joking.
The first-generation meteorite had intense radiation.
Fang Heng actually took it out of thin air?
Could it be a fake meteorite?
Fang Heng spread out his hands.
In the center of his palm lay a thumb-sized stone fragmentl.

Jiang Yueping was the chief researcher of the Dark Knights. He stretched his head over and carefully used tweezers to clamp the fragment, placing it in front of his eyes and observing it for a moment.
“It is the real first-generation meteorite! ” Jiang Yueping’s pupils constricted.
He had checked the information about first-generation meteorite countless times. He could tell whether it was real or fake at a glance.
Jiang Yueping’s tone carried a trace of anxiety, and he couldn’t even keep his breathing calm. He turned his head and urged, “Quick, toolbox. ”
Yang Fei immediately opened the toolbox upon hearing that.
Jiang Yueping held his breath and carefully placed the first-generation meteorite into the toolbox before closing the lid.
“Phew... ” Jiang Yueping heaved a heavy sigh of relief.
Seeing how nervous Jiang Yueping was, Yang Xia also became nervous. She asked softly, “Elder Jiang, is this meteorite real? ”
“Yes, it is indeed a first-generation meteorite. ”
Yang Xia looked at Fang Heng in astonishment.
Was he a human or a ghost? He could actually grab a first-generation meteorite with his bare hands? Was he not afraid of being exposed to radiation?
Jiang Yueping did not dwell too much on the issue of radiation. In his excitement, he could not help but sigh.

“I thought that the spatial rift passage was just a theoretical existence. I did not expect it to be true. With the first-generation meteorite fragment, the shelved research project can be restarted. ”
“Hint: you have submitted the first-generation meteorite fragment (small) to the Dark Knights. Main storyline (District 7) has been affected... ”
“Hint: your friendship with the Dark Knights has increased. Your reputation in the Dark Knights has increased. ”
“Hint: main storyline impact assessment... ”
“Hint: assessment completed. You have obtained 12,000 contribution points from the main storyline (District 7) . Your contribution points ranking in District 7 has risen to 8th place. ”
“Hint: your contribution points from the main storyline have entered the top 10. Your name will appear on the leaderboard rankings and can not be hidden. ”
“What the hell! ” Fang Heng was also stunned.
He did not expect that the submission of a meteorite fragment would directly increase his main storyline contribution points by 12,000. He was instantly stunned on the spot.
He was on the leaderboard rankings?
He could not hide it anymore? !
Fang Heng did not expect to be exposed so quickly at the beginning.
He quickly opened the game log to check.
The name “Fang Heng” was casually slapped on the eighth place main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings.
He was completely exposed.
The only fortunate thing was that there were no parentheses at the end of the list indicating that Fang Heng was from District 8.

“Fang Heng, thank you very much for your help. If there’s any news about the first-generation meteorite research, we will immediately contact you. ” Jiang Yueping bowed to Fang Heng and solemnly expressed his gratitude to Fang Heng.
He took a box filled with information from Yang Fei and handed it over to Fang Heng.

“This is the laboratory research information I’ve compiled. It includes research on the first-generation meteorite, the zombie virus, the Blood Moon, the first-generation virus, the quarantine zone, and so on. I hope it can be of help to you. ”
“Uh, okay, thank you... ” Fang Heng came back to his senses.
On the bright side, he had gotten a reward of 12,000 main storyline contribution points.
The Federation ranked first on the leaderboard rankings and had 98,000 main storyline contribution points.
The gap between him and first place was already less than ten times.
“Fang Heng, keep in touch. If there are any clues, we’ll communicate at any time. ”
Jiang Yueping had waited for the present day for too long. He couldn’t wait to start researching the first-generation meteorite. He nodded at Fang Heng and returned to the small car with the box.

Ai Lei handed a skill book to Fang Heng. “Here, I’ve been looking for the skill book that I promised you for a long time. I have to escort them to the research institute now. I’ll contact you later. ”
“Okay. ” Fang Heng took the skill book and looked at it before slapping it on his head.
“Hint: you have obtained the skill book on basic potion making. ”
“Hint: you have learned the skill ‘basic potion making. ‘ ”
Skill: basic potion making
Description: you can make potions according to the formula. The success rate of potion making is related to the skill level.
Description: the skill can be upgraded to level 10 and can not exceed the player’s current level (after the skill reaches the maximum level, you can try to upgrade the skill)
Description: you can try to combine various medicinal ingredients to learn a potion formula. Alternatively, you can do so through reading, getting passed down information from others, and so on.
Fang Heng glanced at the game description and muttered softly, “With the basic potion making skill, I can make the warlord potion with a more or less increased success rate, right? ”
In Edge Creek Town, the team led by Roche had also returned.
A group of Scavenger Army NPCs crowded in the square, making a lot of noise.
Fang Heng drove the white van back to Edge Creek Town and parked it at the side of the central square.
Just as he got out of the van, a two-line game hint refreshed in front of him.
“Hint: as a result of their defeat, the Scavenger Army has low morale. When participating in the battle, the final effective output of damage will be reduced by 10% . ”
“Hint: as a result of their defeat, the price of all materials that you exchange will be increased by 25% . ”

“Oof. They lost the war again, didn’t they? They were tricked by the mole again, weren’t they? ” Fang Heng thought. He got out of the van and glanced at Cheng Ya, who was sitting in the corner of the square, before walking toward the center of the square.

“Those two young adults beside Cheng Ya look unfamiliar. They’re also players who just joined the Scavenger Army, most likely from the Federation. ” Fang Heng quickly made some calculations in his heart.
Meanwhile, Cheng Ya also noticed Fang Heng, and a hint of vigilance appeared in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - Industrial Potion Making
paragraphs: “Fang Heng! ” Roche had been sitting by the flower bed and had nowhere to vent his anger. When he noticed Fang Heng, he shouted, “Damn it! Where have you been these two days? ”
“It’s my first time drinking the divine potion. I don’t feel well, ” Fang Heng explained casually.

“Bah! Damn it! ” Roche spat on the ground and said fiercely, “You came at the right time. Those shelters are an eyesore. I don’t want to endure any longer. Tonight, we will launch an all-out attack and take everyone there! Those trashes would never expect our attack at night. ”
Roche gave off a vicious aura. “Fang Heng, just like last time, you will also take a team there. ”
Cheng Ya’s expression changed when she heard what Roche said.

“All-out surprise attack? A wave in the morning and another surprise attack at night? I have to inform all the shelters to prepare immediately! With little time to react and counterattack, it’s very likely that the shelters will be destroyed. Moreover... I’m most worried about him, ” Cheng Ya thought as she secretly looked at Fang Heng again.
In the past two days, when Fang Heng was not around, the players’ shelter near Edge Creek Town had the upper hand and resisted the Scavenger Army’s attack.
Once Fang Heng joined the all-out attack, the players’ side would be in trouble again.
She needed to send the news back as soon as possible so that the players in the shelter could take precautions in advance.
Roche was in a very bad mood and was very irritable.
He threw a bottle on the ground to vent the anger in his heart. “Those damn b*stards! I want to crush them now! ”
“Hint: Roche has made a public invitation to the players’ shelter near Edge Creek town tonight. Will you accept it? If you refuse, it will greatly reduce Roche’s favorability rating. ”
“Roche, I don’t think it’s a good idea to launch an attack tonight. ”
“Huh? ” Roche turned around.
His bloodshot eyes stared at Fang Heng, filled with killing intent.
“Fang Heng, are you questioning my decision? ”
For a moment, the NPCs in the square stopped making noise, and the atmosphere instantly fell to freezing point.
“Continuous fighting will affect our combat power. We need some time to rest. ”
Fang Heng did not show any fear. He took a few steps forward.
“Give me some time. I have already prepared a plan. Bear with it for a while. By tomorrow, we will definitely be able to easily complete the plan to attack Edge Creek Town. ”
Cheng Ya and the other two from the Federation stood aside and watched Fang Heng and Roche confront each other. They were even more confused.
It was too strange!
Why would Fang Heng stand up against Roche?
Just to buy some time?
Was it necessary?
Fang Heng had the ability to control zombies, so it was not difficult for him to forcefully attack the players’ shelter.
Moreover, the overall plan for that night’s raid was very sudden. Even Cheng Ya felt pressured.
Why did Fang Heng have to delay it for a day?
While Cheng Ya was confused, Wei Chun, who was beside her, stood up.

“Commander Roche, I think what Fang Heng said makes sense. After so many days, we are tired and need a good rest. Tonight, we will recover our strength and wait until tomorrow to destroy the shelter built by those survivors. ”
Roche turned around and stared at Wei Chun.
Such a fierce look made Wei Chun’s heart skip a beat, and his feet suddenly felt weak.
He gritted his teeth and forced himself to look back at Roche.
“Hahahahahahaha! ”
Roche suddenly burst into laughter.
“Good! Then I will wait for tomorrow to see the surprise you’ve prepared for me. If you can’t satisfy me... ” Roche twisted his neck. The fierce glint in his eyes could no longer be hidden.
After he left, the cold atmosphere that shrouded the square finally eased a little.
“Are you crazy? ”
Cheng Ya was furious at Wei Chun’s self-assertion.
“Cheng Ya, with one more night, we can make preparations in advance. At the same time, we can also think of a way to figure out what Fang Heng is up to. ”
Wei Chun noticed Fang Heng’s movements as he spoke. “He went to the other side of the square. I’ll follow him to take a look. ”
“Don’t go! ” Cheng Ya stopped Wei Chun and warned him in a low voice, “Wait and see. Go offline first and inform your superiors about what just happened. ”
“Hint: you have rejected Roche’s invitation. The friendship between you and Roche has declined. ”
Fang Heng received the game hint and shrugged. He could only comfort himself in his heart.
Anyway, the friendship was already so weak. There was not much to lose.
Soon enough, upon completing the task, he would gain a large amount of Scavenger Army contribution points, and he would get a promotion and a raise. Roche and the others would become his underlings.
“I’ll give him a taste of his own medicine! ” Fang Heng thought as he walked toward the warehouse.
Osborne stood outside the warehouse. He had seen everything that happened earlier. “Challenging Roche’s authority? Are you that confident? ”
“Of course. Just wait and see. ”
Osborne shook his head and waved his hand to signal the two guards to open the warehouse’s door.
Fang Heng returned to the dark Warehouse.
He walked back and forth for a long time and saw that the zombies’ resurrection time was almost up.
Fang Heng walked to the center of the warehouse and looked around.

It was late at night. Since the NPC potioneers didn’t have the habit of staying up late to make potions, most of them had already gone back to the temporary lounge at the back of the warehouse to rest.
There were only four Scavenger Army NPCs guarding the hall.
“Thank you for your hard work. ” Fang Heng waved at the guards and walked to a potion making console in the center of the warehouse.
Half an hour later, a dark red alchemy magic array appeared under Fang Heng’s feet.
“What? ”
The four guards in the warehouse were stunned and subconsciously raised the shotgun in their hands to aim at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng immediately raised his hand to signal.
“Don’t be nervous. Everything is normal. These are my friends. ”
Screech...
In the next second, scarlet Lickers crawled out of the magic array one by one!
Seeing that, the NPCs were shocked. They raised their shotguns and aimed at the Lickers, cold sweat forming on their foreheads.
If it weren’t for the zombie team standing still, the great pressure would have made the NPCs shoot.
Then, a large number of zombies crawled out of the magic array.
“Hey. ”
Fang Heng looked at the guards and nodded. “All right, I’ll guard the area here. Go back and rest. I’ll call you if there’s a problem. ”
The guards looked at each other and realized that their legs had gone soft.
Screech...
Before the head guard could speak, the group of scarlet Lickers climbed up the wall and blocked the entrance of the warehouse, surrounding the four guards.
He really could control the zombie team!
The rumors they heard outside were true!
The head guard’s voice carried a hint of shock, and it was a little hoarse.
“You didn’t see anything, right? ”
“Yes, yes... ”
Fang Heng nodded in satisfaction.
The group of Lickers retreated like the tide, leaving a passage for the guards.
“Go back and rest. Remember, don’t tell anyone about my friends. ”
The four guards fled back to the security room on the second floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Grievance
paragraphs: After dealing with the guards, Fang Heng walked to the experiment table and began to prepare the potion.
Bzz...
Beside his feet, a light blue large-scale magic array flickered, and a huge fist stretched out from the magic array.
The fusion Tyrant forms slowly crawled out from the magic array. They stood up one by one and stood in a row behind Fang Heng.
Fang Heng sauntered to the front of the potion table, sorting the potion ingredients.
“Hint: you have met the potion making requirements. Skills available: ‘basic potionology’ level 1 and ‘basic potion making’ level 1. Acquired skill effect: increased success rate of potion making.”

“Hint: you have met the prerequisites for making the warlord potion. This potion requires 33 Vitality. Current success rate of potion making: 35%. Estimated potion quality after completion is C to F. Do you wish to proceed with the potion making?”
“The success rate has only increased by 8%...” Fang Heng muttered under his breath as a long channeling bar appeared above his head.

“Hint: the production has failed. Some of the medicinal ingredients can not be used anymore. You have consumed an additional amount of Vitality. You have gained 12 basic potion making skill experience points.”
Fang Heng could not help but curse in his heart. “Another failure! The probability’s definitely rigged!”
However, after seeing the increased experienced points, Fang Heng loosened up a little, slightly surprised.
Previously, when he failed to make the potion, there were no experience points gained for the basic potionology skill.
On the contrary, the newly learned potion making skill was very good. Even if he failed, he would still gain some experience points.
In that case, he only needed to make a few more batches to level up his skill level and increase the success rate.
Gaining a little more confidence, Fang Heng continued to sort the medicinal ingredients with his head lowered.
Behind him, the zombies that had long been restless walked up unsteadily, using the sorted medicinal herbs to carry out the next step of the potion making process.
Channeling bar after channeling bar appeared above the heads of the zombie clones.
“Hint: your zombie has completed the production of the warlord potion (success rate: 35%). Production failed! You have received 13 basic potion making experience points.”

“Hint: your zombie has completed the production of the warlord potion (success rate: 35%). Production successful! You have gained 22 basic potion making experience points, 1 basic potionology skill experience points, and the warlord potion (grade E).”
“Hint: your basic potion making skill level has been upgraded to level 2.”
“Hint: your zombie has completed the production of the warlord potion (success rate: 37.2%)...”
Within a few minutes, ten zombie clones had completed the creation of the warlord potion alongside a row of hints that appeared in Fang Heng’s game log.
He had finally succeeded in making three bottles of warlord potion!
Item: warlord potion.
Grade: E

Description: only effective on player (or NPC) who has taken the divine potion before. After using the warlord potion, within a short period of time, the player can recover HP, vitality, quickly recover energy, regenerate limbs, and so on and so forth.
Creator: Fang Heng
Fang Heng stuffed the three completed potions into his backpack and carefully checked the description in the game log.
The skill of basic potionology seemed to be more powerful than basic potion making. It would only increase experience points if the potion making was successful.
In contrast, even if the potion making failed, the skill of basic potion making would gain experience points.
As the skill level gradually increased, the production success rate would also increase.
“Aren’t things getting better...” Fang Heng rubbed his hands excitedly.
Just as he was about to start the so-called industrial production, he suddenly realized that he was being spied on.
Fang Heng abrupty turned his head and looked at the warehouse door behind him.
The door was ajar.

It was late at night, and the abnormal activity caused by the zombie team made the potioneer NPCs not sleep well. Therefore, they secretly got out of bed after a discussion and carefully opened a gap in the door, wanting to see what was happening outside.
Then, they saw a scene that they would never forget for the rest of their lives.
“Hey, you guys, since you can’t sleep, why don’t you come and help me?” Fang Heng said and waved at the crack in the door.
When the survivors realized that Fang Heng had discovered them, they felt as if they had fallen into an ice cave.
“Come, come, come. Come and talk to me.”
Their faces were pale as they walked into the warehouse in fear. They looked at the row of Tyrants standing behind Fang Heng in fear.

“Don’t be nervous. Do me a favor. It’s very simple. I just need you to help sort the medicinal ingredients for making warlord potions with the available materials.” Fang Heng smiled. “Do you understand?”
The potioneer survivors looked at each other and nodded.
“Very good!”
Fang Heng was in high spirits. “I’ll make them f*cking 100 million potions!”
He felt like he had returned to the days of grinding the game.
That night was another sleepless night!
In the real world, there were still many players who could not sleep like Fang Heng.
All the major game companies and game guilds in District 7 were in a mess.
Almost everyone was asking about the same thing.
Who was Fang Heng?
In the blink of an eye, he directly became eighth place on the main storyline leaderboard rankings!
That meant that Fang Heng had obtained at least 8,000 main storyline contribution points in a short period of time!
However, the various large guilds and game companies did not have any information related to Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng? Who is Fang Heng?”
“Is he Fang Heng from District 8?”
“It doesn’t seem like it. He’s probably someone with the same name and surname, right?”
“Do a detailed investigation. I need to confirm his identity!”
“Yes!”
The various large guilds moved upon hearing the news.
The Federation also noticed the player who appeared on the leaderboard rankings in the first instance.
“Have you confirmed it? Is it Fang Heng from Server 8?”

“The IT department has compared some of the audio and video data obtained from Cheng Ya and confirmed that there is 70% similarity. Moreover, considering that he also has the ability to control zombies... the possibility of them being the same person is more than 90%.”
“How? Did he teleport to District 7?”
“Hint: your basic potionology skill has upgraded to level 3.”
“Hint: your basic potion making skill has upgraded to level 8.”
“Huh? What? That’s it?” At two o’clock in the morning, Fang Heng was stunned.

“Yes, Mr. Fang Heng. All the alternative ingredients that can be used together have been fully utilized. We currently lack a type of supplementary medicinal ingredient for the rest and can not make more warlord potions. We couldn’t find a suitable substitute in the warehouse...” a potioneer survivor, Alelho, who was preparing the formula-required ingredients, explained to Fang Heng.
They had finally used up all the ingredients that can be used!
Alelho sighed in his heart.
They could finally rest.
Fang Heng had thoroughly exhausted the few potioneers who stayed up all night to continuously prepare the ingredients.
Seeing that the ingredients had finally been used up, they all sat down to rest.
They were too tired!
It was even more tiring to continuously prepare sets of medicinal ingredients than to directly make the potions.
“Spent all of them? That was fast...” Fang Heng mumbled.
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, the potioneers who were resting on the ground really wanted to curse. Inwardly, they thought, “What? Are you still not satisfied?”
They had been making potions for more than ten years but had never experienced such a ridiculous situation.
Fang Heng didn’t expect that the 100 zombies who had infinite Fatigue Tolerance would already consume most of the medicinal ingredients in the warehouse!

After his skill of basic potionology upgraded to level 3, no matter how successfully the warlord potion was made, it wouldn’t increase experience points. On the other hand, even after his skill of basic potion making reached level 8, he could still gain experience points for it.
It seemed that he was only two levels away from reaching the maximum level!
With the upgraded two skills related to potion making, the success rate of the warlord potion production increased by a large margin.
Currently, the success rate had reached 65.6%, double compared to before!
Fang Heng was enjoying himself when he suddenly realized that he could not continue without the raw materials. He immediately felt an indescribable grievance.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - Imagination
paragraphs: “This is boring... ”
Fang Heng scratched his head.
“I have to think of a way to get some materials, but where? From robbing the players’ shelter? ”
It didn’t seem realistic, since it was rare for the players’ shelter to have the exact medicinal ingredients needed. Even if there were, there wouldn’t be many, and the loot wouldn’t be much.
Right!
Wasn’t there still him?
Fang Heng thought of something and slapped his forehead.
“Thank you for your hard work. Go take your time to rest. We’ll continue working tomorrow at first light. ”
As Fang Heng spoke, he threw down a sleeping bag and went offline on the spot.
“What the hell? Continue tomorrow? ” The NPC potioneers looked at each other.
They didn’t want to go through the same torture again!
Meanwhile, Wei Chun, who was sneakily trying to investigate, was stopped by the guards at the entrance of the warehouse.
After being discovered, Wei Chun could only return to the square dejectedly.
Cheng Ya asked, “How was it? ”
“I’ve asked. Fang Heng went to the warehouse where the emergency materials are stored. The guards at the entrance didn’t allow us to enter. ”
Cheng Ya was even more confused.
She had noticed the warehouse a long time ago. Why was Fang Heng allowed to enter?
“I heard that you need to get permission from Yatu before you can enter. ”
Yatu?
Cheng Ya turned her head to look at Yatu in the central square.
What exactly was in the warehouse? Fang Heng had been inside for so long. What was he doing inside?
Cheng Ya was puzzled. Just then, the survival radio received an emergency communication.
“Captain’ contacting me. ”
Cheng Ya opened her backpack on the spot and checked the survival radio.
“Please check the main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings immediately to confirm Fang Heng’s current situation. Report the situation offline in time. ”
“Main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings? ” Cheng Ya’s heart skipped a beat. She immediately opened the game settings to check. “How could it be... ”
Cheng Ya was shocked.
She did not know when Fang Heng’s name had appeared on the leaderboard rankings!
Moreover, he was shockingly ranked eighth!

The top ten players on the leaderboard rankings in District 7 were all players from various large guilds. Every one of them had the backing of large guilds and large companies. The only exception was a person named Fang Heng.
Cheng Ya turned her head to look at the warehouse. “Fang Heng... It’s definitely him! ”
“Chen Yu? ”
Late at night, when he received a call from Fang Heng, Chen Yu sat up straight, and his expression suddenly became serious.
He rarely received calls from Fang Heng personally, especially at night.
It meant that Fang Heng might be causing trouble in the game again.
Chen Yu was on full alert. “Yes, it’s me. ”

“Hey. Sorry to disturb you so late at night. After all, the matter is quite urgent. Actually, I have a friend who happens to be in District 7 and needs some materials urgently. I owe him a favor... You know I can’t make it in District 7, right? So, about the materials you originally promised to give me, send them directly to District 7. ”
Hearing that Fang Heng only called to ask for materials, Chen Yu relaxed a little.
He was afraid that Fang Heng would cause some trouble in District 8m but there was no need to care about District 7!
“Oh, it’s about that. It’s definitely not a problem. I just need to communicate with my superiors. ”

Why does your friend need so many medicinal ingredients? Sure, I’ll help you contact them. Where do you want them delivered to? ”

Now that the favor would be considered returned with him just providing medicinal ingredients from District 7, Chen Yu felt that Fang Heng was really a good person.
After all, the prices of the ingredients in District 7 was relatively low, and it didn’t even take up their funds in District 8!

A Federation soldier pushed open the door and entered.
Seeing that he was on the phone again, the soldier nodded at Chen Yu and said in a low voice, “Sir, it’s an emergency letter of investigation from District 7. ”
The soldier placed a letter on the table and carefully exited the door.
It was already so late, and there was still an emergency letter, from District 7, too?
Chen Yu suddenly had a bad premonition. As he picked up the phone, he opened the letter to check.
It was a request for District 8 to help investigate the information of an unknown person who had appeared in the main storyline of District 7.
“Huh? What the hell? Fang Heng? ” Chen Yu flipped through the document and saw the name that suddenly appeared. He was shocked.
He carefully confirmed the contents of the investigation letter.
That afternoon, District 7 discovered that an unknown person had suddenly appeared on the main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings. His name was Fang Heng.
They wanted to confirm if that was the same person as the Fang Heng in Server 8.
Chen Yu blinked several times and looked at the phone in his right hand.

“What a coincidence. No way... Could the friend Fang Heng just mentioned be... himself? But why did he go to District 7 for no reason? The penalty for transferring servers is very severe! It’s basically having to restart all over again! Could it be... ” Chen Yu had a terrifying thought. “Could it be that he went to sabotage District 7 because District 8’s main storyline progress is stuck? That indeed sounds like something Fang Heng would do!
Chen Yu flipped to the few photos attached to the back of the investigation letter and immediately confirmed that the person was definitely Fang Heng himself!
“What the hell! ” Chen Yu quickly picked up the phone again. “Hello? Fang Heng? Is that Fang Heng in District 7 really you? ”
“Eh? You already found out? That’s fast. ” Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
It seemed like he couldn’t keep it a secret anymore.
From the moment his name appeared on the main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings, Fang Heng had a premonition.
Chen Yu knew him very well. Even if he was wearing a mask, it was impossible to hide some small, habitual movements from him.
“I’m not pretending anymore. I’m putting my cards on the table. Yes, Fang Heng from District 7 is me. ”
“You... transferred to District 7? ” Chen Yu subconsciously thought that Fang Heng had given up on District 8 and had directly transferred to District 7.
Fang Heng remained silent and decided to let Chen Yu figure it out himself.
In Chen Yu’s opinion, Fang Heng’s silence was a tacit agreement.
He swallowed his saliva and took nearly a minute to digest the news.

“No wonder District 8 has been so peaceful recently. So, it was because he had gone to District 7! But, Fang Heng is pretty bold and ruthless. Seeing that the main storyline of District 8 can not be completed, he unhesitatingly went to District 7, where he has to start from rock bottom and compete with old players who’ve played there for over ten years of ex. ” Chen Yu’s mind was filled with a flurry of thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - District Transfer
paragraphs: However, the various big game guilds in District 8 had already tacitly acknowledged that Fang Heng’s Prison Army and the Federation both had a strong ruling position.
The main reason was that getting beaten by Fang Heng’s Prison Army a while ago had instilled fear in them a while ago.
Now that Fang Heng had gone to District 7, District 8 would most likely not give up. The Prison Army would most likely be handed over to North River Heavy Industry to manage.
If other players were to learn of this news, it was likely that District 8, which had finally stabilized, would be thrown into chaos again.
There might even be player guilds joining forces to challenge District 8’s Prison Army, trying to split the profits again.
For a time, Chen Yu thought a lot. He felt that he had grown a lot during this period of time, and his thinking was becoming more and more comprehensive.
“I understand. ”
Chen Yu took a deep breath and said in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, I will try to keep this information confidential, but I can’t do much. Your true identity will be exposed soon. Be careful. ”
Fang Heng was stunned. What did Chen Yu understand?
“Your sudden need for so many ingredients is for the main storyline, right? But Fang Heng, how should I give it to you? How long have you been in District 7? Have you built a shelter in there? ”
Fang Heng replied, “Well, don’t worry about that. Once the ingredients are collected, submit them to the nearby Dark Knights’ contact points. I will go there personally to pick them up. ”
As expected! Dark Knights!
Chen Yu was even more sure of his guess.
Fang Heng went to District 7 for the main storyline!
“Okay, after the ingredients are collected, I will send them to the Dark Knights’ contact point... ”
“Thank you, bro. ”
Fang Heng felt that Chen Yu was still very reliable.
After hanging up the phone, Fang Heng stretched his body.
“All right! Continue! ”
After the communication was over, Fang Heng hurriedly went online again.
He was in a hurry.

Taking advantage of the fact that the Federation was still gathering materials, Fang Heng quickly teleported back to District 8 and handed over a large box of materials that he had just received from the Dark Knights in District 7 to Qiu Yaokang.
“Take a look at the information that I’ve just received. Make a copy for the Dark Knights later. ”
Qiu Yaokang was initially a little displeased by Fang Heng’s interruption of the experiment.
However, when he started to flip through the information, he could not take his eyes off it.
“This information... is very useful! ”
After QIu Yaokang flipped through a few pages consecutively, his breathing became a little heavy. He sped up and skimmed through the information page by page.
“Even the information related to the quarantine zone is involved... I will prepare a copy and submit it to David later. ”
“Hint: your shelter has obtained special research data (collection) . In the next 31 days, your shelter’s research speed will be increased by 350% . ”

“Hint: you have submitted the first-generation meteorite research data to the Dark Knights. The speed of first-generation meteorite research has greatly increased. You have obtained 22,000 main storyline contribution points. You will affect the subsequent main storyline... ”

Fang Heng was stunned by the game hints that appeared. “22,000 contribution points? That’s a lot. It’s useful to dabble in two servers. I can get a large amount of main storyline contribution points from both sides. Wonderful!”

“So their research on the first-generation meteorite has already reached this stage. ” Qiu Yaokang flipped through the information and clicked his tongue in wonder. “With this information, the following research and experimental steps for the first-generation meteorite can be greatly improved. I believe that the first batch of research drugs will be completed very soon... ”
In the game, it was 4:30 a.m.
Due to Fang Heng’s impressive battle record in District 8, the Federation of District 7 maintained a high level of vigilance and made adequate preparations in advance.
After an emergency meeting, Cheng Ya went online again.
“It’s confirmed. He is Fang Heng of Server 8. ”
The other two Federation players who were participating in the mission were shocked when they heard this news.
Fang Heng had changed his server!
If the news was leaked, it would definitely cause a huge uproar in District 7 and District 8.
“It’s really him? Why did he come to District 7 when District 8 is developing so well? ”

Cheng Ya opened her mouth, but shook her head and no longer answered. “It’s all too strange! From the information leaked by the higher-ups, it seems like Fang Heng spent so much effort to directly transfer to District 7 for the main storyline. But, shouldn’t he be looking for the Dark Knights in that case? Why is he mixed up with the Scavenger Army instead? They’re not really compatible either... ”
Wei Chun felt strange and asked, “Could it be that the information is wrong? ”
“Impossible. The higher-ups have already confirmed that it’s Fang Heng. ”
“What should we do now? Do the higher-ups have any new instructions? ”

“Wait and see, observe for the time being, and act accordingly. Fang Heng must have his purpose in joining the Scavenger Army. Our mission goal is still to find a way to obtain the divine potion and try to protect the safety of the people. Also, this matter must be kept a secret from the public. Do you understand? ”
“Yes! ” Wei Chun agreed, but his mind was in chaos.
He suddenly realized something and pointed to the side, saying, “Look, Fang Heng has come out. ”
Under the night sky, Cheng Ya saw Fang Heng leave the warehouse alone.
He said something to the guard at the warehouse’s entrance, then walked toward the square alone.
“It’s so late. Where is he going? ”
“Shh, be quiet. Let’s wait and see. ”
Fang Heng had just returned to District 7.
He was having a headache because of the medicinal ingredients.

The Federation had helped to prepare a large number of medicinal ingredients. He could use the space tearing passage of the Dark Knights to collect the medicinal ingredients from the whole of District 7 and gather them in the region of Edge Creek Town.
But there was a problem.
How should he collect the medicinal ingredients after that?
How could he complete the final stage of transporting the ingredients from the Dark Knights’ camp to Edge Creek Town’s Scavenger Army?
Fang Heng admitted that he was greedy to death.
He had the idea of raising the honor points of the Scavenger Army to the peak, completing the current main storyline of District 7, and finding the mastermind behind the Scavenger Army.
Therefore, Fang Heng asked the Federation for a large amount of medicinal ingredients.
It would take a long time just to transport the sheer amount of ingredients from the Dark Knights’ camp to Edge Creek Town by large trucks.
The Dark Knights were willing to help him send them to Edge Creek Town.
However, the Scavenger Army in Edge Creek Town was not very willing to see the Dark Knights.
Both sides would definitely fight, so he couldn’t ask the Scavenger Army to help pick up the goods from the Dark Knights..
As for the zombies... they weren’t speedy enough, and it wasn’t safe, for the trucks could easily topple over with them at the wheel.
It was so troublesome!
Fang Heng was worried as he slowly walked toward the square.
Suddenly, his eyes lit up. “Eh? Cheng Ya! They were still here? That’s great! ” Fang Heng smiled and walked toward Cheng Ya and the others.
“We’ve been discovered. ” After learning that the person in front of him was the famous Fang Heng of District 8, Wei Chun felt an unprecedented pressure.
“Cheng Ya, Fang Heng is walking toward us. ”
“Play it by ear. ” Cheng Ya stood up as she spoke.
