chapters.title: Chapter 399 - Helpers
paragraphs: “Fang Heng. ”
“Hey, you guys are here too. ” From afar, Fang Heng waved at the few of them, greeting them in a friendly manner as if they were old friends.
“It’s so late and you haven’t gone offline to rest. Civil servants are indeed pretty busy. I perfectly understand that to serve the people, your ideological levels must be pretty high. ”
Cheng Ya frowned. She didn’t understand what Fang Heng was up to.
After learning that Fang Heng came to District 7 for the main storyline, the Federation was also very nervous.
From a certain point of view, they were also competitors.

“Don’t be so nervous... I didn’t lie to you. I’ve said it before that I’m Fang Heng. You just didn’t believe me. ” Fang Heng touched the back of his head as he spoke and looked at the serious-looking Wei Chun and Cheng Ya behind him.
Wei Chun couldn’t help but ask, “Fang Heng, what are you trying to say? ”
“Uh... Actually, I want to ask you guys for a favor. ”
Cheng Ya was stunned.
“A favor? ”

“Yes, a small favor. Don’t doubt me. I’ve been cooperating with your side, the Federation, all this while. My reputation is very good. You can ask around. ” Fang Heng smiled gently. “How about this, I’ll give you an elementary divine potion as a reward. ”
Cheng Ya and the others were stunned.
The divine potion was their biggest motive in joining the Dark Knights.
“Fang Heng, I need to consult my superiors. ”
To that, Fang Heng made the “go ahead” gesture. “Of course, but hurry up. You know my agreement with Roche. I don’t have much time left. ”
Half an hour later.
The sky was still dark.
A small white car was parked halfway up the mountain road.
The Dark Knights’ camp of Edge Creek Town was built halfway up the mountain.
“Fang Heng, you’re finally here. ”
Ai Lei walked out of the camp with an anxious look on his face.
“You have too many things. Don’t even talk about organizing them. Just the teleportation alone has cost us a lot of crystal energy, ” he complained with a bitter smile.
At first, when he heard that Fang Heng needed help to transport materials, Ai Lei agreed immediately.
But he didn’t expect that Fang Heng would actually bring such a large amount of medicinal ingredients over and fill up their entire camp.

“Look at you, you’re being calculative with me again, aren’t you? We’re all here to save this world. Why nitpick about crystal energy usage? ” Fang Heng winked at Ai Lei as he spoke. “There’s a small portion of blue crystal raw ores at the back of the truck. Think of it as an investment to save the apocalyptic world. ”
There were still many blue crystal raw ores in the warehouse in the real world. District 8 already had better blue crystal energy sources, so Fang Heng was no longer interested in those raw ores.
Fang Heng also found it troublesome to move them time and again, so he gave them to Ai Lei as payment for borrowing the space tearing device.
“Really? ” Ai Lei was delighted when he heard that. He walked to the back of the truck and saw half of the truck full of energy crystal ores. He was instantly overjoyed.
“Hey, Fang Heng. I knew you were loyal to your friends. ”
“Of course. It’s my motto to earn money together. ”
“Hehe. ”
The two of them looked at each other and smiled.
“Come, I’ll take you to see the goods first. ”
“Hint: your friendship with Ai Lei has greatly improved. ”
In the small white car, Cheng Ya and the other two looked at each other.
Fang Heng was indeed connected to the Dark Knights!
And it seemed that they were very close!
He must be secretly doing the main storyline!
“But how did he do it? ” Wei Chun asked the question that was in everyone’s mind.
Weren’t the Dark Knights an opposing camp? Why did their relationship seem to be very good?
No one answered.
In Cheng Ya’s opinion, Fang Heng had too many unsolved mysteries.
After a while, Fang Heng walked out of the camp alone again.
Dong, dong, dong.
Fang Heng knocked on the window and signaled for the three of them to roll down the window. “Follow me. ”
Cheng Ya and the others got out of the car and followed Fang Heng into the Dark Knights’ camp.
As soon as they entered the camp, they smelled a strong medicinal fragrance.
Seeing the mountain of medicinal ingredients piled up in the camp, Cheng Ya and the others were a little confused. “So many medicinal ingredients? ” they thought.
Looking around, they realized that the entire camp was filled with medicinal ingredients. Except for the main passage, the other places were filled with medicinal ingredients.
Just then, Cheng Ya recalled how she seemed to have heard during the meeting not long ago that Fang Heng had requested a large batch of medicinal ingredients from District 7 of the Federation.

Although the commander-in-chief of District 7 was very unwilling to provide the ingredients to such a competitor, the reputation of the Federation was important, so he still held it in and accepted the request. He drew out a large amount of reserve ingredients to give to Fang Heng.
At first, they thought that the medicinal ingredients were needed by an organization or shelter that Fang Heng relied on or had created himself.
However, it turned out that he was the one who needed them.
“But why does he need so many medicinal ingredients himself? Does he have a place to store them? ” Like Cheng Ya, Wei Chun and the other person were full of confusion.
“Let me introduce you. This is Ai Lei from the Dark Knights. ”
Ai Lei nodded at the three of them.
“These are the people I invited to help deliver the goods. ” Fang Heng turned to look at Cheng Ya, then pointed at the few old trucks beside her.

“Our mission is to transport. As you can see, there are a lot of medicinal ingredients in the camp, and this is only a part of it. There are still a lot of medicinal ingredients that will be delivered here one after another. Ai Lei will be temporarily lending these four trucks to us. Try to maximize truck capacity by filling them to the brim. Then, send them back. I will be at the warehouse. ”
“Send them back? Where? ” Cheng Ya was dazed.
“Send them back to the Scavenger Army of Edge Creek Town, the place we just came from. ”
“Scavenger Army? Helping the enemy in front of the Dark Knights? Is that a good idea? ” Cheng Ya was a little confused for a moment. She carefully looked at Ai Lei.
However, she saw that Ai Lei didn’t react at all and was still smiling, seemingly in a good mood.
Those who did not know would have thought that the Dark Knights and the Scavenger Army were working together as a partnership, and that they were funding each other’s resources.
Wei Chun and the others were at a loss.
They looked at each other, and their worldview was a little shattered.
“Could it be that there’s something wrong with this batch of medicinal ingredients? Are Fang Heng and the Dark Knights secretly joining hands to set up a trap for the Scavenger Army? ” they wondered.

Ai Lei uttered, “Thank you for your hard work. People from my side will help you load the medicinal ingredients into the trucks. However, we can’t go into Edge Creek Town, so we can’t help with that. ”

“Thanks, bro. Let me know if you need anything in the future. ” Fang Heng patted Ai Lei’s shoulder and handed a few bottles of coffee to Cheng Ya and the others. “Let’s get to work. Don’t just stand there. We have to hurry up and deliver them. There are still a lot of medicinal ingredients on the way, too. If everything goes smoothly, we’ll probably be able to move them all by tomorrow afternoon... ”
“By tomorrow afternoon? What’s that supposed to mean? Are we expected to transport medicinal ingredients for a full day? Just how many ingredients are there? ” the trio thought.
Wei Chun had his mouth agape as he turned to look at Cheng Ya.
Cheng Ya nodded at Fang Heng. “All right. We’ll do it as quickly as possible. ”
Wei Chun silently took the coffee from Fang Heng, opened the lid, and drank it in one gulp.
“It was indeed difficult to earn money these days, ” he thought.

“Hey, you guys are here too. ” From afar, Fang Heng waved at the few of them, greeting them in a friendly manner as if they were old friends.
“It’s so late and you haven’t gone offline to rest.
Civil servants are indeed pretty busy.
I perfectly understand that to serve the people, your ideological levels must be pretty high. ”
Cheng Ya frowned.
She didn’t understand what Fang Heng was up to.
After learning that Fang Heng came to District 7 for the main storyline, the Federation was also very nervous.
From a certain point of view, they were also competitors.

I didn’t lie to you.
I’ve said it before that I’m Fang Heng.

I’ve been cooperating with your side, the Federation, all this while.
My reputation is very good.
You can ask around. ” Fang Heng smiled gently.

You know my agreement with Roche.
I don’t have much time left. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - Up to No Good
paragraphs: “The IT department has already verified that the player who appeared in District 7 is undoubtedly Fang Heng from District 8. ”
After confirming that the player on the leaderboard rankings was Fang Heng from District 8, the various large guilds felt as if they were facing a great enemy.
They were truly afraid!
They had studied videos of Fang Heng in District 8 over and over again.

In the videos, the strength that Fang Heng displayed was enough to destroy a small shelter in District 7 and deal a devastating blow to a medium-sized shelter. Only a large-sized shelter could defend against him.
Many large guilds had considered directly recruiting Fang Heng.
Unfortunately, the countless offers sank like stones into the sea. Fang Heng’s gaming work studio simply ignored them.
It had been more than ten years since the start of Server 7, and the game had already entered a stable state. Most of the benefits in the game had already been split up.
Now that they had a powerful competitor like Fang Heng, it meant that a portion of their resources would definitely be split up.
No one was willing to let such a thing happen.
As the leading guild of Server 7, after receiving the news of Fang Heng, Leftway Gaming Guild immediately gathered all the major game guilds to participate in a long-distance video conference.
“The latest news from the black market confirms that Fang Heng is currently in Edge Creek Town. ”
“I’ve heard that the players in Edge Creek town are currently fighting with the Scavenger Army. Why would Fang Heng go there? ”

“It might be related to the main storyline, but that’s not important. Fang Heng has just arrived in District 7. Taking advantage of the fact that he’s still young, getting rid of him now is our best chance. The longer we drag this out, the harder it will be to deal with him. ”

A middle-aged man nodded in agreement. “I’ve studied Fang Heng’s information, and his growth rate is too terrifying. At first, I didn’t believe it, but look at how many days it’s been. His main storyline contribution points in District 7 have already reached eighth place... ”
“No matter the cost, we have to get rid of this competitor in advance and chase him back to District 8. ”
“I have contacted Dragon Country Game Company of Edge Creek Town and asked to use their teleportation passage and shelter as the frontline battlefield. ”
The guild leader of Leftway Gaming Guild interrupted the discussion and said, “It’s time to make a decision. Everyone, the future is in our hands. ”
“Medicinal ingredients... ”
In the early morning, the sunlight shone through the gaps in the trees and left a mottled mark on the road.
Cheng Ya gulped down her twelfth bottle of coffee.
For several hours, she had been transporting materials back and forth between the Dark Knights’ camp and Edge Creek Town. Cheng Ya was already a little dazed.
Why did Fang Heng collect so many medicinal ingredients?
Could it be for the main storyline?
Did the main storyline require him to help the Scavenger Army?
No matter how she looked at it, it looked like he was funding the enemy.
Just as she was thinking about it, Cheng Ya received an urgent message from her superiors via the survival radio.
She hurriedly parked the truck by the roadside and immediately went offline.
“Cheng Ya, I just received news that the seventeen large-sized guilds in District 7 have reached an agreement to deal with Fang Heng together. ”
Cheng Ya was shocked when she heard that.
The players in District 7 had never been that united. She did not expect that they would reach an agreement so quickly to deal with Fang Heng.

“It is reported that this operation has been secretly organized by Leftway Gaming Guild. Seventeen guilds have gathered overnight through the space tearing device at the time passage near District 7’s Edge Creek Town. They are expected to launch an attack on Edge Creek Town around noon or the afternoon. On the surface, the reason is to resolve the threat that the Scavenger Army poses to the various large-sized shelters in Edge Creek Town. However, the main goal is to kill Fang Heng. ”
Seventeen large-sized guilds were united.
If they could truly unite in good faith and form a bond, the strength they could exert would be difficult to resist even for the Federation of District 7.
Cheng Ya realized that Fang Heng was going to be in trouble.
“Chief, what should we do? ”
“I’ve asked for instructions. The latest instructions from superiors are to play by ear. ”
“Yes, I understand. ”

Cheng Ya inwardly understood that District 7’s executive officer also didn’t want Fang Heng to enter District 7. After all, his entry would affect the Federation’s control over District 7 and the completion of the main storyline.
If they could use the present opportunity to chase Fang Heng out of District 7, they would most likely be happy to do so.
Even if they couldn’t chase him out, they could have a good gauge of Fang Heng’s strength after the battle.
At the same time, in the game, Fang Heng also received an emergency hint from the game.
“Hint: you have received an emergency message from the external game cabin. Message: God, it’s an emergency. Find an opportunity to go offline. It’s quite urgent. I’ll wait for you. ”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
Emergency?
Could it be that there was trouble in District 8?
Fang Heng parked the truck to the side, threw down a sleeping bag on the spot, and went offline.
Entering the game cabin, Fang Heng saw Mo Jiawei pacing around his guest room anxiously.
“What’s wrong? It can’t be... ”
Mo Jiawei wasn’t in the mood to joke and said, “We’re in big trouble, God. We’ve been exposed. ”
“Huh? ”
“F*ck! ” Mo Jiawei cursed in a low voice and explained, “A friend of mine just told me that the player guilds in District 7 are going to join forces to deal with you, a single person! ”
“Oh? How are they going to deal with me? ” Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
He was a little surprised that the news leaked so quickly.
However, the leak was not what Fang Heng was most interested in right now.
He was very curious about how the player guilds of District 7 was going to deal with him. After all, he was alone in District 7 and did not even have a large-sized shelter.

“They already know that you are hiding in Edge Creek Town. They are going to launch an attack on Fate Creek Town at noon after daybreak and completely destroy the Scavenger Army. At the same time, they are going to think of a way to kill you and drive you out of District 7. ”
“They’re planning to directly attack the Scavenger Army? Are they that brave? ” Fang Heng was shocked.
He couldn’t help but lower his head and stroke his chin, thinking.
He didn’t expect District 7’s reaction to be so big.
They actually rushed all the way to Edge Creek Town to find trouble with the Scavenger Army.
“Would the Scavenger Army not be able to hold on? They’ll probably need to be fed all the potions available. ”
Originally, Fang Heng planned to burn down the warehouse after exchanging all the completed warlord potions for rewards.
After all, he was on the side of the Dark Knights, so he didn’t want to bring trouble to himself with the warlord potions.
Now, since the players of District 7 had come, he had to change his plan.
He would let the players of District 7 fight with the potion-fed Scavenger Army.
Even if the Scavenger Army lost, he still had a zombie team to fight with.
If that also didn’t work out, he would run away.
If both sides fought, he might be able to earn more contribution points.
“Yes! Let them fight! ” thought Fang Heng, who felt that he wouldn’t be disadvantaged anyway.
The prerequisite for earning enough contribution points was that he had to submit the mission before both sides started fighting.
For some reason, seeing the smile on Fang Heng’s face, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but shiver, thinking, “Is God up to something again? ”

Fang Heng raised his head and said, “All right, I understand. I’ll teach them a lesson. Oh right, the defense of District 8 still needs to be strengthened. Be careful of Server 7 coming to look for trouble. Let’s contact each other if anything happens... ”
